Salesforce Developer

Position Type: Full-Time
Schedule: 40 hours per week, Monday–Friday
Time Zone: Eastern Time (ET)
Location: Remote

Apply here:

About the Role

We are seeking a highly skilled Salesforce Developer with strong technical expertise in Salesforce administration, configuration, data management, and CRM process improvement.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience working extensively in Salesforce and is comfortable managing complex datasets, improving CRM processes, configuring Salesforce functionality, and maintaining accurate, reliable sales data.

This role requires strong Salesforce expertise, technical proficiency, attention to detail, and the ability to work within structured processes.

Key Responsibilities

Salesforce Data Management & Cleanup

  • Audit, maintain, and clean Salesforce data, including accounts, contacts, and opportunities.
  • Identify and resolve duplicate, incomplete, and inconsistent records.
  • Standardize fields, naming conventions, data structures, and pipeline information.
  • Support CRM consolidation, migration, and data cleanup initiatives.
  • Maintain data accuracy and integrity across Salesforce.

CRM Configuration & Process Implementation

  • Configure Salesforce objects, fields, workflows, and related CRM functionality.
  • Implement and maintain CRM processes based on defined business requirements.
  • Support customer segmentation and Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) structures.
  • Improve pipeline management, reporting, and data quality processes.
  • Troubleshoot Salesforce-related issues and recommend practical solutions.

Revenue & GTM Operations Support

  • Support revenue and go-to-market (GTM) operational processes.
  • Assist with reporting, forecasting, and revenue planning workflows.
  • Build and maintain Salesforce dashboards and operational reports.
  • Help improve CRM processes to support accurate and reliable revenue data.
  • Collaborate with relevant teams to identify opportunities for process improvement.

Documentation & Operational Support

  • Create and maintain documentation and SOPs for CRM processes and workflows.
  • Promote consistent Salesforce usage and data-management practices.
  • Follow established procedures while identifying opportunities to improve efficiency.
  • Support ad hoc CRM, sales operations, and RevOps initiatives as needed.

Required Qualifications

  • Strong hands-on Salesforce expertise is required.
  • Solid understanding of Salesforce fundamentals, including objects, reporting, data management, and data hygiene.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.
  • Strong technical and analytical problem-solving skills.
  • High attention to detail and accuracy when working with large datasets.
  • Ability to follow structured processes and document workflows clearly.
  • Strong organizational and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in Revenue Operations (RevOps) or Go-to-Market (GTM) Operations.
  • Experience supporting sales or revenue teams in a high-growth environment.
  • Experience with CRM migrations, consolidations, or integrations.
  • Familiarity with automation and workflow tools such as Zapier, Clay, or similar platforms.
  • Experience developing or improving CRM processes and reporting frameworks.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who is highly proficient in Salesforce, technically capable, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with data and CRM processes. The successful candidate should be able to take ownership of Salesforce-related tasks, identify data or process issues, and implement practical solutions while maintaining accuracy and consistency.

raw.description:
Ως μέλος της AI ομάδας της DOTSOFT, ο AI Engineer (NLP/LLM) θα αναλάβει ρόλο-κλειδί στην ανάπτυξη καινοτόμων εφαρμογών βασισμένων σε LLMs, συμπεριλαμβανομένων:

  • Εξατομικευμένων ψηφιακών βοηθών (AI Assistants)

  • Συστήματων αυτόματης παραγωγής και ανάλυσης κειμένου

  • Chatbots και conversational agents σε πολυγλωσσικό περιβάλλον

  • Εργαλείων κατανόησης περιεχομένου και semantic search

Η θέση απαιτεί τεχνολογική ευελιξία, βαθιά γνώση των σύγχρονων AI εργαλείων και ικανότητα συνεργασίας σε διεπιστημονικά έργα.

Κύριες Αρμοδιότητες

  • Σχεδιασμός και ανάπτυξη λύσεων NLP με χρήση Large Language Models (π.χ. OpenAI, HuggingFace Transformers, LLaMA, Mistral κ.ά.).

  • Fine-tuning και βελτιστοποίηση προεκπαιδευμένων μοντέλων σε εξειδικευμένα datasets.

  • Ανάπτυξη pipelines για data preprocessing, training, evaluation και deployment σε cloud/edge περιβάλλοντα.

  • Συμμετοχή σε έργα R&D που ενσωματώνουν AI σε επιχειρησιακές και ερευνητικές πλατφόρμες.

  • Συνεργασία με Software Engineers, UI/UX Designers και Systems Architects για την ολοκληρωμένη υλοποίηση λύσεων.

  • Συμβολή στη συγγραφή τεχνικών παραδοτέων και τεκμηρίωσης AI modules.

  • Παρακολούθηση εξελίξεων στον χώρο του NLP & LLMs και εισαγωγή νέων μεθοδολογιών.

Απαραίτητα Προσόντα

  • Πτυχίο ΑΕΙ σε Πληροφορική, Ηλεκτρολόγων Μηχανικών ή συναφές πεδίο Πληροφορικής / τεχνολογίας Υπολογιστών.

  • Απαραίτητο Μεταπτυχιακό σε Τεχνητή Νοημοσύνη.

  • Επαγγελματική ή ερευνητική εμπειρία σε έργα NLP και Machine Learning.

  • Άριστη γνώση Python και ML libraries (π.χ. TensorFlow, PyTorch, HuggingFace Transformers).

  • Εμπειρία σε fine-tuning και ανάπτυξη εφαρμογών βασισμένων σε LLMs.

  • Κατανόηση αρχών Deep Learning, language embeddings, semantic search και conversational AI.

  • Εμπειρία σε χρήση APIs μεγάλων μοντέλων (π.χ. OpenAI API) και ανάπτυξη custom λύσεων.

  • Εξοικείωση με cloud περιβάλλοντα (AWS, Azure, GCP) ή on-premise AI deployment.

  • Ικανότητα συγγραφής τεχνικής τεκμηρίωσης στα Αγγλικά.

Επιθυμητά Προσόντα

  • Εμπειρία σε multilingual NLP projects ή επεξεργασία ελληνικής γλώσσας.

  • Καλή γνώση MLOps πρακτικών (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines).

  • Εμπειρία σε AI Ethics, Explainability (XAI) και Responsible AI.

  • Συμμετοχή σε ερευνητικά έργα ή ανάπτυξη prototypes στο πλαίσιο R&D.

  • Κατανόηση αρχιτεκτονικών Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).

  • Εμπειρία σε vector databases (π.χ. FAISS, Pinecone)

Τι Προσφέρουμε

  • Συμμετοχή σε πρωτοποριακά έργα με έμφαση στην Τεχνητή Νοημοσύνη και το NLP.

  • Συνεχής επαγγελματική ανάπτυξη μέσω ενασχόλησης με σύγχρονες AI τεχνολογίες.

  • Συνεργασία με διεπιστημονικές ομάδες σε διεθνές περιβάλλον.

  • Δυνατότητα συμβολής στη διαμόρφωση καινοτόμων λύσεων που αξιοποιούν τις τελευταίες εξελίξεις στον χώρο των LLMs.

Εκδήλωση Ενδιαφέροντος

Εάν σας ενδιαφέρει να συμμετάσχετε σε μια δυναμική ομάδα που αξιοποιεί την Τεχνητή Νοημοσύνη για την ανάπτυξη προηγμένων λύσεων, παρακαλούμε αποστείλετε το βιογραφικό σας.

Η DOTSOFT ενθαρρύνει υποψηφίους με ισχυρό τεχνικό υπόβαθρο και πάθος για την εξέλιξη στον χώρο του AI, ακόμη και αν δεν πληρούν το σύνολο των επιθυμητών προσόντων.

Η DOTSOFT Α.Ε., πρωτοπόρος στον τομέα της Πληροφορικής και Επικοινωνιών (ICT), επενδύει συστηματικά στην αξιοποίηση προηγμένων τεχνολογιών Τεχνητής Νοημοσύνης για την ανάπτυξη καινοτόμων ψηφιακών λύσεων. Στο πλαίσιο των έργων Έρευνας & Ανάπτυξης (R&D) και των διεθνών συνεργασιών της, η DOTSOFT αναζητά εξειδικευμένο AI Engineer με εστίαση σε Natural Language Processing (NLP) και Large Language Models (LLMs).

Ο κατάλληλος υποψήφιος θα συμβάλλει ενεργά στον σχεδιασμό, ανάπτυξη και ενσωμάτωση λύσεων Τεχνητής Νοημοσύνης σε σύνθετες πλατφόρμες και έργα, με έμφαση στη γλωσσική κατανόηση, επεξεργασία φυσικής γλώσσας και conversational AI εφαρμογές.

raw.description:
Who we are:

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit to learn more.

About the Role:

The Senior Manager, Strategic Customer Success is a critical leadership position within the Enterprise Sales Organization. In this role, you will be responsible for owning career development, recruiting efforts, account-level strategy, retention, and upsell targets for our remote, US-based team. You will collaborate with Directors of Strategic Accounts and Regional Vice Presidents, along with other departments, to ensure our CSMs effectively help our most valuable customers achieve business success through Motive’s suite of solutions.

The ideal candidate is an excellent leader with deep experiential knowledge of how high-growth SaaS companies leverage Customer Success best practices to grow and retain their customers. This role emphasizes a focus on the client's business outcomes, going beyond just product adoption. Strategic CSMs build strong, trust-based relationships with senior stakeholders, including C-level executives, and act as trusted advisors.

What You'll Do:

  • Lead a team of 6-9 Strategic Customer Success Managers to exceed their retention goals for a portfolio of high-value, high-complexity strategic accounts.
  • Develop and constantly iterate playbooks that drive outcomes for Motive’s strategic clients.
  • Leverage data and analytics to advocate for the client base, care for team performance, and accurately forecast the business, including net revenue retention and gross retention rate.
  • Own advocating for strategic clients with internal stakeholders to drive value and ensure client outcomes are achieved, acting as the voice of the customer within the organization.
  • Manage pipeline reviews, escalations, team meetings, and expectations around Executive Business Reviews and Account Planning, with a focus on delivering high-touch, white-glove service to large, key accounts.
  • Define and execute tailored success plans to help strategic customers achieve their business objectives, including identifying and formalizing solutions to their biggest challenges.
  • Identify and pursue upsell and cross-sell opportunities in collaboration with sales.
  • Monitor customer health, proactively mitigate risks, and secure renewals.
  • Collaborate with product development, sales, and marketing teams to communicate customer feedback and advocate for improvements that align with client needs.
  • Cultivate and manage strong internal and external relationships to ensure our customers' needs are consistently driven forward.

What We're Looking For:

  • 5+ years proven track record of successfully leading a high-performing Customer Success team in B2B SaaS, with a focus on strategic or enterprise clients.
    • B2B Enterprise SaaS platforms with a user-or seat-based licensing model preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to lead a team of 6-9 CSMs with Strategic clients, each carrying a book of business over $4M in ARR.
  • Execution-focused leader with an emphasis on process excellence, utilizing technology specifically with AI.
  • Ability to leverage data to inform decision-making and identify opportunities to service the existing account base better, translating data into actionable insights.
  • Collaborative leader that fosters strong internal partnerships with key stakeholders to effectively advocate for clients.
  • Strong understanding of growth and retention strategies in B2B environments.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage C-level executives and tailor messaging to diverse audiences.
  • Experience with change management, motivating and overcoming barriers to significant, transformational change.
  • Proven ability to build and maintain strong relationships with customers, understanding their unique needs and driving successful outcomes.
  • Demonstrated experience in managing complex internal and external relationships to achieve customer success objectives.

Creating a diverse and inclusive workplace is one of Motive's core values. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives.

raw.description:
The Technical Program Director - Healthcare is accountable for end-to-end delivery leadership for a strategic enterprise healthcare customer, ensuring the successful execution of complex, high-risk technical programs aligned to business outcomes, contractual commitments, and organizational strategy.

The Technical Program Director - Healthcare serves as the single point of accountability for overall program performance, overseeing governance, financial outcomes, and executive stakeholder engagement while driving consistent, high-quality delivery across all workstreams.

The Technical Program Director - Healthcare provides program-level technical oversight across private cloud, infrastructure, and migration initiatives, ensuring solutions meet architecture, security, and regulatory standards. Operating within a highly regulated healthcare environment, this leader ensures programs deliver measurable business value while adapting to evolving customer priorities.

The Technical Program Director - Healthcare also carries full accountability for aligning program delivery with U.S. healthcare regulations such as HIPAA and HITECH, as well as patient safety and clinical operational requirements, including proactive risk management in patient-critical environments. Additionally, the Director ensures the resilience and continuity of patient-critical systems through high availability design, downtime risk mitigation, and robust operational recovery planning.

Work Location

  • Remote in the United States of America

  • Hybrid for candidates located in the San Antonio, TX area, working two days a week at the Rackspace HQ

  • Travel up to 25%

Key Responsibilities

Program Leadership

  • Own and define the overall program vision, strategy, and delivery approach across multiple interdependent projects, including complex infrastructure and migration initiatives

  • Ensure full lifecycle ownership from initiation through delivery, migration execution, operational transition, and closure

  • Direct the development and approval of integrated program and project plans, incorporating technical delivery, dependencies, and sequencing across private cloud environments

  • Maintain alignment between program outcomes and strategic objectives, ensuring delivery across private cloud infrastructure, networking, security, and platform services

  • Ensure the program environment supports successful delivery across all workstreams, including technical assurance, SDDC integration, and management of technical risks and escalations

  • Ensure program plans explicitly account for patient safety, clinical workflows, system resilience, and regulatory compliance, not just technology outcomes

Governance & Control

  • Establish and operate within a standardized enterprise governance framework, ensuring consistency and predictability of delivery

  • Define and maintain program governance structures including Program Board, SteerCo, and escalation paths

  • Ensure adherence to PMO standards including RAID management, stage gates, reporting cadence, and financial control

  • Continuously assess and improve governance processes, contributing to enterprise best practices

  • Ensure all program activities comply with internal standards and delivery frameworks

  • Embed governance controls covering patient safety risk, clinical impact assessments, cybersecurity posture, data protection, and interoperability compliance

Stakeholder & Customer Management

  • Act as the senior accountable interface for executive customer stakeholders (CIO, CTO, Program Sponsors)

  • Lead complex stakeholder engagement across clinical, operational, and technology domains

  • Deliver clear, integrated, and outcome-focused communications to senior stakeholders

  • Manage stakeholder expectations and resolve conflicts across multiple parties

  • Ensure alignment across customer, delivery teams, vendors, and internal leadership

  • Build strong engagement with clinical stakeholders to ensure program decisions support safe, effective care delivery and do not disrupt clinical workflows

Financial & Commercial Management

  • Own program financial performance including revenue, margin, forecasting, and cost control

  • Ensure accurate tracking of program financials including revenue recognition, invoicing, and receivables

  • Lead financial integration across multiple projects within the program

  • Support commercial activities including bids, RFP responses, and vendor selection

  • Ensure the program achieves agreed commercial and contractual outcomes

  • Ensure financial planning accounts for regulatory compliance, cybersecurity, data protection, resilience requirements, and clinical risk mitigation investments

Risk, Issue & Escalation Management

  • Own the identification, assessment, and mitigation of program-level risks and issues

  • Ensure appropriate escalation of risks and issues within governance structures

  • Develop and implement corrective actions to address complex delivery challenges

  • Maintain proactive risk management ensuring program outcomes are protected

  • Ensure unresolved issues are addressed through structured governance forums

  • Explicitly manage risks relating to patient safety, clinical system availability, data privacy, cybersecurity threats, and regulatory compliance

  • Ensure resilience and continuity risks (including downtime and failure scenarios) are proactively assessed and mitigated

Quality & Assurance

  • Ensure all program deliverables meet defined quality standards and customer expectations

  • Lead program-level quality reviews, audits, and assurance activities

  • Validate project quality plans and ensure adherence to quality management processes

  • Drive continuous improvement through lessons learned and best practice adoption

  • Ensure consistent application of delivery methodologies across all projects

  • Ensure quality assurance includes clinical safety validation, regulatory compliance checks, cybersecurity controls, and interoperability standards (FHIR / HL7)

Healthcare Industry Alignment

  • Ensure program delivery aligns to healthcare regulatory, compliance, and operational requirements (HIPAA / HITECH)

  • Manage risks related to patient data, clinical safety, system availability, and critical healthcare services

  • Ensure adherence to data protection, privacy, and cybersecurity standards

  • Ensure solutions support interoperability and integration across healthcare ecosystems (e.g., FHIR, HL7)

  • Navigate complex healthcare stakeholder environments including clinical and administrative functions

  • Ensure programs are designed with full awareness of clinical workflows, patient safety implications, and operational continuity requirements

People Leadership & Resource Management

  • Lead and coordinate multi-disciplinary program and project teams

  • Ensure effective allocation and utilization of shared resources across the portfolio

  • Define program organization structures, roles, and responsibilities (RACI)

  • Support development of program and project management capability

  • Drive a high-performance culture focused on accountability and delivery excellence

  • Ensure teams are aligned to healthcare delivery priorities, including patient safety, regulatory accountability, cybersecurity awareness, and clinical impact sensitivity

Skills and Capabilities

  • Strategic program leadership

  • Executive stakeholder management

  • Governance and PMO alignment

  • Financial and commercial management

  • Risk and issue management

  • Quality assurance and controls

  • Resource planning and optimization

  • Leadership and team development

  • Healthcare SME

Qualifications

  • A minimum of 15 years of experience delivering complex programs in enterprise environments

  • Proven experience managing large-scale, high-risk, multi-stream programs

  • Strong executive presence with extensive customer-facing leadership experience

  • Experience managing strategic enterprise customers with executive-level visibility

  • Demonstrated expertise in data center infrastructure, private cloud, and hybrid cloud environments

  • Experience managing delivery under strict SLAs and contractual frameworks

  • Strong understanding of governance, PMO frameworks, and financial management

  • Strong healthcare experience, including knowledge of HIPAA / HITECH, patient safety considerations, interoperability standards (FHIR / HL7), and clinical systems

  • Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in a field related to the role. At the manager’s discretion, additional relevant experience may substitute for the degree requirement

  • Master’s degree preferred

  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification required

  • Program Management Professional (PgMP) preferred

Work Location

  • Remote in the United States of America

  • Hybrid for candidates located in the San Antonio, TX area, working two days a week at the Rackspace HQ

  • Travel up to 25%

Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several geographic markets. The compensation range for this position ranges from $165,830.00/year in our lowest geographic market up to 243,141.80 USD/year in our highest geographic market. Pay is based on a number of factors including market location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. The compensation package may also include incentive compensation opportunities in the form of annual bonus or incentives, equity awards and an Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP). We have a proven record of advising customers based on their business challenges, designing solutions that scale, building and managing those solutions, and optimizing returns into the future. Named a best place to work, year after year according to Fortune, Forbes and Glassdoor, we attract and develop world-class talent. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in CUDA, GPU architecture, distributed computing, performance optimization, and large-scale AI infrastructure, with a proven track record of designing high-performance computing solutions for enterprise and research environments.

  • Design, develop, and optimize high-performance CUDA kernels for AI, deep learning, and scientific computing applications.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of professional experience in GPU programming, High-Performance Computing (HPC), or parallel computing.
  • Expert-level proficiency in CUDA C/C++, GPU architecture, and massively parallel programming techniques.
  • Extensive experience with NCCL, MPI, CUDA-aware MPI, and distributed GPU communication frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of GPU memory hierarchy, kernel optimization, occupancy tuning, and performance analysis.
  • Hands-on experience integrating custom GPU kernels into PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, Triton, or other machine learning frameworks.

  • Familiarity with cloud-based GPU infrastructure on AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Contributions to open-source GPU libraries, research publications, patents, or technical presentations.
  • Experience with emerging accelerator technologies such as AMD ROCm, Intel

RemotePass exists because talent is distributed equally, but opportunity is not. About the Role:

We are a rapidly growing company that specializes in providing comprehensive global HR and payroll solutions for businesses. Partnerships are set to become one of our largest sources of new pipeline over the next three years, and we are building that function now.

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated individual to build that channel for RemotePass, deciding which partner types are worth pursuing, recruiting and signing them, and making sure the pipeline they produce is measurable and converting.

This is a hands-on role. You will build the target lists, run the outreach, take the meetings and negotiate the agreements yourself.   • Establish roadmap priorities and quarterly focuses for the channel, and report on them monthly with the same rigour as a sales forecast.
  • Design and deliver onboarding and enablement for new partners, so they understand our proposition and can position us accurately.

  • Work with our go-to-market engineer to make partner-sourced pipeline properly traceable in our CRM, so channel contribution can be measured and defended.
  • Co-sell with our account executives, bringing partners into live opportunities and owning the handoffs in both directions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Marketing, Sales, Product and Operations, to align channel goals with wider company objectives.
  • Monitor and analyse channel performance, identify what is not working, and act on it.
  • Act as the main point of contact for our partners, responding to enquiries in a timely and professional manner.
  • Stay up to date with industry trends and competitor channel programmes, and make recommendations accordingly.

    • 4 to 7 years of experience in B2B SaaS or professional services, with at least 2 in channel, partnerships, alliances or partner-led business development.

    • Strong understanding of partner acquisition and engagement strategies.
    • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, including the ability to build credibility with senior people at professional services firms, where the person across the table is an adviser rather than a buyer.
    • Proficient in data analysis and metrics reporting.
    • Strong organisational and project management skills, and a proactive approach to problem-solving.
    • Familiarity with CRM systems, ideally HubSpot

Benefits

  • Be part of a fast-growing global company revolutionizing remote work management.
  • Work in a collaborative and inclusive environment that values innovation and creativity.

Role Overview

We are looking for a strategic, high-caliber Senior Project Manager to drive execution across the company’s most critical growth and product transformation initiatives. In this role, you will bridge the gap between visionary leadership ideas and high-stakes market execution. You will own the delivery framework for complex, cross-functional projects—such as researching, validating, and launching new services, and transforming our core product to maximize client value. You will act as the rhythm-setter for the organization, establishing structured discovery-and-delivery cycles, unblocking teams, and ensuring agile iteration based on constant market feedback.


Key Responsibilities

• Strategic Project Architecture: Take high-level strategic growth directions from leadership and package them into structured, adaptable project frameworks with clear business outcomes.
• Discovery & Validation Management: Coordinate and accelerate cross-functional cycles for searching, testing, and validating new services and market hypotheses.
• Product Transformation Rhythm: Drive the execution roadmap for product changes, ensuring alignment between research, product development, and client feedback loops.
• Agile Roadmap Ownership: Build and maintain flexible, milestone-driven roadmaps; map dependencies and adapt project tracks dynamically based on shifting data and priorities.
• Cross-Functional Orchestration: Align senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams (Product, Growth, Operations) around shared goals, fostering accountability and seamless information flow.
• Governance & Visibility: Establish high-level project visibility via dashboards, steering cadences, and concise executive summaries for leadership.

KPIs / Success Metrics

Strategic Milestone Delivery: % of strategic growth and product initiatives successfully validated and launched on schedule.

Time-to-Market / Validation Velocity: Average cycle time from initial high-level idea to research validation/MVP launch.

Feedback Loop Efficiency: Speed and agility of adjusting project roadmaps based on incoming research and client data.

Process Leadership: Successful adoption of scalable project management frameworks across high-stakes, senior-led initiatives.

Stakeholder Satisfaction: Leadership confidence and minimal executive time required to oversee project progress.

Requirements

  • AI & Emerging Technology Literacy (Must Have): Strong understanding of modern AI ecosystems, including LLMs, AI agents, workflow automation, and AI-powered product experiences. The ideal candidate should be comfortable coordinating projects involving AI-driven operational transformation, conversational systems, MCP/agent-based architectures, and rapid AI experimentation cycles.
  • Travel & Hospitality Tech Expertise (Strongly Preferred / Ideal): Deep familiarity with travel tech, hotel tech, OTA ecosystems, booking engines, channel managers, distribution infrastructure, or hospitality operations is highly preferred. Experience working on products connected to hotel distribution, direct bookings, guest experience, or operational automation is a major advantage.
  • Proven Experience: 5+ years of experience as a Senior Project Manager, Technical PM, or Program Manager within fast-growing tech startups, scale-ups, or top-tier digital ecosystems.
  • Strategic Execution Mindset: A rare mix of structured, process-driven thinking and the ability to thrive in ambiguity. You love frameworks but understand how to manage rapid iteration and R&D cycles.
  • Senior Stakeholder Management: Proven track record of driving cross-functional alignment and managing execution without formal line authority over senior team members.
  • Agile & Product Literacy: Strong understanding of modern product discovery techniques, customer research cycles, and agile project management methodologies.
  • Tool & Tech Proficiency: Advanced expertise in scaling workspace structures using project management ecosystems (Notion, Jira, Asana, etc.).
  • Communication: Exceptional, precise, and crisp communication skills. Ability to synthesize complex, moving project parts into high-level strategic takeaways for executives.

Benefits

  • Fully remote, async-friendly team
  • High ownership and autonomy from day one
  • Chance to build AI-first hospitality infrastructure used globally
  • Competitive compensation + performance incentives

SALARY

raw.description:
Working at Omnisend is... kind of boring.

Not the soul-crushing kind of boring — more like the “no drama, no chaos, just smart people doing great work” kind. The kind that lets you focus on what matters, without pointless meetings, micromanagement, or bureaucracy. We’re data-driven. We test, we iterate, we improve. Gut feelings don’t drive decisions — insights do. We trust each other. We’re transparent, give real feedback, and actually listen. No egos, no hand-holding — just a team of experienced professionals moving fast, adapting easily, and delivering impact. Omnisend is customer-funded and customer-driven. Our work is rooted in solving real problems that help ecommerce brands grow. No empty promises — we bring in results. And yes, we have fun. But the grown-up kind — workations, team gatherings, the occasional party. No forced fun, no awkward icebreakers. Just genuine moments with a team that actually enjoys working together.

About the role:

The Team Lead of Account Experts is a people leadership and regional customer success role within Omnisend’s Customer Success organization. In this role, you will lead and coach a team of Account Experts while overseeing the Chinese speaking book of business. You will be responsible for customer health, retention, and client success across the region, ensuring merchants receive proactive, strategic, and high-quality support.

Working closely with other regional leads and Director of Customer Success, you will help turn CS strategy into strong daily execution, improve team performance, identify risks and opportunities, and make sure APAC customers succeed with Omnisend.

What you’ll do @ Omnisend:

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Account Experts;

  • Oversee the Chinese speaking book of business and take ownership of regional customer health, retention, and client success;

  • Monitor churn risk, adoption, engagement, renewal readiness, and overall account performance;

  • Support the team with complex, strategic, high-value, or at-risk customer accounts;

  • Coach Account Experts on ecommerce strategy, email and SMS marketing, product adoption, retention, renewals, and difficult customer conversations;

  • Ensure APAC customers are successfully onboarded and receive the right guidance across setup, migration, warmup, campaigns, automations, and ongoing account growth;

  • Review customer dashboards, team performance, workload, and open issues to ensure timely follow-up and strong execution;

  • Own first-level customer escalations for the book of business;

  • Drive consistency in customer communication, account planning, QBRs, documentation, and best-practice sharing;

  • Share customer insights, risks, trends, and feedback with the Customer Success team.

  • Foster a culture of accountability, ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

We expect that you’ll bring:

  • 2+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, ecommerce, SaaS, or a similar customer-facing role;

  • Experience leading, mentoring, or coaching others;

  • Experience owning or supporting a book of business, customer portfolio, or regional customer segment;

  • Strong understanding of customer success best practices, retention, adoption, customer health, and account ownership;

  • Good understanding of digital marketing metrics, including opens, clicks, conversions, revenue, engagement, and retention;

  • Ability to identify churn risks, customer health signals, and opportunities to improve customer outcomes;

  • Confidence in discussing business, renewal, cancellation, retention, and growth topics with customers;

  • Strong communication, prioritization, and problem-solving skills;

  • Ability to work with data and make data-informed decisions;

  • A proactive, adaptable, and customer-centric mindset;

  • Familiarity with tools such as Slack, Zoom, Intercom, Mixpanel, HubSpot, G-Suite, Omnisend, or similar platforms;

  • Fluency in English and Chinese (both Mandarin and Cantonese).

What we offer in return:

  • Competitive salary based on experience + commission depending on individual and team results;

  • An unlimited learning budget for self-improvement complying with the best interest of Omnisend;

  • Working methods and best practices inspired by the best tech companies in Silicon Valley;

  • Senior colleagues who enable us to have a high-performing, productive environment where your growth will accelerate;

  • Flexible working hours and remote work possibilities;

  • Private health insurance;

  • Unlimited access to psychotherapy;

  • A workstation budget of 420 EUR;

  • Personalized work anniversary gifts, including house cleaning services, bikes, scooters, spas, international flights, and more depending on the year;

  • Attractive workations and team-led team-building events.

Omnisend is an email and SMS marketing platform built for ecommerce brands. With one-click integration to major ecommerce platforms, intuitive automation, and powerful email templates, we make sophisticated marketing effortless — no learning curve required.
Award-winning 24/7/365 customer support? Check. A platform trusted by growing brands and seasoned pros alike? Absolutely. The idea that “great marketing needs to be expensive”? Our 150,000+ customers prove that wrong every day.

raw.excerpt: PROXIMÉDIAS est un média de proximité, déployé en réseau dans de nombreuses villes de France, dont la vocation est de rendre l’information accessible, vivante et ancrée dans chaque territoire.
raw.description:
PROXIMÉDIAS est un média de proximité, déployé en réseau dans de nombreuses
villes de France, dont la vocation est de rendre l’information accessible, vivante et ancrée dans chaque territoire. Chaque site local agit comme agrégateur de contenus, rassemblant l’actualité internationale, nationale, régionale et thématique par l’intégration de flux RSS et de médias partenaires, tout en donnant une place centrale à l’information locale produite par un(e) correspondant(e) dédié(e) à sa commune. PROXIMÉDIAS propose ainsi une expérience complète où se mêlent les grandes titres et la vie quotidienne du territoire.

Une ligne éditoriale locale, axée « infomercial » intégrant plusieurs thématiques, Histoire d’entreprise, Mon métier ma passion, Changement de Cap, Vie Associative, Focus Sport. Mettre en avant l'ensemble des acteurs de la vie économique locale de manière différente, et les accompagner régulièrement dans la promotion de nouveaux services ou produits, de manifestations ou d'offres spéciales. Une actualité également complétée d'informations pratiques en provenance des différents services publics de votre ville.

PROXIMÉDIAS se fonde sur un modèle résolument attractif pour chaque correspondant(e) :
- un éventail de 7 sources de revenus (articles uniques, articles récurrents, partenariats commissionnés, publicité, sponsoring, financements participatif et parrainage de correspondant(e)s).
- une approche vertueuse pour les articles uniques, avec une tarification au choix pour le professionnel.
- 100% des gains en faveur du(de la) correspondant(e) locale pour les
articles, articles récurrents, sponsoring et publicité locale)
- Un contrôle intégral des flux financiers en votre faveur par l'ouverture d'un espace Stripe dédié, et des paiements directement à votre profit dans un délai variable de 3 à 5 jours.
- Une véritable indépendance dans votre activité et la possibilité de cumuler celle-ci à un autre emploi. - Un statut au choix (freelance, portage salarial, bénéficiaire d'un CAPE en Coopérative d'Activité et d'Emploi).
- La mise à disposition d'un ensemble d'outils (site internet, documents promotionnels personnalisés, e-mailings type, trames informatives), d'une hotline vous accompagnant du lundi au vendredi.

Vos missions

PROXIMÉDIAS recrute des passionnés de l’écrit et de l'information, au contact
humain facile, sans que cette démarche n'ait une vocation purement commerciale. Que vous soyez blogueur, journaliste, écrivain public, ou autodidacte passionné cherchant à renforcer sa présence en ligne, se viabiliser et en faire une activité pérenne et durable, nous faisons appel à vos talents pour renforcer notre présence.

Vos compétences

Cette mission s’adresse à des personnes autonomes, à l’aise avec la sollicitation du tissu socio-économique et associatif local, la production régulière d'articles, la médiatisation et l'information via les réseaux sociaux et la création d'un lien de proximité avec les habitants. Vous devenez la voix de votre ville, un relais essentiel
entre les acteurs du territoire et les habitants.

Avantages

Ce partenariat, au titre de la mise à disposition de moyens techniques et humains induit des frais participatifs volontairement modiques, reconduits trimestriellement, et remboursés par l'octroi de primes majorées sur vos ventes issues de partenariats commissionnés afin de rendre l'offre accessible à tous.

Si vous vous reconnaissez dans cette mission, rejoignez l’aventure, devenez acteur(rice) de l’information locale et offrez-vous un emploi conforme à votre attente !

raw.title: Behavioral Health Care Manager - CA or HI license
raw.excerpt: About The Role Our Behavioral Health Care Managers are the consistent, trusted advocates at the very center of our care model.
raw.description:
About The Role 

Our Behavioral Health Care Managers are the consistent, trusted advocates at the very center of our care model. By providing targeted behavioral health support that integrates with the patient’s physical healthcare, they serve as the vital bridge that unifies the entire care team—from primary care provider to psychiatric consultant—around a single, compassionate plan.

This is a fully remote opportunity supporting one or more of our partner practices, working Monday-Friday.

Please Note: This role is part of our evergreen hiring strategy, where we proactively identify and engage talent for ongoing and anticipated needs across our team. We are continuously building a pipeline of qualified candidates for current and future opportunities.

Applicants will be considered for both immediate and future openings that align with their experience. Candidates may be contacted as opportunities arise, and timelines for next steps may vary based on business needs. We appreciate your patience and look forward to connecting.

Core Responsibilities

  • Support the mental health of patients with cancer on an assigned patient caseload
  • Provide brief behavioral interventions tailored for the cancer setting
  • Screen and assess patients for common mental health and substance abuse disorders
  • Facilitate patient engagement and follow-up care
  • Provide patient education about common mental health and substance abuse disorders and the available treatment options
  • Systematically track treatment response and monitor patients for changes in clinical symptoms and treatment side effects or complications
  • Support psychotropic medication management as prescribed by medical providers, focusing on treatment adherence monitoring, side effects, and effectiveness of treatment
  • Develop a trusted, effective working relationship with the partner oncology practice team
  • Work within partner oncology groups to support patients, clinicians, and practice staff with the identification and intake of patients needing behavioral health support


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in a behavioral health, healthcare, or oncology setting (preferred)
  • You hold one of the following clinical licenses in CA or HI:
    • Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW)
    • Licensed Professional Counselor (LPC)
    • Licensed Professional Clinical Counselor (LPCC)
    • Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT)
  • Dedicated to providing evidenced-based care and have a demonstrated ability to collaborate and communicate effectively in a team setting
  • You enjoy working in a dynamic, fast-growing environment where priorities evolve, processes are continuously improved, and adaptability is essential
  • Prior experience interacting with physicians and collaborating with a multidisciplinary team
  • Have a passion for delivering quality behavioral health care
  • Ability to operate with a high degree of autonomy


Compensation And Benefits

  • Competitive Compensation
  • Medical, dental, vision benefits
  • Flexible PTO
  • 401(k)
  • Access to and mentorship from leading clinicians and experts in psycho-oncology and integrated behavioral health

About Colla Health

We help people with cancer improve their quality of life by providing behavioral healthcare to the 17 million cancer patients in the US as an extension of their medical treatment.

One out of every three cancer patients has a diagnosed mental health condition but only 25% of them receive treatment for their mental health challenges, exacerbating quality of life, worsening health outcomes, and increasing their total cost of care to the system. We are on a mission to provide relevant, accessible behavioral health at the point of care that is embedded within a patient’s oncology practice. We are backed by a premier venture capital firm and are building a world-class team of clinicians, technologists, and healthcare operations builders passionate about helping cancer patients improve their quality of life.

We have built a behavioral health services and technology company to support patients' mental health alongside their physical health treatment plans. Our first offering deploys virtual mental health services using Collaborative Care, an evidence-based behavioral health care model. We will scale this virtual care model using technology, and build the foundations to drive outcomes focused on value-based care.

raw.excerpt: Overview of 66degrees66degrees is an end-to-end AI transformation partner that guides enterprises from complex business challenges to clear, quantifiable outcomes.
raw.description:
Overview of 66degrees

66degrees is an end-to-end AI transformation partner that guides enterprises from complex business challenges to clear, quantifiable outcomes. Our company is the culmination of several successful firms, each a leader in its own right in cloud, artificial intelligence, and data. This convergence of talent and expertise is how we help businesses reach their own "inflection point," where chaotic data becomes a strategic asset, complexity becomes clarity, and AI becomes an engine for growth. Our ultimate vision is to be the catalyst for a future where every business operates as an intelligent enterprise, with autonomous systems unlocking human potential.

At 66degrees, we believe in thriving through challenges and winning together. These values not only guide us in achieving our goals as a company but also for our people. We are dedicated to creating a significant impact for our employees by fostering a culture that sparks innovation and supports professional and personal growth along the way.

Overview of Role

In this role, you will manage multiple aspects of AI information security operations, response, and engineering with a specialized focus on securing AI/ML systems and infrastructure. This position will contribute to a team focusing on incident response, playbook development and execution, operational engineering, AI governance, tooling maintenance, and serving as a key participant in Information Security and AI governance programs. You will work in close collaboration with all IT and AI/ML teams to design and support effective Information Security Operations for International, with emphasis on emerging AI threats and generative AI security.

Responsibilities

  • Manages and is responsible for the successful completion of all tasks in assigned projects.
  • Contribute to the Security Operations and Engineering Team focused on maintaining the security integrity of the client's mission critical suite of applications.
  • Available 24/7 for any critical security incident response that may arise which requires immediate resolution.
  • Work to ensure security tooling within environments is operational and operating at needed levels of service and availability.
  • Ensure operational practices provide a sound foundation that utilizes tools and processes for rapid identification of security events to address and mitigate risks.
  • Assist in Plan, organize, and execute multiple responsibilities to achieve project goals and provide technical leadership to move operational projects to completion.
  • Contribute to security requirements, standards, procedures, and reference architectures to comply with policies and technical standards.
  • Develop and maintain incident response playbooks specific to AI/ML security threats including prompt injection, model poisoning, data exfiltration, and adversarial attacks.
  • Monitor and secure generative AI systems, large language models (LLMs), and AI-powered applications within environments.
  • Contribute to AI governance frameworks and policies ensuring responsible AI practices and compliance with AI-specific security standards.
  • Analyze and evaluate security implications of new AI/ML tools and platforms before deployment to production environments.
  • Participate in AI threat intelligence activities and stay current with emerging AI security vulnerabilities and attack methodologies.
  • Conduct post-incident analysis for AI-related security events and develop preventive measures specific to AI threat vectors.
  • Review and validate AI model security properties, including robustness against adversarial inputs and data privacy protections.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in technology or applicable experience.
  • Related certifications (e.g., GSEC, CISSP, GIAC, AWS) preferred.
  • 5+ Years of experience within information security operations in multiple roles.
  • 3+ years of experience with security incident response and operations
  • 2+ years of experience with AI/ML security, including securing LLMs, generative AI systems, and machine learning pipelines
  • Extensive experience with, but not excluded to: TCP/IP, DNS, WAF, SEIM, and SOAR technologies.
  • Experience with PowerShell, python, and shell scripting
  • Knowledge of information security standards, principles, and practices required.
  • Knowledge of emerging AI security standards and frameworks (NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, industry- specific AI governance guidelines)
  • Experience with AI threat modeling, adversarial attack vectors, and AI-specific vulnerability assessments
  • Understanding of AI governance frameworks, model validation, and responsible AI principles
  • Familiarity with common AI/ML security concerns including prompt injection, model poisoning, data poisoning, and membership inference attacks
  • Ability to work independently and in a team environment.

Please note, we cannot sponsor or transfer any visas, of any kind, at this time.

66degrees is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to actual or perceived race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, national origin, age, weight, height, marital status, sexual orientation, veteran status, disability status or other legally protected class.

AI Transparency & Disclosure

As an AI transformation partner, 66degrees leverages intelligent solutions to enhance our recruitment experience. We utilize AI tools—including LinkedIn Recruiter’s Hiring Assistant and interview transcription technologies—to assist with sourcing, role analysis, and capturing interview highlights.

These tools augment our process, but we "Commit to Our Craft" by ensuring all final hiring decisions are made by our human Talent Team. By applying, you acknowledge the use of these technologies to help us "Win Together" in finding the best fit for our team.

This position will contribute to a team focusing on incident response, playbook development and execution, operational engineering, AI governance, tooling maintenance, and serving as a key participant in Information Security and AI governance programs. You will work in close collaboration with all IT and AI/ML teams to design and support effective Information Security Operations for International, with emphasis on emerging AI threats and generative AI security.

Responsibilities

  • Manages and is responsible for the successful completion of all tasks in assigned projects.
  • Contribute to the Security Operations and Engineering Team focused on maintaining the security integrity of the client's mission critical suite of applications.
  • Available 24/7 for any critical security incident response that may arise which requires immediate resolution.
  • Work to ensure security tooling within environments is operational and operating at needed levels of service and availability.
  • Ensure operational practices provide a sound foundation that utilizes tools and processes for rapid identification of security events to address and mitigate risks.

  • Contribute to security requirements, standards, procedures, and reference architectures to comply with policies and technical standards.
  • Develop and maintain incident response playbooks specific to AI/ML security threats including prompt injection, model poisoning, data exfiltration, and adversarial attacks.
  • Monitor and secure generative AI systems, large language models (LLMs), and AI-powered applications within environments.
  • Contribute to AI governance frameworks and policies ensuring responsible AI practices and compliance with AI-specific security standards.
  • Analyze and evaluate security implications of new AI/ML tools and platforms before deployment to production environments.
  • Participate in AI threat intelligence activities and stay current with emerging AI security vulnerabilities and attack methodologies.
  • Conduct post-incident analysis for AI-related security events and develop preventive measures specific to AI threat vectors.
  • Review and validate AI model security properties, including robustness against adversarial inputs and data privacy protections.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in technology or applicable experience.
  • Related certifications (e.g., GSEC, CISSP, GIAC, AWS) preferred.
  • 5+ Years of experience within information security operations in multiple roles.
  • 3+ years of experience with security incident response and operations
  • 2+ years of experience with AI/ML security, including securing LLMs, generative AI systems, and machine learning pipelines
  • Extensive experience with, but not excluded to: TCP/IP, DNS, WAF, SEIM, and SOAR technologies.
  • Experience with PowerShell, python, and shell scripting
  • Knowledge of information security standards, principles, and practices required.
  • Knowledge of emerging AI security standards and frameworks (NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, industry- specific AI governance guidelines)
  • Experience with AI threat modeling, adversarial attack vectors, and AI-specific vulnerability assessments
  • Understanding of AI governance frameworks, model validation, and responsible AI principles
  • Familiarity with common AI/ML security concerns including prompt injection, model poisoning, data poisoning, and membership inference attacks
  • Ability to work independently and in a team environment.

raw.description:
Términos de Referencia

Consultoría para la identificación y categorización de fuentes de financiamiento y fondos concursables para bionegocios comunitarios de la Amazonía peruana

Sobre NESsT

NESsT es una organización internacional sin fines de lucro con oficinas en América Latina y Europa y un equipo de liderazgo global con sede en los EE. UU.

El objetivo principal de NESsT es transformar vidas invirtiendo en empresas sociales que brinden empleo digno a las comunidades que enfrentan aislamiento, discriminación y falta de empleo, de habilidades y educación deficiente mientras son ambientalmente sostenibles. Creemos que las empresas sociales locales están excepcionalmente calificadas para transformar estas comunidades. Estas cuentan con la confianza de las comunidades y han creado negocios alineados con sus mejores intereses. Puede encontrar más información de NESsT en:

Sobre NESsT Amazonia

NESsT Amazonia es un programa que apoya los medios de vida de comunidades indígenas y la conservación de los bosques amazónicos, a través de dos estrategias: aceleración e inversión de impacto. En la fase de aceleración el programa acompaña a los emprendimientos de la bioeconomía, a aumentar el potencial empresarial ofreciendo: capital pre-semilla, mentoría de negocios, acceso a redes empresariales y mercados, diseño de tecnología y pruebas de mercado. Además, el programa trabaja con emprendimientos indígenas de manera integrada, vinculándolos con cadenas de valor sostenibles, proveyendo: pequeños subsidios, servicios empresariales y gestión de impacto.

Contexto y Justificación

Uno de los principales cuellos de botella para la sostenibilidad y el escalamiento de los bionegocios comunitarios de la Amazonía peruana es el acceso a financiamiento adecuado. Si bien en el Perú existe una oferta creciente de fuentes de financiamiento (fondos públicos concursables, fondos ambientales y de conservación, cooperación internacional, inversión de impacto, banca y microfinanzas, y premios), esta oferta se encuentra fragmentada y es heterogénea en cuanto a montos, instrumentos, requisitos, plazos y criterios de elegibilidad.

A ello se suma una barrera estructural: buena parte de estos fondos exige condiciones (formalización, forma jurídica específica, contrapartida o cofinanciamiento, garantías, historial financiero y capacidad de reporte) que muchas organizaciones comunitarias no logran cumplir. Los criterios de solicitud y los requisitos de reporte, cuando son complejos, limitan un acceso equitativo e inclusivo al financiamiento por parte de las iniciativas de base amazónica.

En este marco, NESsT requiere contar con un instrumento de trabajo actualizado, categorizado y accionable que identifique las fuentes de financiamiento y fondos concursables a los que pueden postular los bionegocios comunitarios amazónicos, con sus requisitos, montos, instrumentos, plazos y rutas de acceso, y que analice las brechas que dificultan dicho acceso. Este instrumento busca orientar el trabajo del equipo de NESsT y apoyar a los bionegocios de su portafolio en la toma de decisiones sobre financiamiento.

Conceptos clave

El desarrollo de la consultoría deberá considerar los siguientes conceptos:

  • Socio-bioeconomía: mientras que bioeconomía responde a un concepto amplio y motivado por la innovación, la socio-bioeconomía se entiende como un modelo especializado adaptado para la preservación de las características ecológicas y culturales únicas de la Amazonía. Tiene como objetivo el balance ecológico, los medios de vida locales y la distribución equitativa; y combina conocimiento tradicional con la investigación científica.
  • Bionegocio comunitario o de base comunitaria: cooperativas o asociaciones productivas de la industria de alimentos sostenibles y saludables, agroforestería, sociobiodiversidad, pesca sostenible y gestión de bosques comunitaria, que contribuyen a la conservación de los bosques y sus biomas, promoviendo la resiliencia territorial y aportando a la mitigación y adaptación al cambio climático. Además, generan ingresos para las zonas de bosque y rurales como única alternativa ante el uso predatorio de los recursos naturales, mientras fortalecen a las comunidades y preservan la diversidad.
  • Eco y bio negocios:
    • Econegocios: Son iniciativas o emprendimientos económicos que buscan ser rentables mientras reducen la huella ecológica y promueven la conservación de los recursos naturales. Abarcan rubros como la agricultura sostenible, la economía circular, las energías limpias y el reciclaje.
    • Bionegocios: Son aquellos emprendimientos basados específicamente en el aprovechamiento rentable y el uso sostenible de los productos de la diversidad biológica (biodiversidad), asegurando su preservación en la producción de bienes y servicios. Cumplen con criterios estrictos de sostenibilidad ambiental, social y económica.
  • Fuente de financiamiento: toda entidad, programa o mecanismo público, privado, de cooperación o de inversión que provee recursos financieros a bionegocios, en cualquiera de sus modalidades.
  • Fondo concursable: mecanismo que asigna recursos mediante convocatorias competitivas con bases, criterios de elegibilidad y plazos definidos.
  • Instrumentos financieros: incluyen, entre otros, subvenciones no reembolsables, financiamiento parcialmente reembolsable, capital semilla, deuda/préstamos, inversión de capital o de impacto, garantías, esquemas de financiamiento combinado (blended finance) y premios o reconocimientos.

Objetivo general:

NESsT requiere contratar los servicios de un(a) consultor(a) para identificar, sistematizar y categorizar las fuentes de financiamiento y fondos concursables (nacionales e internacionales accesibles desde el Perú) a los que pueden postular los bionegocios comunitarios de la Amazonía peruana, generando una herramienta práctica y actualizable que consolide requisitos, montos, instrumentos, plazos y rutas de acceso, e incluya un análisis de brechas que oriente el trabajo de NESsT.

Objetivos

Específicos:

  • Construir, de manera conjunta con NESsT, un marco de categorización de las fuentes de financiamiento (dimensiones, variables y estructura de ficha).
  • Mapear e identificar no menos de 30 fuentes de financiamiento y fondos concursables aplicables a bionegocios comunitarios amazónicos, vigentes o recurrentes.
  • Elaborar una ficha estandarizada por cada fuente, con sus requisitos, montos, instrumento, elegibilidad, plazos, nivel de dificultad y datos de contacto.
  • Consolidar un calendario de convocatorias que permita anticipar las ventanas de postulación.
  • Analizar las brechas y barreras que dificultan el acceso de los bionegocios comunitarios y proponer rutas de acceso según su etapa de madurez y forma legal.
  • Transferir la herramienta y sus criterios de uso al equipo de NESsT.

Alcance de la consultoría:

Etapa 1: Diseño metodológico y mapeo de fuentes

  • Elaborar el plan de trabajo y acordar con NESsT el marco de categorización y la estructura de la herramienta (formato, campos y ficha por fuente).
  • Mapear e identificar las fuentes de financiamiento relevantes, cubriendo como mínimo las siguientes familias:
    • Fondos públicos concursables del Estado peruano (p. ej. PROCOMPITE, PROINNÓVATE, AGROIDEAS, PNIA/PROCIENCIA y programas sectoriales aplicables).
    • Fondos ambientales y de conservación Cooperación internacional y banca de desarrollo Inversión de impacto (fondos e inversionistas de impacto activos en la Amazonía peruana)
    • Banca, microfinanzas y garantías (entidades financieras y productos con potencial de uso por bionegocios comunitarios).
    • Premios, concursos y reconocimientos que otorguen recursos, visibilidad o acceso a redes.
  • Registrar la información en una base de datos estructurada (versión preliminar) e indicar las fuentes revisadas y los criterios de inclusión aplicados.

Se espera que la Etapa 1 se desarrolle en un plazo de 30 días calendario.

Etapa 2: Categorización, análisis de brechas y herramienta final

  • Completar la ficha estandarizada por cada fuente y categorizar el universo de fuentes según todas las dimensiones acordadas (ver dimensiones de categorización).
  • Elaborar el calendario de convocatorias del ciclo 2026–2027, 2027–2028 distinguiendo convocatorias abiertas, recurrentes e históricas.
  • Realizar un análisis de brechas: identificar los requisitos que sistemáticamente excluyen a los bionegocios comunitarios (formalización, forma jurídica, contrapartida, garantías, reportería) y sus implicancias.
  • Proponer rutas de acceso que orienten qué fuentes son más pertinentes según la etapa de madurez, la forma legal y la cadena de valor del bionegocio, y qué preparación previa requiere cada perfil.
  • Formular recomendaciones para el equipo de NESsT sobre cómo preparar y priorizar a los bionegocios del portafolio frente a estas oportunidades.
  • Entregar la herramienta final, una guía práctica de uso y realizar una sesión virtual de transferencia con el equipo de NESsT.

Se espera que la Etapa 2 se desarrolle en un plazo de 30 días calendario.

Dimensiones de categorización (mínimas)

La herramienta deberá permitir filtrar y clasificar cada fuente, como mínimo, por:

  • Tipo de instrumento financiero (no reembolsable, parcialmente reembolsable, capital semilla, deuda, inversión de capital/impacto, garantías/blended, premios).
  • Tipo de financiador (Estado peruano, fondos ambientales, cooperación internacional, inversión de impacto, banca/microfinanzas, filantropía, concursos privados).
  • Etapa de madurez del bionegocio (temprana, en crecimiento, consolidado/listo para inversión).
  • Sector o cadena de valor (agroforestería, productos forestales no maderables, alimentos sostenibles, pesca/piscicultura, ecoturismo, artesanía, entre otros).
  • Forma legal y elegibilidad (comunidad nativa, asociación, cooperativa, empresa comunal, persona jurídica con RUC).
  • Ámbito geográfico (regiones amazónicas específicas, nacional o internacional).
  • Monto y plazo (rango de financiamiento, contrapartida requerida y duración).
  • Nivel de dificultad/exigencia (documentación, garantías, cofinanciamiento y requisitos de reporte).

Para el desarrollo de estos productos se deberá tener en cuenta las siguientes consideraciones metodológicas:

  1. Se mantendrán sesiones de trabajo quincenales con el equipo de NESsT, donde se reportarán avances de cada uno de los productos específicos detallados en los puntos anteriores.
  2. La información deberá corresponder a fuentes vigentes al año 2026, priorizando convocatorias abiertas o de carácter recurrente; las convocatorias cerradas se incluirán como referencia histórica cuando aporten a anticipar próximas ediciones.
  3. El formato y los campos de la herramienta se acordarán con NESsT al inicio de la consultoría, priorizando su facilidad de uso y actualización por parte del equipo.
  4. El consultor/a podrá realizar recomendaciones y sugerencias para el desarrollo de estos productos siempre que se encuentren alineadas con el objetivo general de la consultoría.

Entregables:

Producto 1 - Etapa 1: Plan de Trabajo y marco metodológico

  • Plan de trabajo con actividades, cronograma y método de recolección de información.
  • Marco de categorización propuesto (dimensiones, variables y estructura de la ficha por fuente), validado con NESsT.

Plazo: 7 días calendario desde la fecha de firma de contrato. Pago: 15%

Producto 2 -Etapa 1: Base de datos / mapeo preliminar

  • Base de datos estructurada (Excel/herramienta navegable) con la identificación de no menos de 30 fuentes de financiamiento y fondos concursables aplicables a bionegocios comunitarios amazónicos.
  • Nota metodológica sobre fuentes revisadas y criterios de inclusión.

Plazo: 30 días calendario desde la fecha de firma de contrato. Pago: 25%

Producto 3 -Etapa 2: Herramienta categorizada, fichas y calendario

  • Herramienta final categorizada según todas las dimensiones del TdR.
  • Ficha completa por cada fuente (requisitos, montos, instrumento, elegibilidad, plazos, dificultad, contacto).
  • Calendario de convocatorias (abiertas, recurrentes e históricas) para el ciclo 2026–2027-2028.

Plazo: 50 días calendario desde la fecha de firma de contrato. Pago: 25%

Producto 4 - Etapa 2: Informe final, análisis de brechas y transferencia

  • Informe final con análisis de brechas/barreras de acceso y rutas de acceso por etapa de madurez y forma legal.
  • Guía práctica de uso de la herramienta y recomendaciones para el equipo de aceleración.
  • Sesión virtual de transferencia con el equipo de NESsT.

Plazo: 60 días calendario desde la fecha de firma de contrato. Pago: 35%

Perfil requerido:

  • Persona natural o jurídica. Profesional en economía, finanzas, administración, gestión empresarial, desarrollo sostenible, ciencias ambientales u otras áreas relacionadas. Deseable especialización en financiamiento para el desarrollo, bioeconomía, inversión de impacto o modelos de negocio comunitarios.
  • Se valorará positivamente que el/la consultor(a) cuente con un equipo de soporte que permita cubrir de manera integral las distintas fuentes de capital (fondos públicos, cooperación, inversión de impacto y banca).

Experiencia:

  • Experiencia demostrable de al menos 05 años en financiamiento para el desarrollo, fondos concursables, cooperación internacional y/o inversión de impacto, preferentemente vinculada a bioeconomía, desarrollo rural o conservación.
  • Conocimiento del ecosistema peruano de fondos y de sus requisitos, montos, instrumentos y plazos (fondos públicos, fondos ambientales, cooperación, banca e inversión de impacto).
  • Experiencia con modelos asociativos y organizaciones de base comunitaria o indígena de la Amazonía, y comprensión de sus condiciones de formalización y acceso a financiamiento.
  • Deseable haber elaborado mapeos, catálogos o estudios de fuentes de financiamiento o instrumentos similares.

Habilidades requeridas:

  • Capacidad de investigación, sistematización y análisis de información de múltiples fuentes.
  • Manejo avanzado de hojas de cálculo para el diseño de bases de datos y herramientas navegables y actualizables (Excel u otras).
  • Capacidad para diseñar productos accionables y de fácil uso por equipos operativos.
  • Aptitudes y disposición para trabajar en equipo y seguir instrucciones. Manejo de herramientas de cómputo de uso frecuente (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, correo electrónico e internet).
  • Manejo de herramientas y plataformas virtuales (Teams, Zoom, Meet, etc.).

Condiciones del contrato:

La consultoría se realizará de manera virtual. Eventualmente, el trabajo podría requerir alguna sesión de coordinación con el equipo de NESsT y/o con actores del ecosistema de financiamiento.

Duración:

La duración del contrato es de 2 meses (60 días calendario) desde la firma del contrato.

Los candidatos interesados deberán enviar su Hoja de vida, propuesta técnica y económica a través de la plataforma Bamboo hasta el 21 de setiembre de 2026.

raw.description:
Life at BMS

At RayzeBio, every day is an opportunity to ignite meaningful change. As a wholly-owned subsidiary of Bristol Myers Squibb, RayzeBio blends the nimble, pioneering spirit of an emergent biotech with the global expertise and resources of a leading innovator in oncology. Our mission is to develop transformative radiopharmaceutical therapies that offer new hope for patients living with cancer. Here, you’ll join a multidisciplinary team where your ideas are valued, your expertise is amplified, and collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. From day one, expect to make an immediate impact—on our science, on our teams, and most importantly, on patients. Learn more about RayzeBio:


The Specialist, RPT (Radiopharmaceutical Therapies) Production Planning and Scheduling will be responsible for facilitating and managing patient dose scheduling, consistent with RayzeBio corporate goals and program Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Good Clinical Practice (GCP)/International Conference on Harmonization (ICH) guidelines and other applicable federal (FDA) and state regulations. The role will require significant collaboration across internal and external functions to ensure on-time delivery of patient clinical materials. This role will also ensure that such operations activities are timely, efficient, and of the highest quality.

Job Responsibilities

  • Essential duties and responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

  • Create and maintain detailed study and site tracking for patient dosing schedules across all clinical programs

  • Manage and collaborate with internal and external functions for all aspects of the patient treatment schedule and dosing, including scheduling of study participant dosing, receipt and processing of drug product orders, liaison to the Clinical team on the status of drug product manufacturing, shipments and receipt

  • Provide support, address issues and facilitate operational continuity for the on-time delivery of patient clinical materials

  • Key liaison between the Clinical Site Operations, Supply Chain and Logistics, and Radiochemistry teams

  • Identify, mitigate, and manage closely potential risks associated with the on-time delivery of patient clinical materials and escalate accordingly to the Head of Clinical Site Operations and Head of Clinical Operations

  • Drive and implement continuous improvement in the planning and scheduling of patient clinical materials

  • Collaborate with IT Business Partners in support of modeling and scheduling simulation implementations

  • Maintain and update study-level clinical site procedures for RPT dose management

  • Performs other tasks as assigned

  • Leverage AI tools to enhance individual productivity and quality of work

  • Ability to travel approximately 10% of time

Education and Experience

  • Minimum 2 years of relevant experience with clinical operations, materials management and/or supply chain

  • BA/BS degree

Skills and Qualifications

  • Independent professional who proactively communicates frequently and effectively.

  • Organized and able to work on multiple projects with tight deadlines.

  • High energy level; positive attitude; works well under stress.

  • Hands-on, action-oriented, and able to implement effectively.

Physical Demands

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, reach with hands and arms, and talk or hear. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 15 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and distance vision.

Work Environment

The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.
