raw.description:
WELL Health Technologies is an innovative technology-enabled healthcare company whose overarching objective is to positively impact health outcomes by leveraging technology to empower and support healthcare practitioners and their patients.

WELL has built an innovative practitioner enablement platform that includes comprehensive end to end practice management tools inclusive of virtual care and digital patient engagement capabilities as well as Electronic Medical Records (EMR), Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) and data protection services. WELL Health Technologies, uses this platform to power healthcare practitioners both inside and outside of WELL Health Technologies’ own omni-channel patient services offerings.

WELL owns and operates Canada's largest network of outpatient medical clinics serving primary and specialized healthcare services and is the provider of a leading multi-national multi-disciplinary telehealth offering. WELL Health Technologies is publicly traded on the Toronto Stock Exchange under the symbol "WELL".

To learn more about the company, please visit: .

The opportunity

Reporting to the Senior Director, Business Transformation, we are hiring a Project Delivery Lead to lead the day-to-day delivery of ThinkWELL, WELL Health’s enterprise intelligence, analytics, and automation platform. ThinkWELL is a multi-year platform capability delivered through use cases that bring together business owners, data engineering, platform architecture, AI and application engineering, security and transformation partners. Each use case is a scoped delivery inside that enduring platform, and this role runs those deliveries end-to-end.

You will translate priorities into an integrated delivery plan, coordinate work across business, data, AI, and technology teams, and keep initiatives moving from build through business validation, launch, and value review. You will stay close to the work, challenge assumptions and unclear estimates, identify risks and dependencies early, and ensure teams have the decisions and plans they need to move forward. You will also coordinate releases, including UAT, launch readiness, training and communications, post go-live support, and value measurement.

This is a newly created, senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. It is fully remote and open to candidates anywhere in Canada.

Who you are

You are an experienced technology delivery professional who knows how to bring structure, clarity, and momentum to complex, cross-functional work. Your background may be in technical project delivery, technology program delivery, agile delivery, or a combination of these. You have worked in an evolving environment where the structure and processes were still taking shape, and you know how to turn broad priorities into practical plans that people can execute against.

You are comfortable working across business and technical teams, asking the questions that uncover dependencies, challenge assumptions, and clarify what needs to happen next. You have enough familiarity with data, analytics, AI, and application delivery to understand how the pieces connect and confidently engage technical partners without needing to be the technical decision-maker.

You bring sound judgment and a strong sense of accountability. You stay close to the details, look for evidence behind reported progress, and recognize when something is beginning to move off track. When challenges arise, you can bring the right people together, clarify the options, recommend a path forward, and escalate when a decision is needed.

Most importantly, you are comfortable influencing without direct authority. You build trust across teams, communicate clearly with technical and business stakeholders, and create the visibility and follow-through needed to move complex work from planning through release and into the hands of real users.

What's in it for you

Ownership and influence. ThinkWELL is WELL’s largest data and AI investment and the foundation for how the organization plans to use its clinical and operational data. You will have meaningful ownership over how work moves forward, influencing how priorities are sequenced, what evidence demonstrates completion, and when releases are ready to reach real users.

Enterprise-wide impact. You will work across business, data, AI, platform architecture, application engineering, security, and transformation teams to deliver use cases that turn ThinkWELL’s capabilities into practical outcomes. Your work will help move initiatives from ideas and priorities through execution, launch, and value measurement, giving you visibility into both the technology being built and how it is being used across the organization.

The opportunity to shape how delivery works. As WELL moves toward a Platform Operations model for ThinkWELL, you will help establish the structure, discipline, and ways of working that keep a complex, multi-year platform roadmap moving. You will have the opportunity to strengthen planning, release coordination, delivery visibility, and accountability while helping teams identify and resolve challenges before they become barriers to progress.

You will:

  • Drive integrated delivery planning. You will translate ThinkWELL priorities into a clear, integrated delivery plan and backlog across platform foundations and business use cases. You will maintain a rolling six-week view of owners, dependencies, target dates, and capacity assumptions, creating visibility into what is moving forward and what needs attention.
  • Keep delivery moving. You will run sprint planning, stand-ups, capacity and dependency reviews, demos, and retrospectives. You will keep monday.com current as the reliable source of delivery commitments and progress, ensuring teams have clarity on priorities, ownership, and next steps.
  • Create accountability. You will challenge unclear estimates, unsupported status updates, and stalled work, verifying completion against agreed acceptance evidence. When delivery moves off track, you will work with teams to establish a recovery plan or escalate early with a clear view of the impact, options, and recommended path forward.
  • Coordinate releases from validation through launch. You will bring business and technical owners together to prepare releases for real users, coordinating UAT and sign-off, launch cohorts, training and communications, cutover, support, and hypercare. You will help ensure each release is ready to launch and that early value can be measured.
  • Bring clarity to risks and decisions. You will maintain visibility into risks, issues, actions, dependencies, and decisions, with clear owners and timelines. You will identify potential roadblocks early and bring the right people together to resolve them before they affect broader delivery.
  • Provide clear delivery insight to leadership. You will prepare concise reporting and Steering Committee materials for the Senior Director, providing visibility into completed work, forecast dates and confidence, capacity, risks, decisions, launch readiness, and early evidence of value.

Here's what you bring:

  • The delivery experience. You have experience leading complex, cross-functional technology or project delivery, whether your background is in technical project delivery, technology programs, PMO, agile delivery, consulting, or a related area. You know how to turn broad outcomes into practical, sequenced plans with clear ownership, dependencies, acceptance criteria, capacity considerations, and release forecasts.
  • The technical fluency. You have a working understanding of data, analytics, AI, and application delivery and can confidently engage with technical teams about dependencies, estimates, risks, and readiness. You know how to ask thoughtful questions, test assumptions, and dig deeper when the details do not support the plan.
  • The project management skills. You have experience running delivery cadences, maintaining project plans and delivery tools, and managing risks, issues, dependencies, actions, and decisions. You can produce clear, evidence-based reporting that gives stakeholders an accurate view of progress, confidence, and what needs attention. Experience with monday.com, Jira, Azure DevOps, or a similar platform would be helpful.
  • The release experience. You understand what it takes to move work beyond development and into the hands of users. You have coordinated activities such as UAT, business sign-off, release readiness, launch, adoption, support, and value measurement in partnership with business and technical teams.
  • The ability to influence. You can create accountability and move work forward across teams that do not report to you. You communicate clearly, build trusted relationships with business and technical stakeholders, and know when to challenge, collaborate, recommend a path forward, or escalate to get the decisions delivery depends on.

Preferred qualifications

While not required, experience working with delivery management platforms such as monday.com, Jira, or Azure DevOps would be an asset. Exposure to data, analytics, AI, or enterprise platform delivery, particularly within Microsoft’s data and AI ecosystem, would help you ramp up quickly. Experience with Microsoft Fabric or similar data and analytics platforms is considered an asset. Experience working in a fast-growing or evolving organization where delivery structures and processes are still taking shape is also considered an asset.

Why join us?

Healthcare is our sector, and we know that for WELL to be a winning team, we must provide an open environment to prioritize health and wellbeing and multiple resources to discuss mental, physical, and psychological needs openly. From the CEO to the newest hire, everyone comes together as part of our culture of respect, openness, support, and communication. We unite to empower each other to be the best we can be.

We recognize that the best way to serve our diverse patient communities is by reflecting that diversity. With almost 65% of our team members identifying as female and 70% of our leadership identifying as a visible minority, we are proud of our diverse, equitable and inclusive organization.

Apply now

Interested in applying but worried you don't have it all? At WELL, we know not everyone gains their experience following a traditional path. If you share our values, want to make a difference in healthcare technology solutions, and meet 70% of the qualifications, we encourage you to apply. Express your interest here.

What you can expect from our interview process:

  • A 30-minute virtual interview with a Talent Advisor to discuss your interest in joining WELL Health and in the role, as well as your experience. The conversation will be recorded using BrightHire, an AI-powered video interview tool. More details will be shared when you are invited to interview.
  • A one-hour virtual interview with the Senior Director, Digital Transformation. You will work through a delivery scenario focused on how you would sequence the work, validate reported progress, and escalate a risk with options and a recommendation.
  • A final 30-minute virtual interview with the VP, Digital Transformation focused on WELL’s transformation agenda and the next phase of ThinkWELL.

Compensation

The salary range for this position is $110,000 - $140,000. The salary will be determined based on several factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, skills, and the needs of the organization. At WELL, we are committed to fair and equitable compensation and aim to provide a competitive salary that reflects the value and expertise of the successful candidate.

WELL is committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and accessible workplace. We welcome and celebrate the diversity of applicants and team members across ability, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, and lived experience. We strive to create an environment where differences are valued and contribute to our collective success – this is the WELL Way.

WELL has been independently certified as a Great Place to Work® by the Great Place to Work Institute® Canada. This recognition reflects our commitment to building a workplace culture rooted in trust, inclusivity, and employee well-being. It also aligns with our Healthy Place to Work pillar and the priorities outlined in our annual Sustainability Impact Report.

raw.description:
Since 1998, Businessolver has delivered market-changing benefits technology and services supported by an intrinsic responsiveness to client needs. The company creates client programs that maximize benefits program investment, minimize risk exposure, and engage employees with easy-to-use solutions and communication tools to assist them in making wise and cost-efficient benefits selections. Founded by HR professionals, Businessolver's unwavering service-oriented culture and secure SaaS platform provide measurable success in its mission to provide complete client delight.

**Please be aware of recruitment scams. Businessolver does not make job offers outside of our official hiring process or request payment or sensitive personal information. You will never receive an offer of employment without meeting a hiring authority and having a "live" and face-to-face conversation.**

Job Summary:

The Payroll Analystsupports accurate, timely, and compliant US payroll processing by reviewing payroll data, validating timekeeping and employee changes, resolving routinediscrepancies, supportingpayroll tax, audit, and multi-state termination pay requirements, and serving as backup support during absences or high-volume periods.

The Gig:

  • Assist with and/or process biweekly payroll accurately and on time in accordance with company policies and all applicable US federal, state, and local requirements.
  • Review timekeeping, earnings, deductions, direct deposit changes, employee updates, and tax elections.
  • Review terminations for applicable US state final pay timing, deduction, and documentation requirements.
  • Support payroll tax withholding, deduction, filing, and reporting activities, including US federal income tax, Social Security, Medicare, FUTA, SUTA, state income tax, local tax, and other statutory payroll requirements.
  • Research payroll discrepancies, tax variances, missing information, and timecard issues; resolve routine items and escalate as needed.
  • Respond to employee payroll inquiries related to pay, taxes, deductions, direct deposit, garnishments, and pay statements.
  • Maintain payroll records and support reporting, reconciliations, audit requests, compliance documentation, and internal controls.
  • Assist with monthly, quarterly and year-end payroll activities, including payroll reconciliations, taxable wage review, W-2 support, tax notice research, and audit documentation.
  • Review and prepare escalated off-cycle payroll runs, in a prompt manner as needed.
  • Serve as backup support for all things payroll during absences or high-volume periods.

What you need to make the cut:

  • 2-4 years of US payroll processing, payroll support required.
  • Associate’s Degree or higher-level degreed achievement in Accounting, Finance, Human Resources, or a related field preferred.
  • Working knowledge of US payroll concepts, including gross-to-net calculations, tax withholdings (including federal, state, local, Social Security, Medicare, FUTA, and SUTA), taxable wages, pre- and post-tax deductions, FLSA wage and hour requirements, terminations, garnishments, year-end reporting, and compliance requirements in a multi-state environment.
  • Familiarity with US multi-state payroll compliance, state and local tax withholding, unemployment tax, reciprocity rules, paid leave programs, and jurisdiction-specific payroll requirements.
  • Experience supporting monthly, quarterly, and year-end payroll processes, including US Federal W-2 preparation, Federal and State payroll tax reconciliations, taxable wage balancing, and audit documentation.
  • Strong analytical, reconciliation, reporting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience with payroll, HRIS, or timekeeping systems (Ceridian Dayforce, ADP, or Workday experience preferred).
  • Ability to handle confidential payroll information with professionalism, accuracy, and discretion.
  • Strong attention to detail with a high level of accuracy, accountability, and data integrity.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
  • Excellent communication and customer service skills, with the ability to explain payroll information clearly and professionally.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet strict payroll deadlines, and work effectively in a fast-paced environment, and align working hours schedule with Payroll Manager (8am-5pm US CT hours).

The pay range for this position is $20 to $31 per hour(pay to be determined by the applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, balanced against internal equity and competitive market based geographic ranges).

Other Compensation: If this position is full-time or part-time benefit eligible, you will receive a comprehensive benefits package which can be viewed here:

At Businessolver, we take our responsibility to protect our clients, employees, and company seriously and that begins with the hiring process.

Our approach is thoughtful and thorough. We’ve built a multi-layered screening process designed to identify top talent and ensure the integrity of every hire. This includes quickly filtering out individuals who may attempt to misrepresent themselves or act in bad faith.

We also partner with trusted, best-in-class providers to conduct background checks, verify identities, and confirm references. These steps aren’t just about compliance, they’re about ensuring fairness, safety, and trust for everyone involved.

Put simply: we will always confirm that you are who you say you are. It's just one of the many ways we uphold the standards that matter most, to you, to us, and to the people we serve.

With heart,
The Businessolver Recruiting Team

Businessolver is committed to maintaining an environment that protects client data. We train our employees to maintain leading class security practices and expect all employees to adhere to policy, procedures and controls.

(Applicable to all roles at an AVP, DIR, VP, Head Of or SVP and above level):

Serve as a security contact for the business unit. Responsible for driving adoption and compliance with information security and privacy practices. Serve as a liaison with the information security team on security and privacy matters.

Businessolver is an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer and is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and more. Acting as a key collaborator with the CLT, VP of FP&A, and business partners, this post leads core accounting functions, including financial operations, reporting, tax, treasury, compliance, and internal control, to ensure financial operations support strategic goals through best-in-class systems, process innovation, and a high-performance team culture.

Key Responsibilities and Outputs:

  • Provides strategic leadership and visionary direction to elevate the Global Accounting function into a forward-thinking, value-add center of excellence.
  • Architects organizational design and capacity models, ensuring agile, scalable finance capability to drive long-term business growth while serving as an executive mentor and escalation lead.
  • Cultivates high-performing, empowered teams across all core accounting and operational pillars through continuous capability building.
  • Drives end-to-end global accounting strategy and execution across Statutory Reporting, Audit, Payroll, Treasury, Compliance, and Tax operations.
  • Partners with the CLT to establish robust corporate governance frameworks, deploying industry best practices to streamline global controls.
  • Champions global compliance strategy, standardizing SOPs, policies, and internal controls to mitigate operational risk across diverse markets.
  • Directs risk management audits in close collaboration with the Advance Risk Advisory group to proactively address vulnerability areas.
  • Oversees external and internal financial audit engagements with KPMG and Advance Accounting to maintain clean audit outcomes and reporting integrity.
  • Enforces dynamic compliance frameworks, ensuring seamless alignment with all global financial regulations.
  • Delivers timely, data-informed financial insights and board-level reporting to support strategic decisions by Advance Finance, executive leadership, and the Board.
  • Innovates and optimizes internal control frameworks, safeguarding organizational assets while leveraging automation and modern finance tools.
  • Spearheads M&A integration across regional finance ops, banking networks, and enterprise system architectures for seamless scaling.
  • Leads continuous improvement initiatives that modernize processes, leveraging data and employee feedback to champion a modern, high-engagement culture.
  • Drives operational rigor and team compliance across global workflows and standard operating procedures.
  • Fosters an agile performance management framework, utilizing real-time feedback, recognition, and targeted coaching to drive results.
  • Accelerates individual and collective talent development through structured mentorship and continuous learning pathways.
  • Aligns team goals with enterprise-wide strategy using transparent communication strategies that promote cross-functional alignment and employee engagement.
  • Optimizes resource allocation and operational efficiency through workload balancing and strategic capacity planning.
  • Manages global departmental budgets efficiently, maximizing ROI on finance investments and technology tools.
  • Serves as a trusted strategic thought partner to the CFO, steering key transformational initiatives and enterprise financial strategy.
  • Actively advances executive leadership capabilities through continuous personal and professional development.
  • Evaluates and implements AI tools and emerging technologies to drive operational efficiencies, automation, and continuous innovation across global finance processes.

Essential:

  • Strategic Finance Vision & Digital Transformation: Proven track record in spearheading finance system modernization, automation, and agile operational workflows to support long-term enterprise growth.
  • Progressive Executive Leadership: 10+ years of progressive finance leadership, cultivating high-performing, agile global teams with specific experience navigating US business operations.
  • Foundational Credentials: Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting or Finance (or equivalent) paired with CPA, Chartered Accountant, or equivalent professional credential.
  • Technical Mastery: Deep expertise in US/Global GAAP, ASC revenue recognition across multi-jurisdiction environments.
  • Global Tax & Treasury Strategy: Strong working knowledge of US domestic and international tax accounting principles to drive effective risk mitigation.
  • Agile Execution: Demonstrated capacity to prioritize and deliver high-impact outcomes across complex, multi-threaded priorities under tight timelines.
  • Influential Communication: Ability to translate complex financial concepts into actionable business stories for executive leaders (CLT) and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Sharp business acumen to partner seamlessly with operational leaders, influencing strategic choices and driving business value.
  • Strategic Agility: Ability to connect big-picture strategy with tactical execution, leveraging data insights to navigate change effectively.
  • Distributed Team Leadership: Demonstrated success leading, mentoring, and inspiring remote and global distributed finance teams.

Desirable:

  • Tech & SaaS Sector Acumen: Deep industry familiarity with technology, SaaS, software, or information services business models.

Personal Attributes:

  • Strategic Catalyst & Enterprise Influencer: Self-driven leader with executive gravitas, adept at translating complex vision into enterprise alignment and action.
  • Agile Change Leader: Thrives in fast-paced, evolving global environments, driving continuous improvement and modernizing financial operations with resilience and purpose.
  • High-EQ Collaborator & Communicator: Approachable and empathetic leader with high emotional intelligence and persuasive communication skills that build trust across diverse cross-functional teams.
  • Tenacious & Results-Oriented Execution: Demonstrates high operational rigor, personal organization, and steady focus to overcome complex challenges and deliver high-impact results.

Total Rewards @ Turnitin

Beyond compensation, you’ll experience the intrinsic rewards of unleashing your potential and making a positive impact on global education. You’ll also thrive in a culture free of politics, surrounded by humble, inclusive, and collaborative teammates.

Seeing Beyond the Job Ad

If you’re willing to learn and unleash your potential alongside us, join our team!

When you join Turnitin, you'll be welcomed into a company that is a recognized innovator in global education. For over 25 years, Turnitin has partnered with educators and institutions to develop learning integrity solutions that recognize the enduring value of critical thinking in a rapidly changing world. Over 16,000 academic institutions, publishers, and corporations use our services in more than 185 countries around the world: Turnitin Feedback Studio, Clarity, Originality, Gradescope, ExamSoft, Similarity, and iThenticate. Protecting the value of an authentic education is at the heart of who we are.

Experience a remote-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in a way that best suits you, supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well-being. Job Description

Join us as Start-up Team Manager - To manage complex site operations, ensure compliance with regulatory standards, support site recruitment and training efforts, and facilitate smooth collaboration between trial sites and internal teams to drive the success of clinical studies.

What You’ll Do:

  • Collaborate with multiple team members in a matrix environment for the effective delivery of site activation within the assigned projects.
    • May oversee site activation for assigned projects according to timelines and quality standard.
    • Assist with coordination of the flow of information between PPD teams, clients, or functional departments involved in site activation.

    • Work within the team to establish appropriate controls to ensure that project resources and expenses are aligned with budgets with accountability to Global
    Project Management.

    country teams in a matrix environment and manages the assigned scope of work against timelines, costs, and quality.
    • Participating in a functional area leads to identifying and evaluating fundamental issues pertaining to successful site activation, interpreting data on complex issues,
    make good business decisions and ensure solutions are implemented.
    • Develop customer relationships in alignment with assigned projects.

    Education and Experience:
    • Bachelor's degree or equivalent and relevant formal academic / vocational qualification
    • Previous experience to provide the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job (comparable to 5+ years’).
    • In some cases, an equivalency, consisting of a combination of appropriate education, training and/or directly related experience, will be considered sufficient for an individual to meet the requirements of the role.

    Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:
    • Able to work well and efficiently with cross-functional teams
    • Consistently demonstrates knowledge of the key principles of cross functional project management
    • Demonstrated organizational and multitasking skills
    • Demonstrated attention to detail
    • Ability to identify and remedy risks related to contractual deliverables and provides appropriate solutions
    • Demonstrates sound understanding of cross-cultural awareness and can adapt appropriately
    • Comprehensive understanding and appreciation of clinical research/ development, including medical and therapeutic areas, phases and medical terminology
    • Demonstrates ability to lead, liaise and coordinate cross-functional project teams
    • Comprehensive knowledge/understanding of clinical development guidelines and Directives

    Working Conditions and Environment:
    • Work is performed in an office/ laboratory and/or a clinical environment.
    • Exposure to biological fluids with potential exposure to infectious organisms.
    • Exposure to electrical office equipment.
    • Personal protective equipment is required such as protective eyewear, garments and gloves.
    • Occasional travel, up to 20% of the time, includes travel to site locations both domestic and international. May include travel time outside of normal business hours and/or on weekends.

    Physical Requirements:
    • Ability to work in an upright and /or stationary position for 6-8 hours per day.
    • Repetitive hand movement of both hands with the ability to make fast, simple, repeated movements of the fingers, hands, and wrists.
    • Frequent mobility required.
    • Occasional crouching, stooping, with frequent bending and twisting of upper body and neck.
    • Light to moderate lifting and carrying (or otherwise moves) objects including luggage and laptop computer with a maximum lift of 15-20 lbs.
    • Ability to access and use a variety of computer software developed both in-house and off-the-shelf.
    • Ability to communicate information and ideas so others will understand; with the ability to listen to and understand information and ideas presented through spoken words and sentences.
    • Frequently interacts with others to obtain or relate information to diverse groups.
    • Performs a wide range of variable tasks as dictated by variable demands and changing conditions with little predictability as to the occurrence. Ability to perform under stress. Ability to multi-task.
    • Regular and consistent attendance.

You’ll work in an environment where collaboration and development are part of the everyday experience – and where your contributions truly make a difference.

We're looking for bilingual speakers to record short, casual voice clips where they naturally mix English with Spanish - the way they'd actually talk in real life. No script, no scenarios, just you talking about your day, your opinions, whatever comes naturally.

Do you switch between English and Spanish mid-sentence without even thinking about it? Rant about your day, discuss your favorite show, think out loud with different languages - say it exactly how you'd say it to a friend. What if you could get paid just for recording it?

Through the integration of ERP, HCM and/or CRM solutions, Net at Work offers unique, industry-specific solutions and operation platforms that enable companies to compete more effectively in today’s digital economy. For more information, visit www.netatwork.com.

About this Position

The Systems Engineer (SE) is responsible for implementation of networking technologies for clients and supporting clients and their networks. The SE configures the equipment and software to meet client business needs and documents the solution for ongoing support.

This position will provide second level technical support and main level ticket tracking in an efficient and effective manner. The SE can also function as part of an implementation team on larger projects, or individual provides the services on support visits or smaller project needs.

The primary role focus is to decrease time to resolution and increase revenue by acting as a project resource and an escalated resource for service tickets and Service Desk escalations.

Job Responsibilities

  • Coordinate and/or perform remote fixes at the desktop, server and networking level, including installing and upgrading software, implementing file backups, and configuring systems and applications.
  • Second level escalations on the service desk team; resolve level 2 issues in Mac OS and Windows environments.
  • De-escalate client situations related to outages, communications, and travel onsite where necessary.

    • Current MCSE/MCSA or similar level Microsoft Certifications .

Customer Requirements

Since launching in 2019, Starface has turned the historically negative experience of having acne into a more joyful, relatable one with a category of its own: expressive and effective products that make people feel good. With a full suite of hydrocolloid pimple patches in bright colors and a roster of limited-edition collaborations— from fan-favorite characters like Hello Kitty and Snoopy to fashion brands like Marc Jacob’s Heaven—it’s easy to see why Starface users say they look forward to getting breakouts. Featuring award-winning formulas and ultra-cute packaging, Starface products are designed to make you smile every time you use them.

your impact @ starface

Starface is seeking a Controller to lead and strengthen our accounting function as we enter our next stage of growth. In this role, you’ll report directly to our SVP, Head of Finance, oversee the accounting team, and own the function across close, reporting, audits, controls, systems, external partnerships, and team development.

You’ll inherit strong building blocks, talented partners, and meaningful opportunities to improve how the work gets done. Your mandate will be to bring critical workstreams current, create more reliable and scalable processes, and build a clear roadmap for the accounting organization Starface needs as we continue to grow.

The right person for this role is an experienced, hands-on accounting leader who has successfully stepped into complex or evolving environments, created order from ambiguity, and led teams through periods of growth or transformation. You’re technically strong, comfortable rolling up your sleeves, and confident partnering with executives, auditors, advisors, and investors.

At Starface, we find fun, lead with care, aim high, stay curious, and move forward. We welcome an attitude of exploration into the bold and creative in all that we do (even accounting, if applicable and compliant!). If you are an adaptable accounting leader who sees a complicated problem and immediately starts mapping the way forward, and all of this resonates with you so far, please keep reading!

we’ll count on you to

  • Lead the full accounting function, including the monthly close, general ledger, reconciliations, financial reporting, consolidation, accounts payable, accounts receivable, inventory accounting, and technical accounting.
  • Quickly assess the current state of the function, team, systems, open workstreams, and key risks, while identifying immediate opportunities to improve accuracy, accountability, and efficiency.
  • Bring outstanding audits, covenant reporting, reconciliations, tax-related workstreams, and other critical external deliverables fully current.
  • Establish a reliable and well-controlled close process, with clear timelines, ownership, documentation, and reporting standards.
  • Lead relationships with external auditors, accountants, tax advisors, and other partners, serving as Starface’s primary accounting subject-matter expert and point of accountability.

raw.description:
Want to join a team that's revolutionizing the field of AI with data center scale solutions? We are seeking a highly technical Solution Architect to serve as a forward-deployed technical liaison between NVIDIA’s Partner Network (NPN), NVIDIA’s internal teams, and enterprise customers. In this role, your focus will be to support customers and partners in the areas of planning, development, and deployment of large-scale AI factories based on NVIDIA's reference designs. Acting as a trusted advisor embedded with customer and partner teams, you will bridge solution development, implementation enablement, and post-deployment optimization to accelerate AI factory adoption!

What you will be doing:

  • AI Factory deployment planning: Collaborate with NVIDIA product, engineering and partners teams to understand NVIDIA’s reference architecture for AI Factory infrastructure. Support customers and partners in quickly implementing this architecture into sophisticated and reliable data center builds.

  • Building process capabilities: Collaborate across the org to build processes, partner relationships and workflows to deliver and deploy large AI factories at speed of light (SOL).

  • Build and oversight: Review and appraise customers' and partners' installation plans, including all point-to-point cabling assignments, hardware compatibility verification, and BOM reviews, verifying their compliance with NVIDIA reference architecture. Delivering mentorship, expertise and suggestions to optimize performance, scalability, and cost-effectiveness.

  • Review the operational efficiency, reliability, and readiness of data center and hardware elements before initiating AI/HPC cluster deployments. Design and apply detailed audit plans and conduct pre-deployment audits to detect possible problems, risks, and improvement areas.

  • Quality Assurance: Implement and make quality assurance processes to ensure that deployments meet established specifications and performance benchmarks.

  • Continuous Improvement: Develop partner-facing playbooks, deployment guides, and guideline documentation specific to AI factory implementations using NVIDIA reference builds.

  • Technical Enablement and Knowledge Transfer: Provide hands-on mentorship to partners on deploying NVIDIA AI factory; conduct workshops and develop runbooks to build partners expertise.

  • Internal Liaison & Feedback Loop: Serve as the representative of the customer/partner within NVIDIA, conveying field insights, deployment challenges, and optimization opportunities to NVIDIA internal and product engineering teams to support the seamless integration of data center infrastructure solutions.

What we need to see:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Engineering, or a related field. Preferred qualifications include an advanced degree or equivalent experience, relevant certifications, or comparable experience.

  • We need an expert professional with a background in multiple aspects of infrastructure delivery, preferably of hyperscale data centers. The ideal candidate will have at least 8+ years of experience, preferably in high-density AI/HPC data centers.

  • Proven technical expertise in data center systems and operations—power distribution, liquid cooling, rack/server chassis, and cabling.

  • Effective communication at both on-the-ground implementation as well as executive levels, internally and with customers and partners.

  • Coordination & Time Management – proficient at planning and scheduling tasks related to the job to accomplish objectives within or ahead of designated time frames.

  • Able to travel (25%).

Way to Stand out from the crowd:

  • Experience in hyperscale data center rollout, operational procedures, safety, and security protocols.

  • Strong grasp of the entire data center Infrastructure stack.

  • Strong channel sales and services knowledge and partner co-selling experience

  • Ability to learn quickly and tackle sophisticated problems.

This role embodies the forward-deployed engineer approach: you will spend significant time embedded with customer and partner technical teams. You will move fluidly between field deployments and internal NVIDIA teamwork. Your success is measured by the successful deployment and optimization of AI factories that enable customers and partners to achieve their AI ambitions. You will also provide critical feedback to refine NVIDIA’s reference architectures and partner enablement programs!

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 184,000 USD - 287,500 USD for Level 4, and 224,000 USD - 356,500 USD for Level 5.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until September 12, 2026.

Summary:

We are seeking an experienced OTC Specialist to support critical master data, pricing, and contract management activities within the Order-to-Cash (OTC) process.

The ideal candidate has hands-on SAP S/4HANA experience, particularly in Material Master and Master Data Management, along with experience supporting pricing structures, customer contracts, Salesforce CPQ, and SAP data migration or mass upload activities.

This role requires a highly analytical professional who can maintain data integrity, support pricing and contract administration, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure accurate execution of commercial agreements and master data processes.

Responsibilities

SAP Master Data Management

  • Create, maintain, and update Material Master records within SAP S/4HANA.
  • Maintain Customer, Pricing, and Contract Master Data.
  • Configure and maintain alternative Units of Measure (UOM), material numbers, and master data attributes.
  • Perform master data validation and reconciliation to ensure data accuracy and integrity.
  • Execute mass uploads and updates using SAP migration tools, templates, or approved upload utilities.
  • Support SAP S/4HANA migration, data conversion, and data cleansing activities.

Pricing Management

  • Maintain pricing structures, pricing conditions, price books, and rate tables within SAP S/4HANA and Salesforce CPQ.
  • Configure pricing conditions based on approved commercial agreements.
  • Analyze pricing data to ensure consistency, compliance, and accuracy.
  • Support implementation of pricing updates, discounts, and customer-specific pricing arrangements.
  • Utilize SAP pricing transactions such as VK12, VA43, VA03, ZCAUR, or equivalent pricing tools.

Contract Management

  • Review, interpret, validate, and maintain customer contracts and commercial agreements.
  • Ensure contract terms are accurately translated into operational processes and enterprise systems.
  • Support contract amendments, renewals, pricing changes, and customer updates.
  • Ensure contract and pricing data remain synchronized across SAP and Salesforce.

Salesforce CPQ & CRM Administration

  • Maintain pricing, contract, and customer information within Salesforce CPQ.
  • Support quote validation, pricing approvals, contract amendments, and order processing.
  • Ensure data consistency between Salesforce and SAP S/4HANA.
  • Support CPQ configuration updates related to pricing and commercial agreements.

Data Analysis & Reporting

  • Analyze pricing, contract, material master, and OTC-related data using Microsoft Excel.
  • Utilize advanced Excel functions including:
  • VLOOKUP
  • XLOOKUP
  • PivotTables
  • Macros
  • Build reports and dashboards using Power BI.
  • Identify data quality issues and recommend corrective actions.
  • Drive automation and process standardization opportunities.

Process Ownership

  • Own assigned master data, pricing, and contract processes from initiation through completion.
  • Ensure high-quality deliverables with minimal supervision.
  • Proactively identify process gaps and recommend improvements.
  • Maintain compliance with internal controls, audit requirements, and data governance standards.

Qualifications

Mandatory

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Finance, Supply Chain, or a related discipline.
  • Hands-on SAP experience, preferably SAP S/4HANA.
  • Experience creating and maintaining Material Master and/or Master Data within SAP.
  • Experience performing mass uploads, data migration, or master data conversion activities in SAP.
  • Experience supporting pricing structures, pricing conditions, price books, rate tables, or pricing master data.
  • Experience reviewing, maintaining, or supporting customer contracts and commercial agreements.
  • Experience using Salesforce, preferably Salesforce CPQ.
  • Strong understanding of Order-to-Cash (OTC) processes.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including VLOOKUP, XLOOKUP, PivotTables, and Macros.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and data validation skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • SAP SD functional experience.
  • SAP S/4HANA implementation or migration experience.
  • Experience with SAP transactions such as:
  • VK12
  • VA03
  • VA43
  • ZCAUR
  • Experience with LSMW, Migration Cockpit, or other SAP data migration tools.
  • Experience with Salesforce CPQ administration.
  • Experience using Power BI for reporting and dashboard development.
  • Knowledge of SAP Sales & Distribution (SD).
  • Experience working within global shared services or multinational environments.

Preferred Technical Skills

SAP

  • SAP S/4HANA
  • SAP SD
  • Material Master
  • Master Data
  • Pricing Conditions
  • Data Migration
  • LSMW
  • Migration Cockpit
  • Customer Master
  • Contract Master

Salesforce

  • Salesforce
  • Salesforce CPQ
  • Quote-to-Cash
  • Order Management

Data & Reporting

  • Advanced Excel
  • Power BI
  • Data Validation
  • Data Reconciliation
  • Root Cause Analysis

Job Title:

Group Manager, Software Engineering

Job Description

Technical Products and Services (TPS):

We're Concentrix. The intelligent transformation partner. Solution-focused. Tech-powered. Intelligence-fueled.

The global technology and services leader that powers the world’s best brands, today and into the future. We’re solution-focused, tech-powered, intelligence-fueled. With unique data and insights, deep industry expertise, and advanced technology solutions, we’re the intelligent transformation partner that powers a world that works, helping companies become refreshingly simple to work, interact, and transact with. We shape new game-changing careers in over 70 countries, attracting the best talent.

The Concentrix Technical Products and Services team is the driving force behind Concentrix’s transformation, data, and technology services. We integrate world-class digital engineering, creativity, and a deep understanding of human behavior to find and unlock value through tech-powered and intelligence-fueled experiences. We combine human-centered design, powerful data, and strong tech to accelerate transformation at scale. You will be surrounded by the best in the world providing market leading technology and insights to modernize and simplify the customer experience. Within our professional services team, you will deliver strategic consulting, design, advisory services, market research, and contact center analytics that deliver insights to improve outcomes and value for our clients. Hence achieving our vision.

Our game-changers around the world have devoted their careers to ensuring every relationship is exceptional. And we’re proud to be recognized with awards such as "World's Best Workplaces," “Best Companies for Career Growth,” and “Best Company Culture,” year after year.

Join us and be part of this journey towards greater opportunities and brighter futures.

Job Summary

We are looking for a dynamic Group Manager of Software Engineering to lead engineering teams for our Generative AI product group. As a Group Manager in Software Engineering at Concentrix, you will lead dynamic teams of software engineers. Your role will be pivotal in driving the development and implementation of cutting-edge Generative AI software solutions while leading our cross-functional teams of backend, frontend, and QA engineers.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the charge in achieving technical excellence across the development stack, ensuring the architectural integrity and innovation of our platform.

  • Mentor and inspire high-performing teams, cultivating a culture of excellence, ownership, and an agile mindset. Empower team members to consistently achieve meaningful results and add business value.

  • Establish clear goals and growth pathways, promoting a culture of accountability and innovation within the team.

  • Oversee the complete development lifecycle of key features and enhancements, from ideation to deployment, ensuring timely and quality delivery.

  • Enhance collaboration by aligning priorities and optimizing resource allocation to consistently meet project milestones.

  • Proactively manage project execution by monitoring progress, identifying risks or bottlenecks early, and implementing strategic solutions to maintain team momentum.

  • Promote the use of emerging AI tools to boost productivity in development and QA processes.

  • Drive cross-functional synergy by facilitating effective collaboration among engineers, DevOps, and key stakeholders for seamless integration and rapid product delivery.

  • Act as a trusted liaison, bridging the gap between technical complexities and business objectives, translating them into actionable insights for all teams.

  • Foster a culture of openness and empowerment through knowledge sharing, transparent communication, and shared accountability.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

  • Over 10 years of experience as a senior engineering manager leading frontend, backend, and QA engineering teams.

  • Proficient in both JavaScript and TypeScript.

  • Expertise in web technologies such as React, Next.js, Node.js, and NestJS.

  • Experience with RDBMS and NoSQL databases, including Postgres, MongoDB, and DynamoDB.

  • Proficient in Design Principles, including Object Oriented Programming and Functional Programming.

  • Understanding of the value of a data-centric approach to software engineering and the benefits of a well-architected data ecosystem.

  • Solid knowledge of AWS and Azure services and infrastructure, specifically for web applications.

  • Experience in performance optimization, security best practices, and RESTful API design and development.

  • Proficient in Agile methodologies and project management tools like Jira.

  • Experience with automated code deployment pipelines using CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions.

  • Strong leadership and people management skills, with a proven track record of building and nurturing high-performing teams.

  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills with a focus on achieving results and delivering exceptional user experiences.

  • Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to interact with stakeholders at all levels.

  • Experience in startup environments is a plus.

  • Experience with e-commerce or retail companies is highly beneficial.

  • Familiarity with modern AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or ChatGPT for accelerating code generation, documentation, and refactoring.

  • Experience using AI-powered debugging and testing tools for faster issue resolution.

  • Comfortable with prompt engineering practices to enhance product and team efficiency in interactions with AI assistants and agents.

Job Summary

The RN Regional Manager is responsible for overseeing and supporting infusion nursing services within a designated region. This clinical leadership role includes direct supervision and support of field infusion nurses, coordination with partner agencies, and oversight of clinical documentation to ensure the delivery of high-quality, patient-centered care. The Regional Manager plays a critical role in onboarding, training, and mentoring nursing staff while upholding clinical standards and ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements. This position serves as a key clinical resource and works in close collaboration with the Regional Director.

Location: Remote

Schedule: Monday to Friday, 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM PST

Duties and Responsibilities

Clinical Oversight & Quality Assurance

  • Review and approve infusion nursing documentation for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with clinical and regulatory standards.
  • Monitor adherence to infusion therapy protocols and infection control practices.
  • Appropriately escalate complex clinical concerns or patient cases to the Regional Director.
  • Promote high-quality patient outcomes through routine audits, performance evaluations, and constructive feedback.

Nurse Management & Leadership

  • Supervise, mentor, and support field infusion nurses across the assigned region.
  • Conduct regular performance reviews and implement improvement plans when necessary.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, clinical excellence, and continuous professional growth.
  • Ensure adequate nurse staffing and coordinate schedules with administrative teams to meet operational needs.

Onboarding & Training

  • Lead onboarding for new infusion nurses, ensuring thorough and effective integration into the team.
  • Develop and deliver training programs focused on infusion best practices, clinical documentation, and safety protocols.
  • Provide ongoing education and professional development opportunities to maintain staff competency.

Communication & Coordination

  • Act as the primary liaison between field nurses, internal departments, and external partner agencies.
  • Ensure clear, timely communication among all stakeholders to support seamless, coordinated care.
  • Participate in interdisciplinary meetings, case conferences, and strategic planning sessions.
  • Demonstrate adaptability by stepping in to assist with responsibilities beyond standard duties when needed, ensuring continuity of care and operational efficiency.
  • Maintain open, proactive communication with nursing staff, leadership, and the Regional Director to address workload distribution, staffing concerns, and emerging needs, fostering a culture of transparency and collaboration.

Compliance & Reporting

  • Ensure that nursing services are provided in full compliance with state and federal regulations, accreditation standards, and internal policies.
  • Support internal and external audits, regulatory surveys, and continuous quality improvement initiatives.
  • Stay current with best practices in infusion therapy and home health nursing.
  • Promptly identify and escalate significant clinical, staffing, or operational issues to the Regional Director, while exercising sound judgment to resolve routine matters independently.

Required Qualifications

  • Active, unrestricted Multistate RN license in good standing.
  • Minimum of 5 years of clinical nursing experience, including at least 2 years in infusion therapy.
  • At least 2 years of experience in a nursing leadership, supervisory, or management role.
  • Experience working with home health agencies or in home infusion care settings.
  • Strong knowledge of home infusion therapy, patient care standards, and clinical documentation best practices.
  • Proficiency with EMR systems and Google Workspace tools.
  • Excellent communication, leadership, and organizational abilities.
  • Willingness and ability to travel within the assigned region as needed.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) is preferred.
  • Master’s degree or certification in nursing leadership or administration is a plus.
  • Active California RN license in good standing.
  • CRNI® (Certified Registered Nurse Infusion) and/or IgCN® (Immunoglobulin Certified Nurse) certification is preferred.

Senior Data Scientist | Drive Innovation Through Data | Remote Working Available

Level: Mid-Level
Experience: Minimum 2 years' experience in a Data Scientist or similar analytical role

About the Role

We're partnering with an organisation delivering impactful healthcare programmes and are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to help shape data-driven decision-making across the business.

This is an exciting opportunity for a data professional who enjoys transforming complex datasets into meaningful insights that drive real-world outcomes. You'll work with key stakeholders across programmes and leadership teams, providing analytical expertise that supports strategic decisions and improves service delivery.

As a member of the team, you'll ensure high-quality analytical delivery while helping to develop analytical capability and best practices across the organisation.

What You’ll Be Doing

In this role, you'll be responsible for:

  • Leading complex data analysis to generate actionable insights and support strategic decision-making
  • Applying advanced statistical techniques including hypothesis testing, regression analysis, and time-series modelling
  • Developing and optimising advanced SQL queries to analyse large and complex datasets
  • Using Python for data wrangling, analysis, modelling, and automation
  • Identifying trends, risks, and opportunities through the analysis of healthcare and operational data
  • Creating compelling visualisations and reports to communicate findings to a range of audiences
  • Working closely with stakeholders to understand business challenges and translate them into analytical solutions
  • Influencing decision-making through evidence-based recommendations and strategic insight
  • Leading analytical projects and ensuring delivery against agreed objectives and timelines
  • Supporting and mentoring colleagues to encourage continuous learning and development
  • Ensuring analytical outputs meet quality assurance and governance standards
  • Driving continuous improvement in analytical methodologies, tools, and best practices

Requirements

Essential Requirements

To be successful in this role, you'll need:

  • A minimum of 2 years' experience working as a Data Scientist or in a similar analytics-focused role
  • Strong expertise in advanced analytics and statistical techniques
  • Advanced SQL development skills
  • Advanced Python skills, including data wrangling and analysis
  • Experience analysing and interpreting complex datasets
  • Excellent problem-solving and critical thinking skills
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication abilities
  • Experience presenting complex findings in a clear and engaging way
  • Experience leading projects, workstreams, or analytical initiatives
  • Eligibility to work in the UK

Desirable (Not Required)

These aren't essential, but they're a bonus:

  • Experience using data visualisation tools such as Power BI
  • Understanding of data governance, quality assurance, and analytical best practice frameworks
  • Experience delivering insights within complex programme or transformation environments

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Competitive Salary: With a range of benefits, complemented by ongoing training, mentorship, and career progression opportunities within a collaborative team environment.
  • Career growth: Work on real client projects and build a strong foundation for your future.
  • Collaborative culture: Be part of a team that values learning and innovation.
  • Upskilling opportunities: Access to training programs to boost your technical skills.
  • Dedicated support: A manager onsite and ongoing mentoring from _nology.

Apply Today!

If you’re ready to take the next step in your career and grow with the support of _nology and a dedicated team, submit your application now. We look forward to hearing from you!

raw.title: Grant Manager
raw.excerpt: ACCEL Schools is seeking a hands-on Grant Manager to own the full lifecycle of federal, state, and local grants supporting four West Virginia schools.
raw.description:
ACCEL Schools is seeking a hands-on Grant Manager to own the full lifecycle of federal, state, and local grants supporting four West Virginia schools. This position will be responsible for grant administration from pre-award planning and application support through award setup, budgeting, accounting, compliance, reporting, reimbursement, monitoring, and closeout. The role requires a strong understanding of how grant requirements connect to the general ledger and how grant activity affects revenue, expenses, payroll, reimbursements, and month-end accounting.

This is a working-manager position. The Grant Manager will initially perform detailed day-to-day grant and financial management activities for the West Virginia portfolio. As ACCEL Schools grows, the portfolio is expected to expand to additional schools and states. The Grant Manager will help establish scalable, standardized processes that can support a growing multi-state grant portfolio.

Eligibility: Open to residents of West Virginia

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the full grant lifecycle for federal, state, and local grants, including grant identification and pre-award support, application coordination, award review and setup, budgeting, post-award administration, financial management, compliance, reporting, reimbursement, monitoring, and closeout.
  • Manage the grant portfolio for four West Virginia schools, with responsibility expected to expand to additional schools and states as the organization grows.
  • Review grant award documents, terms, conditions, approved budgets, funding restrictions, reporting requirements, and deadlines; translate requirements into practical accounting and operational processes.
  • Maintain detailed grant ledgers and spending trackers, record actual expenses and revenue, update forecasts monthly, and monitor remaining balances against award budgets, performance periods, and spending timelines.
  • Reconcile grant revenue and expenses to the general ledger and cross-check activity across accounting, payroll, procurement, reimbursement, state and federal reporting systems, and internal grant schedules.
  • Prepare and post journal entries related to grant revenue, payroll, wages, expenses, allocations, reimbursements, and other allowable costs, ensuring grant activity is accurately reflected in the general ledger.
  • Review grant-funded expenditures for allowability, allocability, reasonableness, proper documentation, and compliance with applicable federal, state, and grant-specific requirements.
  • Prepare, submit, and monitor invoices, cash requests, reimbursement requests, drawdowns, and other funding requests, including supporting documentation required by funding agencies.
  • Prepare and/or oversee timely and accurate financial and programmatic grant reports across required state, federal, and internal systems.
  • Manage West Virginia-specific reporting and compliance requirements, including detailed documentation for programs such as CSP grants, and respond to rejected, questioned, or returned submissions.
  • Monitor grant activity throughout the grant period, identify budget variances, underspending, overspending, compliance risks, and missed funding opportunities, and recommend corrective actions.
  • Coordinate grant budget amendments and revisions when spending plans or program needs change, ensuring required approvals are obtained before changes are implemented.
  • Support grant applications and renewals by gathering financial information, developing or reviewing grant budgets, and coordinating required documentation with school and corporate stakeholders.
  • Maintain complete, organized, and audit-ready grant files, including award documents, budgets, invoices, payroll support, reimbursement documentation, reports, correspondence, and closeout records.
  • Support federal, state, and other compliance audits and monitoring reviews; coordinate responses to information requests and ensure findings or recommendations are addressed timely.
  • Manage grant closeout activities, including final expenditure reconciliation, final reports, remaining balances, required documentation, and confirmation that all grant requirements have been satisfied.
  • Partner with Finance and Accounting on monthly close and explain the financial impact of grant activity on revenue, expenses, payroll, reimbursements, and the general ledger.
  • Collaborate with school and operational leaders to ensure grant-funded staffing, programs, purchases, and other costs are allowable, properly documented, and charged to the correct award.
  • Provide guidance and training to school leaders and other stakeholders on grant requirements, allowable costs, budgeting, documentation, reporting, and compliance.
  • Continuously review monthly activity and grant processes to identify opportunities to improve controls, accuracy, efficiency, and visibility into grant performance.
  • Help design and implement standardized, scalable grant management processes as ACCEL Schools expands into additional states and schools and transitions to new financial and procurement systems.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert and primary point of contact for assigned grants, coordinating effectively with school leadership, Accounting, Finance, Accounts Payable, Payroll, Procurement, and external funding agencies.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business, Public Administration, Education Administration, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in grant management, grant accounting, accounting, or financial management, with demonstrated responsibility for managing grants through multiple stages of the grant lifecycle.
  • Demonstrated experience managing federal and state grants, including budgeting, expenditure tracking, reconciliations, reporting, compliance, reimbursement, and closeout.
  • Experience in a nonprofit, education, public sector, charter school, or other highly regulated grant-funded environment.
  • Direct knowledge of West Virginia grant requirements, reporting practices, and compliance expectations.
  • Strong understanding of grant accounting principles and the ability to connect grant requirements to general ledger activity.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including PivotTables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, data analysis, and maintaining detailed financial trackers.
  • Ability to manage multiple entities, grants, reporting systems, deadlines, and competing priorities with a high level of accuracy.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain financial and compliance requirements to accounting, school, and operational teams.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, problem-solving, and project management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing grants across multiple states or school locations.
  • Experience with education-focused grants, including CSP, Title I, Title II, Title IV, 21st Century, or other federal and state education programs.
  • Experience with NetSuite.
  • Experience with Dayforce.
  • Knowledge of Uniform Guidance (2 CFR Part 200) and evolving federal grant requirements.
  • Experience developing grant management policies, procedures, internal controls, and reporting tools.
  • Experience supporting grant applications, renewals, monitoring visits, and closeouts.

Work Style and Success Profile

  • Hands-on and willing to perform detailed grant accounting, financial management, compliance, and administrative work.
  • Able to independently own a grant portfolio while maintaining strong communication with school, finance, accounting, and operational stakeholders.
  • Comfortable shifting between strategic portfolio oversight and transaction-level review.
  • Proactive, highly organized, detail-oriented, analytical, and responsive in a fast-moving environment.
  • Able to research and interpret grant requirements and translate them into clear actions and processes.
  • Comfortable identifying issues, challenging questionable activity, and recommending solutions before problems become compliance or financial risks.
  • Able to build and improve processes rather than relying solely on existing procedures.
  • Comfortable learning new state requirements and supporting expansion into additional non-Ohio schools.

Work Location and Travel

This is a 100% remote position within the state of West Virginia. Candidates should have meaningful professional experience with West Virginia nonprofit, education, or grant-funded organizations. Travel is not required; however, the Grant Manager may optionally travel approximately one to two times per year to meet colleagues and school partners, with additional voluntary travel based on interest and business needs.

Our Benefits:

Life benefits – time & peace of mind

  • Paid time off
  • Retirement contributions
  • Optional Basic Life and AD&D insurance
  • Voluntary life insurance (employee, spouse, child)
  • Discounted childcare at Early Learning Academies locations

Health benefits – stay well & thrive

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Voluntary short-term disability insurance
  • Voluntary long-term disability insurance

Career benefits – keep growing

  • Career advancement opportunities throughout Pansophic Learning and our strong network of 4,000+ instructors and education professionals

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

It is our policy to abide by all federal, state and local laws prohibiting employment discrimination based solely on a person’s race, color, religious creed, sex, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, pregnancy, childbirth, physical disability, mental and/or intellectual disability, age, military status, veteran status (including protected veterans), marital status, registered domestic partner or civil union status, familial status, gender (including sex stereotyping and gender identity or expression), medical condition, genetic information, sexual orientation, or any other protected status except where a reasonable, bona fide occupational qualification exists.

raw.description:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.

Role

Production Engineering applies software engineering principles to production systems, shifting operations from reactive, human-driven intervention to proactive, software-driven reliability and scale.

The Vice President / Senior Vice President of Production Engineering is the senior executive accountable for the reliability, performance, scalability, and security of NICE’s global, AI-first platforms.

The leader who fills this role is the owner of end-to-end production environments across NICE’s Cloud, Telecom, and Datacenter platforms, accountable for the operational outcomes of those platforms.

The selected leader will drive the transformation of a diverse, operations-heavy organization into a modern, AI-first function.

Responsibilities

Production Engineering Transformation

  • Lead the evolution of an organization that includes software engineers, systems engineers, network engineers, telecom engineers, database administrators, application operations, DevOps, SRE, and NOC personnel into a cohesive Production Engineering function.
  • Shift the organization from ticket-driven, reactive operations toward software-first, automated systems that proactively ensure reliability and scale.
  • Define future-state roles, skill sets, and career paths aligned with Production Engineering and AI-first platform needs.
  • Drive up-skilling, re-skilling, and selective hiring to build modern production engineering capabilities.

Platform Operations

  • Own the engineering and operation of global cloud infrastructure, telecom platforms, and datacenter environments.
  • Ensure production systems meet defined availability, performance, scalability, security, and cost targets.
  • Establish and enforce production readiness standards across all platform services.
  • Own operational governance for capacity planning, resilience, disaster recovery, and business continuity.

Production Engineering Discipline

  • Establish Production Engineering as a core engineering discipline embedded with Product Engineering teams.
  • Drive adoption of software-first operational practices including automated recovery, infrastructure as code, synthetic testing, and observability.
  • Ensure reliability, scalability, performance, and security are treated as first-class design requirements, not post-release concerns.
  • Influence architecture and delivery decisions early to prevent systemic production risk.

Reliability, Observability & Incident Leadership

  • Define and maintain service level indicators (SLIs) and service-level objectives (SLOs), error budgets, and reliability metrics across the platform.
  • Own observability strategy, including monitoring, alerting, logs, metrics, tracing, and capacity signals.
  • Lead global incident management, escalation, and executive-level response during major platform events.
  • Ensure incidents drive learning and systemic improvement rather than repeat failures or hero-driven response.

Automation, AI & Platform Enablement

  • Drive the adoption of AI-assisted operations, automation, and agent-based workflows across production environments.
  • Leverage AI to improve detection, diagnosis, remediation, and capacity forecasting while maintaining appropriate human-in-the-loop controls.
  • Own CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and infrastructure-as-code practices.
  • Reduce operational toil and manual intervention through automation and self-service platforms.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner with Product Engineering to align platform capabilities with product delivery commitments.
  • Partner with Customer Support to strengthen feedback loops from customer experience into engineering action.
  • Partner with Security to ensure platforms are secure by design and compliant by default.
  • Act as a senior operational leader during customer-impacting events and executive escalations.

Organization & Talent Leadership

  • Lead, scale, and grow global teams within Production Engineering.
  • Build strong leadership layers and develop senior technical leaders.
  • Foster a culture of ownership, bias for action, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.
  • Attract, retain, and develop world-class production engineers capable of operating AI-first platforms at scale.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
  • 15+ years of engineering leadership experience operating large-scale, distributed platforms.
  • 8+ years leading senior engineering or operations organizations spanning infrastructure, platform, or production environments.
  • Proven experience leading organizational and skill transformation within engineering or operations teams.
  • Strong background in cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, networking, and runtime platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to establish engineering standards and influence architecture across organizations.
  • Experience partnering with Product, Security, and Support leaders in complex environments.

Preferred

  • Experience operating AI-enabled or data-intensive platforms in production.
  • Experience modernizing legacy operations or NOC-based organizations.
  • Background in Production Engineering or SRE organizations at scale.
  • Experience operating in regulated, sovereign, or enterprise customer environments.

About NiCE

NICE Ltd. (NASDAQ: NICE) software products are used by 25,000+ global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations, to deliver extraordinary customer experiences, fight financial crime and ensure public safety. Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3+ billion financial transactions.

Known as an innovation powerhouse that excels in AI, cloud and digital, NiCE is consistently recognized as the market leader in its domains, with over 8,500 employees across 30+ countries.

NiCE is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, neurotype, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other category protected by law.
