Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Global Senior Manager of Benefits, Wellbeing & Mobility for our Total Rewards team in Brazil!

The Wellhub mission is to make wellbeing universal and the pursuit of this mission begins with our Wellhub. You will be responsible for the design, strategy, and implementation of our benefits and wellbeing programs globally. This role reports to the VP of Total Rewards, and will directly manage an analyst as well as partner with the global People Operations team for local implementation and support of our programs.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Conduct a comprehensive assessment of our benefits offerings across all regions and countries of operation, utilizing global benchmarks to guarantee the ongoing competitiveness of our programs;
  • Thought leadership in the emerging space of corporate wellbeing, driving greater impact and adoption of our wellbeing programs within our organization;
  • Responsible for the design and ongoing oversight of benefits administration including health, welfare, life and disability, etc.;
  • Managing mobility policies, including the international relocation program;
  • Responsible for measuring the impact of wellness programs to improve employee health and ensuring that wellness activities align with overall business objectives;
  • Ensure the proper resolution of escalated benefits issues and oversee policies related to vacation, holidays, bereavement, and leave of absence. Develop & execute a comprehensive benefits communication strategy and collaborate with People Operations on localized benefits administration, covering allowances such as transportation, meal stipend, etc.

WHO YOU ARE

  • A bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field is preferred;
  • Prior experience managing multi-country benefits in a corporate environment and/or relevant previous benefits consulting experience is highly valued; or a solid senior-level foundation in localized benefits (e.g., Brazil/LATAM) paired with strong strategic thinking and a proven appetite and capacity to learn and expand into a global scope;
  • Fluent/Advanced English; Spanish is strongly desired;
  • Proficiency in Google suite of office products;
  • Knowledge of local, state, and federal rules and regulations as they relate to benefits management, particularly in LATAM & Europe;
  • Highly skilled in written, verbal, and interpersonal communication with all levels of employees;
  • Ability to develop and administer budgets and financial reports; ability to analyze problems, identify alternative solutions, project consequences of proposed actions, and implement recommendations in support of goals;
  • Strong analytical, strategic thinking, and organizational skills.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.

HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge.Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here.

Want to see what it’s really like to work here? Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on YouTube!

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

Our commitment to inclusion also extends to how we recognize and reward our people. We’re proud to be Syndio Fair Pay Certified, reflecting our ongoing dedication to equitable and fair pay practices across our global team. Read more about it here.

Questions on how we treat your personal data? See our Aviso de Privacidade para Candidatos.

Position Summary

The Chief API Officer (CAPIO) is responsible for establishing and executing the organization's Application Programming Interface (API) strategy, governance, and ecosystem development initiatives. This executive leads API product management, developer experience, platform integration, Open Banking/Open Finance initiatives, API monetization, security, and digital ecosystem expansion. The role serves as the bridge between business strategy and technology innovation, ensuring APIs become strategic assets that drive revenue, partnerships, customer engagement, and digital transformation.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

  • Develop and execute the enterprise-wide API strategy aligned with business objectives.
  • Establish APIs as strategic products and revenue-generating assets.
  • Drive API-first and platform-centric business models across the organization.
  • Identify opportunities for ecosystem expansion through API enablement.
  • Advise executive leadership and the Board on API innovation and digital ecosystem trends.

API Product Management

  • Oversee the API lifecycle from design and development to deployment and retirement.
  • Define API product roadmaps and service portfolios.
  • Ensure APIs meet customer, developer, and partner requirements.
  • Drive adoption of API product management best practices.
  • Establish service-level agreements (SLAs) and performance standards.

API Governance & Architecture

  • Develop API governance frameworks, standards, and policies.
  • Establish enterprise API architecture and design principles.
  • Ensure consistency, scalability, and interoperability across API platforms.
  • Oversee API versioning, documentation, and lifecycle management.
  • Promote API reuse and enterprise integration strategies.

Developer Ecosystem & Partnerships

  • Build and manage developer communities and partner ecosystems.
  • Develop API onboarding programs and developer support initiatives.
  • Foster innovation through open APIs and third-party integrations.
  • Collaborate with external developers, fintechs, vendors, and strategic partners.
  • Lead developer experience (DX) improvements.

API Monetization & Commercial Strategy

  • Develop API monetization models and pricing strategies.
  • Create new revenue streams through API products and services.
  • Identify commercial partnership opportunities leveraging APIs.
  • Monitor API usage, consumption trends, and profitability.
  • Support marketplace and ecosystem expansion strategies.

Open Banking & Open Finance Leadership

  • Lead Open Banking, Open Finance, and Embedded Finance API initiatives.
  • Ensure compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements.
  • Drive innovation through financial data-sharing ecosystems.
  • Develop strategic API partnerships with financial institutions and fintech organizations.

Security, Risk & Compliance

  • Ensure API security and data protection standards are maintained.
  • Oversee authentication, authorization, and access management frameworks.
  • Implement API cybersecurity best practices.
  • Ensure compliance with privacy regulations, industry standards, and regulatory requirements.
  • Manage operational, security, and third-party risks.

Technology & Innovation

  • Drive adoption of modern API technologies and integration platforms.
  • Oversee API gateways, management platforms, and developer portals.
  • Support cloud-native architectures and microservices transformation.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies including AI, blockchain, and event-driven architectures.
  • Promote continuous innovation and automation.

Data & Analytics

  • Monitor API performance and business outcomes.
  • Establish API analytics and reporting frameworks.
  • Utilize data insights to optimize API products and customer experiences.
  • Measure ecosystem growth and API adoption metrics.

Team Leadership

  • Build and lead high-performing API product, engineering, architecture, and developer relations teams.
  • Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and customer-centricity.
  • Develop future leaders and technical experts within the API organization.

Required Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Administration, or related field.
  • MBA or Master's degree preferred.

Experience

  • 12+ years of leadership experience in API management, enterprise architecture, digital platforms, software engineering, fintech, or technology sectors.
  • Proven experience developing and managing enterprise API ecosystems.
  • Strong background in Open Banking, Open Finance, platform strategies, or digital transformation initiatives.
  • Experience leading large-scale integration and developer ecosystem programs.

Technical Knowledge

  • API Design & Architecture
  • REST, GraphQL, gRPC, and Event-Driven APIs
  • API Gateways & Management Platforms
  • Open Banking & Open Finance Standards
  • Cloud Computing & Microservices
  • Enterprise Integration
  • Cybersecurity & Identity Management
  • Developer Portals & Developer Experience
  • Data Governance & Privacy
  • Platform & Ecosystem Management

Core Competencies

  • API Strategy & Governance
  • Platform & Ecosystem Development
  • API Product Management
  • Digital Transformation Leadership
  • API Monetization
  • Developer Experience (DX)
  • Security & Risk Management
  • Innovation & Emerging Technologies
  • Stakeholder Engagement
  • Executive Leadership

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • API adoption and consumption growth.
  • API revenue and monetization performance.
  • Number of active developers and partners.
  • API platform uptime and reliability.
  • Time-to-market for API products.
  • Security and compliance performance.
  • Customer and developer satisfaction scores.
  • API transaction volume growth.
  • Ecosystem expansion metrics.
  • Operational efficiency and cost optimization.

Secondary Computing & Digital Subject Specialist

Salary: £45,000 - £50,000

STEM Learning has established a strong position in digital education through the National Centre for Computing Education (NCCE) and our wider work in computing, artificial intelligence and digital technologies. We are looking for an exceptional Computing & Digital Specialist to help drive our vision forward, bringing specialist expertise to shape high-quality professional learning, respond to emerging developments and influence the future of computing and digital education. Working across NCCE and wider STEM Learning programmes, you will play a key role in growing the reach, quality and impact of our offer and ensuring we continue to meet the evolving needs of teachers, education professionals and learners.

The Role

This role provides specialist expertise in secondary and post-16 computing and digital education across STEM Learning, contributing to the organisation’s strategic direction, programme development and wider educational impact. Working across the National Centre for Computing Education and other STEM Learning programmes, the role connects subject expertise, educational research, sector intelligence and emerging developments in technology to the design and delivery of high-quality professional learning.

The role contributes to the overall success of STEM Learning by ensuring that its computing and digital education provision is evidence-informed, innovative, responsive to curriculum and policy change, and aligned with the needs of education professionals and learners. Through collaboration with internal teams and external partners, the postholder will strengthen STEM Learning’s expertise, reach and influence, identify opportunities for growth and improvement, and help position the organisation as a leading voice in computing, artificial intelligence and digital education.

Our Ideal Candidate

Candidates will demonstrate our values: Sustainable – Innovative – Proactive

Qualifications/Skills/Experience/Competencies we are looking for include:

  • Significant professional experience in secondary and/or post-16 computing and digital education, with a strong understanding of curriculum, qualifications, pedagogy and current developments in the subject.
  • A relevant degree-level qualification or equivalent professional experience in computing, education or a related discipline.
  • Experience of designing, developing and delivering professional learning for teachers and/or other education professionals.
  • Experience of developing evidence-informed educational resources and professional learning, with the ability to translate research and evidence into effective practice.
  • Experience of building and managing effective partnerships with a range of stakeholders, including external organisations and delivery partners.
  • Experience of managing complex projects, competing priorities and deadlines, ideally within large-scale or national programmes.

Download the full Role Profile to find out more!

About Us

At STEM Learning, we work to improve lives through STEM education. We are a purpose-driven organisation, supporting teachers through high-impact professional development, inspiring young people to build confidence and curiosity in STEM, and connecting schools with employers to grow the UK’s future talent. Guided by our values, we focus our effort where it can make the greatest difference - helping all young people, whatever their background, to see themselves in STEM.

By joining us, you’ll:

Contribute to exciting, high-profile STEM initiatives that have a lasting impact on students and employers alike.

Work alongside passionate colleagues dedicated to shaping the future of STEM careers.

Be supported by a collaborative and dynamic work environment that fosters innovation and creativity.

Gain the opportunity to grow professionally.

Take a look inside the National STEM Learning Centre in York to see our facilities.

Our Benefits

  • 30 days holidays plus bank holidays
  • An additional day off on your birthday
  • Access to an attractive pension scheme
  • Our full-time hours are 37 hours per week
  • Up to 3 paid volunteering leave days per year
  • A comprehensive employee assistance programme

Next Steps

Closing date for applications: Friday 25th September 2026

Interview dates TBC

To Apply

Please provide us with:

  • Your up-to-date CV
  • A covering letter (no more than the equivalent of 2 sides of A4) explaining your interest in the role and why you think you would be the ideal candidate.

STEM Learning strives to be diverse and inclusive – a place where we can ALL be ourselves. We encourage applications from all backgrounds and communities, and are committed to employing teams with diverse abilities, skills, and experiences.

We foster a culture where every employee’s voice is respected and valued.

Salary: £45,000 – £50,000 / year

raw.description:
Principal AI Engineer (AI / .NET Core / React)

At Mitratech, we’re a team of engineers passionate about building world-class products that empower Legal, Risk, Compliance, and HR professionals at Fortune 100 companies. We thrive in a global, inclusive culture that values innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence.

With continued growth, we’re looking for a Principal AI Engineer to join our HotDocs Team. HotDocs is Mitratech’s flagship document automation platform, used by enterprise clients worldwide to streamline the assembly of complex legal documents and contracts.

You'll set the technical direction for AI at HotDocs - designing and delivering new AI-powered enterprise capabilities and driving our adoption of AI across the software development lifecycle. This is a remote-first role.

About the Role

As a Principal AI Engineer, you will:

  • Set the AI Technical Direction: Own the architecture for AI capabilities across HotDocs - model management, LLM and agent orchestration, retrieval strategy, evaluation, cost and latency management - and translate it into a pragmatic delivery roadmap.
  • Deliver Enterprise AI Features: Take new AI-powered features from prototype to production at enterprise scale, writing clean, maintainable code in .NET Core and React and holding the bar for performance, security, and readability.
  • Drive AI Adoption in the SDLC: Lead how we use AI across engineering - coding assistants, agentic workflows, test generation, code review, and documentation - selecting tooling, defining safe and effective usage patterns, and measuring the impact on delivery.
  • Build Trustworthy AI: Establish evaluation harnesses, guardrails, observability, and AI governance practices so that AI features are accurate, explainable, and safe for use in regulated, compliance-heavy environments.
  • Bring Deep Technical Expertise: Apply strong .NET and React ecosystem knowledge to complex problems, modernize and refactor legacy code where it blocks AI integration, and improve system scalability and reliability.
  • Lead and Mentor: Raise the AI capability of the wider engineering group through code reviews, design reviews, pairing, brown-bag sessions, and clear written guidance.
  • Influence Across the Business: Partner with product management, architecture, security, and customer-facing teams to shape the AI roadmap, evaluate build-versus-buy decisions, and set realistic expectations for what AI can deliver.
  • Enhance DevOps and AI Ops: Extend CI/CD pipelines to cover AI workloads - prompt and model versioning, automated evaluation gates, monitoring, and cost tracking - working closely with DevOps engineers.
  • Focus on the User: Ensure AI features solve real customer problems and deliver a great experience through attention to detail, responsiveness, transparency, and accessibility.

About You

You are:

  • A Technical Leader: You set direction without needing authority, build consensus across teams, and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical peers.
  • An AI Practitioner, not a Spectator: You have shipped AI features to real users, keep pace with a fast-moving field, and can tell genuine capability from hype.
  • Evidence-Led: You care about maintainable code, testing, and measurable outcomes - you evaluate AI systems with data rather than intuition.
  • Adaptable and Pragmatic: You balance long-term architectural goals with the practical needs of a sprint-driven environment, and you know when a simple solution beats a model.
  • Security-, Privacy- and Performance-Minded: You build with scalability and resilience in mind, using secure-by-design principles, and you treat data privacy and responsible AI as first-order concerns.

Required Skills and Experience

  • 12 or more years of professional software development experience, including time in a principal, lead, or staff-level technical role.
  • Strong skills in .NET Core (C#) and React (TypeScript) or similar SPA frameworks - this remains a hands-on engineering role.
  • Demonstrable experience designing and shipping production AI solutions - LLM integration, prompt engineering, RAG, MCP, and agentic or tool-calling systems.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud AI platforms and services (e.g. Azure OpenAI / AI Foundry, or equivalent) and with orchestration frameworks such as Semantic Kernel.
  • Experience building and maintaining REST APIs.
  • Proficiency with Entity Framework and Azure SQL (or SQL Server).
  • Experience evaluating and improving AI system quality - test sets, benchmarking, human review loops, and handling non-deterministic behavior.
  • Understanding of web applications and AI-specific security, including secure coding, prompt injection, and safe handling of sensitive customer data.
  • Experience using Git and collaborating through modern workflows (e.g., pull requests, branching strategies).
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps or similar).
  • Comfortable working in agile teams using tools such as Jira and Confluence.
  • Practical experience using AI tooling within the SDLC (e.g. coding assistants, agentic developer tools) and a view on how to adopt it well across a team.
  • A track record of technical leadership - mentoring senior engineers, leading design reviews, and influencing roadmap and architecture decisions.

Nice to Have

  • Deeper AI specialism in areas such as SLMs and fine-tuning, CAG, vector databases, AI observability, multi-agent systems, or AI/ML pipelines.
  • Experience with Microsoft Office Addins (office.js / VSTO)
  • Familiarity of .NET Framework / WPF
  • Experience with authentication standards such as OAuth and SSO.
  • Exposure to distributed caching (e.g., Redis)
  • Knowledge of Linux environments and containerization (Docker).
  • Scripting in PowerShell.
  • Familiarity with performance tuning and application diagnostics.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code or automation tooling.
  • Previous experience in enterprise SaaS or compliance-heavy domains (e.g., legaltech, fintech), particularly applying AI to document, contract, or natural language workloads.

What We Offer

  • A collaborative, supportive, and learning-focused work culture.
  • The chance to shape an AI strategy end to end, from architecture through to production, at enterprise scale.
  • Opportunities to grow your technical skills and career path.
  • Remote-first flexibility with optional in-person collaboration sessions.
  • Competitive benefits and a chance to impact how global organizations automate critical legal and compliance workflows.

Join Us

Ready to lead the application of AI to document automation at enterprise scale? Apply now to join Mitratech’s innovative, inclusive, and driven HotDocs engineering team.

raw.description:
Position Summary

The Chief API Officer (CAPIO) is responsible for establishing and executing the organization's Application Programming Interface (API) strategy, governance, and ecosystem development initiatives. This executive leads API product management, developer experience, platform integration, Open Banking/Open Finance initiatives, API monetization, security, and digital ecosystem expansion. The role serves as the bridge between business strategy and technology innovation, ensuring APIs become strategic assets that drive revenue, partnerships, customer engagement, and digital transformation.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

  • Develop and execute the enterprise-wide API strategy aligned with business objectives.
  • Establish APIs as strategic products and revenue-generating assets.
  • Drive API-first and platform-centric business models across the organization.
  • Identify opportunities for ecosystem expansion through API enablement.
  • Advise executive leadership and the Board on API innovation and digital ecosystem trends.

API Product Management

  • Oversee the API lifecycle from design and development to deployment and retirement.
  • Define API product roadmaps and service portfolios.
  • Ensure APIs meet customer, developer, and partner requirements.
  • Drive adoption of API product management best practices.
  • Establish service-level agreements (SLAs) and performance standards.

API Governance & Architecture

  • Develop API governance frameworks, standards, and policies.
  • Establish enterprise API architecture and design principles.
  • Ensure consistency, scalability, and interoperability across API platforms.
  • Oversee API versioning, documentation, and lifecycle management.
  • Promote API reuse and enterprise integration strategies.

Developer Ecosystem & Partnerships

  • Build and manage developer communities and partner ecosystems.
  • Develop API onboarding programs and developer support initiatives.
  • Foster innovation through open APIs and third-party integrations.
  • Collaborate with external developers, fintechs, vendors, and strategic partners.
  • Lead developer experience (DX) improvements.

API Monetization & Commercial Strategy

  • Develop API monetization models and pricing strategies.
  • Create new revenue streams through API products and services.
  • Identify commercial partnership opportunities leveraging APIs.
  • Monitor API usage, consumption trends, and profitability.
  • Support marketplace and ecosystem expansion strategies.

Open Banking & Open Finance Leadership

  • Lead Open Banking, Open Finance, and Embedded Finance API initiatives.
  • Ensure compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements.
  • Drive innovation through financial data-sharing ecosystems.
  • Develop strategic API partnerships with financial institutions and fintech organizations.

Security, Risk & Compliance

  • Ensure API security and data protection standards are maintained.
  • Oversee authentication, authorization, and access management frameworks.
  • Implement API cybersecurity best practices.
  • Ensure compliance with privacy regulations, industry standards, and regulatory requirements.
  • Manage operational, security, and third-party risks.

Technology & Innovation

  • Drive adoption of modern API technologies and integration platforms.
  • Oversee API gateways, management platforms, and developer portals.
  • Support cloud-native architectures and microservices transformation.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies including AI, blockchain, and event-driven architectures.
  • Promote continuous innovation and automation.

Data & Analytics

  • Monitor API performance and business outcomes.
  • Establish API analytics and reporting frameworks.
  • Utilize data insights to optimize API products and customer experiences.
  • Measure ecosystem growth and API adoption metrics.

Team Leadership

  • Build and lead high-performing API product, engineering, architecture, and developer relations teams.
  • Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and customer-centricity.
  • Develop future leaders and technical experts within the API organization.

Required Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Administration, or related field.
  • MBA or Master's degree preferred.

Experience

  • 12+ years of leadership experience in API management, enterprise architecture, digital platforms, software engineering, fintech, or technology sectors.
  • Proven experience developing and managing enterprise API ecosystems.
  • Strong background in Open Banking, Open Finance, platform strategies, or digital transformation initiatives.
  • Experience leading large-scale integration and developer ecosystem programs.

Technical Knowledge

  • API Design & Architecture
  • REST, GraphQL, gRPC, and Event-Driven APIs
  • API Gateways & Management Platforms
  • Open Banking & Open Finance Standards
  • Cloud Computing & Microservices
  • Enterprise Integration
  • Cybersecurity & Identity Management
  • Developer Portals & Developer Experience
  • Data Governance & Privacy
  • Platform & Ecosystem Management

Core Competencies

  • API Strategy & Governance
  • Platform & Ecosystem Development
  • API Product Management
  • Digital Transformation Leadership
  • API Monetization
  • Developer Experience (DX)
  • Security & Risk Management
  • Innovation & Emerging Technologies
  • Stakeholder Engagement
  • Executive Leadership

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • API adoption and consumption growth.
  • API revenue and monetization performance.
  • Number of active developers and partners.
  • API platform uptime and reliability.
  • Time-to-market for API products.
  • Security and compliance performance.
  • Customer and developer satisfaction scores.
  • API transaction volume growth.
  • Ecosystem expansion metrics.
  • Operational efficiency and cost optimization.

Who We Are: At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be engaged directly by the client as an independent contractor. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote so you'll be able to work from home.

Who The Client Is: We help businesses make their buildings smarter, more efficient and more sustainable.

With more than 20 years of industry experience, we specialise in building automation, energy management and optimisation, helping clients reduce operating costs, improve building performance and create better environments for occupants.

We combine technology, engineering expertise and practical experience to deliver solutions that are measurable, reliable and built for the long term. We work closely with clients and industry partners to solve complex challenges and unlock greater value from their buildings.

Role Overview: This is a hands-on BMS Estimator role for an experienced Building Management Systems and HVAC controls professional who can turn complex project documentation into accurate, commercially sound estimates. You’ll review mechanical, electrical and BMS drawings, specifications and equipment schedules, interpret control strategies and sequences, develop points schedules and controller selections, and assess BMS networks, field devices and third-party integrations including BACnet and Modbus.

Working closely with the estimating, engineering and project delivery teams, you’ll build detailed tender submissions covering materials, labour, engineering, commissioning and project management. You’ll also identify scope gaps, risks, exclusions and qualifications, review supplier quotations and prepare clear handover documentation for the Australian project team. Strong knowledge of HVAC plant and BMS architecture is essential, while experience with Reliable Controls and BidTracer or similar estimating software will be highly regarded.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Review mechanical, electrical and BMS drawings, specifications and equipment schedules.
  • Interpret mechanical plant, HVAC systems and control requirements.
  • Develop detailed BMS points schedules and controller selections.
  • Estimate BMS network architecture, including BACnet/IP and BACnet MS/TP.
  • Identify requirements for sensors, actuators, valves, dampers, VSDs, meters and other field devices.
  • Identify third-party interfaces and integration requirements, including BACnet, Modbus and other common protocols.
  • Interpret control strategies, sequences of operation and functional descriptions.
  • Prepare detailed allowances for materials, labour, engineering, commissioning and project management.
  • Review switchboard/MSSB requirements and BMS electrical interfaces.
  • Obtain, assess and compare supplier quotations.
  • Identify scope gaps, exclusions, qualifications, assumptions and project risks.
  • Prepare detailed tender breakdowns and supporting documentation.
  • Prepare clear handover documentation for the Australian project team.
  • Work collaboratively with estimating, engineering and project delivery teams throughout the tender process.
  • Systems & Technical Scope

You should be comfortable estimating BMS and HVAC control systems involving:

  • AHUs, FCUs, VAVs and ventilation systems
  • Chilled water and heating hot water systems
  • Chillers, boilers and heat pumps
  • Cooling towers and condenser water systems
  • VRF/VRV systems
  • Pumps, VSDs, valves and dampers
  • Metering and energy monitoring systems
  • BMS controllers, I/O and field devices
  • BACnet and Modbus integration
  • BMS networks and supervisory systems

Requirements

  • Proven experience in BMS estimating, BMS engineering, controls engineering or a closely related role.
  • Strong knowledge of HVAC systems, mechanical plant and building controls.
  • Ability to interpret mechanical, electrical and BMS drawings and specifications.
  • Strong understanding of BMS architecture, controllers, I/O and networks.
  • Working knowledge of BACnet, Modbus and third-party system integrations.
  • Ability to understand sequences of operation and functional descriptions.
  • Strong commercial awareness and attention to detail.
  • Experience preparing detailed tenders, quotations or project estimates.
  • Ability to identify scope gaps, risks, exclusions and assumptions.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with Australian-based estimating, engineering and project teams.

Desirable

  • Experience with Reliable Controls — highly regarded but not essential.
  • Experience with BidTracer or similar estimating/tender management software.
  • Experience estimating BMS projects within the Australian commercial building environment.

Work Arrangement & Expectations:

This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement.

To ensure alignment and transparency, successful candidates will be expected to:

  • Disclose any existing ongoing roles or client work
  • Reflect this engagement on their LinkedIn profile (clearly marked as “Independent Contractor”)

About the Role
We are looking for a Junior Facebook Ads Specialist to join our media buying team to work across multiple international markets. This is a fast-paced, high-growth role for someone who is eager to learn, takes ownership seriously, communicates proactively, and doesn't need to be chased for updates.

You'll work closely with our media buying, video editing, graphic design, and landing page teams to turn performance data into better creative ideas and experiments.

  • Analyze winning and losing ads to understand why they perform differently
  • Come up with new creative ideas, angles, hooks, messaging, and ways to improve existing winners

Atuamos com umamentalidade de jogo infinito: não focamos em ganhar uma partida isolada, mas em permanecer no jogo, buscando desafios cada vez maiores e manter um aprendizado contínuo para ser cada dia melhor.

Na GIRO.TECH temos um ambiente realmente meritocrático, quem entrega e colabora mais, será sempre recompensado. Nosso time sênior e lideranças é majoritariamente formado por pessoas que entraram na empresa em cargos Júnior e até mesmo como estagiários. Aqui, novas vagas importantes são prioritariamente preenchidas com pessoas da casa.

Nossos processos seletivos são uma busca de futuros sócios da empresa. Para ir rápido, melhor ir sozinho. Se queremos construir algo grande, precisamos nos juntar a mais gente boa que pense como a gente. Dedicamos muito tempo nos processos seletivos para achar essas pessoas e entregamos desafios constantes para promover crescimento. Temos hoje comosócios da empresa, muitas pessoas que começaram em posições de base e mostraram que têm vontade de ser mais.

Fundadores - nossa base

Uma empresa é a extensão dos valores e sonhos de seus sócios fundadores. A GIRO.TECH foi fundada por quatro sócios, que têm como primeira formação a tecnologia, e são apaixonados por servir os outros usando seu conhecimento e por resolver problemas complexos.


Isso é GIRO.TECH

  • Liderança e Mentoria:aqui não temos "chefes", mas líderes que caminham lado a lado, incentivam e ensinam.
  • Voz Ativa:a melhor ideia prevalece, não o maior cargo. Oferecemos espaço para testar, errar e aprender.
  • Liberdade e Responsabilidade:valorizamos o trabalho remoto e a autonomia. Você tem liberdade para trabalhar de onde preferir e vestir o que for mais confortável; em troca, esperamos responsabilidade total com as entregas.
  • Crescimento Interno:priorizamos nosso time para ocupar novas vagas e posições mais desafiadoras. Temos muitas pessoas que iniciaram como estagiários e hoje evoluíram para o nível sênior, alguns, inclusive, passaram a ser sócios da empresa.
  • Excelência Técnica:nossa principal estratégia comercial é possuir a melhor tecnologia e um produto de alta performance. O resultado é a satisfação dos nossos clientes, que nos avaliam constantemente com notas acima de 9.

Isso NÃO é GIRO.TECH

  • Não somos uma instituição financeira tradicional de "terno e colete puffer".
  • Não valorizamos hierarquias rígidas ou burocracias excessivas para tomada de decisão.
  • Não somos os donos da verdade; somosinquietos, curiosos e abertos a mudanças.

Perfil que buscamos

Buscamos pessoas capazes de se adaptar a cenários dinâmicos e com sede de conhecimento. Valorizamos ainquietude: a busca constante por evoluir processos e construir resultados melhores a cada dia.

Se você é apaixonado por solucionar problemas com excelência, busca desafios que te tirem da zona de conforto e nunca está satisfeito com o mediano, seu lugar é aqui.

Vem construir o futuro da tecnologia de crédito com a gente!



Sobre a vaga:

O crédito consignado é uma operação que só funciona quando os números fecham. Cada parcela precisa ser descontada, repassada e conciliada corretamente — e quando não é, alguém precisa perceber, entender por quê e resolver antes que vire prejuízo.

Esse alguém é você.

Estamos construindo a operação financeira do nosso produto de crédito e procuramos alguém que faça as duas coisas: rode a rotina com rigor e, ao mesmo tempo, transforme em processo documentado, controle e automação aquilo que vem sendo construído. É uma vaga para quem gosta de conciliar, mas se incomoda de conciliar do mesmo jeito manual todo mês.

Você vai trabalhar lado a lado com Produto, Tecnologia, Operações e Contabilidade, com reporte direto ao Head de Produtos de Crédito — e com espaço real para desenhar como as coisas serão feitas daqui pra frente.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Conciliar os arquivos de escrituração e de pagamentos com a carteira de contratos, confrontando parcela devida, valor descontado e valor repassado.
  • Identificar, classificar e tratar divergências: descontos parciais, parcelas não descontadas, repasses não realizados, suspensões de desconto, verbas rescisórias e encargos.
  • Manter o controle de itens em aberto, conduzir a regularização com clientes e parceiros e garantir o encerramento dentro do mês de competência.
  • Apurar, conferir e acompanhar os repasses devidos a parceiros e demais contrapartes, conforme as regras contratuais.
  • Controlar o ciclo de faturamento de serviços e consultas
  • Monitorar o descasamento entre prazos de recebimento e de pagamento, sinalizando com antecedência qualquer risco de exposição de caixa.
  • Acompanhar inadimplência da carteira, acionamento de garantias e os prazos críticos associados.
  • Desenhar, documentar e implantar os processos e controles das rotinas de conciliação, repasse, faturamento e gestão de garantias.
  • Especificar relatórios e painéis junto a Produto e Tecnologia, apoiar homologação de sistemas e validação de novas rotinas.
  • Identificar trabalho manual recorrente e propor automações, priorizando por risco e por volume.
  • Dar retaguarda às rotinas financeiras da empresa (contas a pagar e receber, conciliação bancária, fechamento mensal) quando necessário.

O que buscamos (requisitos):


  • Formação:Ensino superior completo em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência:
    - Vivência com conciliação de alto volume — arquivos de retorno, movimentos financeiros ou transações.
    - Noções de contabilidade e rotinas da área financeira.
  • Ferramentas:
    -Excel e Google Planilhas em nível avançado (PROCV/ÍNDICE+CORRESP, SOMASES, tabelas dinâmicas, tratamento de bases): essencial.
    - Facilidade com dados: leitura e manipulação de arquivos CSV e layouts posicionais.
    - Google Drive e Notion.
    - Diferenciais: SQL e consumo de APIs.
  • Desejável (não eliminatório): -Vivência em crédito consignado, instituição financeira, securitizadora, FIDC ou fintech de crédito — backoffice, liquidação, cessão de carteira ou gestão de garantias.
    - Experiência documentando processos (fluxogramas, POPs, matrizes de controle).
  • Perfil que combina com a vaga:
    -Rigor com número: para você, diferença não explicada não é diferença aceita.
    - Ceticismo produtivo — questiona o dado antes de reportá-lo e não se acomoda com inconsistência recorrente.
    - Pensa em processo: enxerga a rotina como sistema e vai atrás da causa raiz, não só do ajuste do mês.
    - Autonomia e organização para conduzir rotinas com prazo rígido sem alguém cobrando.

raw.description:
About Button

Since 2018, Button has been building reliable technology for government and private-sector clients with the goal of creating a more sustainable future through digital transformation. We create secure, easy-to-use systems through deliberate consideration and iteration. We are passionate about creating stronger communities through technology and continuing to grow across Canada and beyond.

Button Inc. was born out of a desire to take complex tasks and ideas and deliver them in a genuine, innovative, and impactful way. We help clients tackle hard problems and delight them with user-focused design and exceptional technical delivery. We start every engagement by making sure we’re solving the right problem with the most appropriate technical solution to meet our client’s needs.

About The Opportunity

Button is looking to support a government client undertaking a long-term digital modernization program to replace disconnected legacy regulatory systems and reduce technical debt. Rather than rebuilding existing applications one-for-one, the organization is creating secure, interconnected and sustainable solutions within the Microsoft 365 ecosystem, supported by a common data framework. The project will deliver scalable solutions that improve business processes, data access and reporting while creating reusable components, supporting production releases, and providing the documentation and knowledge transfer needed for long-term internal support.

We're looking for a Sr Microsoft developer with a minimum of 10 years experience in the ecosystem. You will lead the full solution lifecycle using an outcome-first approach. This includes defining the business problem and user needs; assessing data ownership, integrity, migration and integration requirements; mapping those needs to Microsoft 365 capabilities; and comparing potential solutions based on simplicity, sustainability, cost and governance.

You will recommend an appropriate technology pattern with clear rationale and risk considerations, then design, test and implement the agreed solution using reusable and scalable components wherever possible. You will also prepare detailed documentation and provide hands-on knowledge transfer to support the solution’s long-term success.

You work with business and technical teams to understand and recommend the most appropriate combination of Microsoft technologies to automate business processes, improve data access and reporting, and support the modernization of the organization’s regulatory capabilities. Technologies include Teams, SharePoint, Planner, Power Platform, Dataverse, Power BI, Viva and Copilot.

Required Experience

Please note that while Button values lifelong learning, transferable skills and candidates from diverse professional backgrounds, the experience outlined below is mandatory in order to be considered by the client.

  • A minimum of 10 years within the last 15 years experience working in the Microsoft Ecoystem.
  • Full Solution Lifecycle project experience using an outcome-first approach as outlined above
  • Certification of either
    • PL‑400: Microsoft Power Platform Developer Associate; OR
    • PL‑600: Microsoft Power Platform Solution Architect Expert

5 years within the last 10 years in each of the following areas:

  • Developing Microsoft Planner functionality using the Planner API to programmatically create, manage, track or integrate plans and tasks with other business applications and workflows
  • Developing Microsoft SharePoint solutions using the Microsoft Graph API, including Drive, List and Site functionality
  • Managing Microsoft Teams using the Microsoft Graph API
  • Developing Power Automate cloud flows using standard and custom Microsoft connectors for both automation and orchestration
  • Integrating solutions with Microsoft Azure Active Directory single sign-on
  • Creating Microsoft Teams Canvas Power Apps for enterprise business requirements and developing custom components using the Power Apps Component Framework
  • Developing Power BI reports and dashboards
  • Connecting solutions with new and existing enterprise or Common Dataverse data

5 years within the last 10 years specifically with:

  • Visual Studio Integrated Development Environment with C#, .NET, Python
  • Visual Studio Code with JavaScript, TypeScript and Node.js

Please note that if an offer of employment is presented, you will be required to complete a Government of Canada security screening process prior to commencing work.

Why Button?

This is a unique and exciting opportunity to play a key role in creating a more sustainable future through digital transformation.

We are open to you joining as a Full Time Employee, Hourly Term Employee or as an Incorporated Independent Contractor on an hourly basis. The hourly rate is reflective of each of those options.

Full Time Employees of Button receive:

  • Generous total compensation plan
  • 25 days of paid time off (15 vacation days, 10 sick/personal days) to ensure a healthy work-life balance
  • An extra day off for your birthday! (So you’re not pushing to production on your special day)
  • Full benefits package to look after you and your family, plus a health spending account
  • Commitment to continuous learning and mentorship, with time provided for professional and personal development
  • Remote work with flexibility when you need it, as long as you communicate clearly with your team (we value a trust-based team culture!)
Salary: 50-110 per hour

About us:

Airtm is a financial-infrastructure company building the future of the online-work economy. We are on a mission to empower the world's growing number of Digital Entrepreneurs in the Global South, giving them the financial freedom to thrive.
The problem is clear: in emerging markets, accessing the dollar economy is difficult. Cross-border payments are slow, expensive, and often lose value to inflation. This limits the potential of millions of talented individuals.
Airtm’s solution is a swift and comprehensive financial platform that facilitates low-value cross-border payments and local cash-outs. As pioneers in stablecoin-payment infrastructure, Airtm has built the most advanced cross-border payment system available on the market.
As a company married to the world of online work, Airtm will go beyond payments to build the necessary infrastructure the online-work economy needs to thrive. We are fostering an entirely new economy, giving individuals, communities, and countries the tools to take control of their financial destinies.

About the Role:

The Senior QA Engineer is responsible for ensuring the quality and reliability of the company's software products. This role involves close collaboration with product and engineering teams to define clear acceptance criteria, develop and execute comprehensive test strategies, and build robust automated testing frameworks for a modern web application and its backend services. The engineer plays a critical role in maintaining high standards for product releases and improving the overall quality assurance process, while actively pioneering the integration of AI and LLM tools into the testing lifecycle.

What you’ll be responsible for, the QA engineer:

-

  • Analyzes product specifications to derive comprehensive and testable acceptance criteria.

  • Collaborates with product managers and developers to clarify requirements and identify potential edge cases.

  • Designs, implements, and maintains a robust suite of automated tests, including end-to-end, integration, and regression tests.

  • Performs manual testing for complex or new features prior to the establishment of full automation coverage.

  • Monitors, analyzes, and improves test coverage, reliability, and performance over time.

  • Contributes to the continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) process by integrating automated tests into the deployment pipeline.

  • Enhances overall product quality by creating detailed bug reports, providing constructive feedback, and maintaining clear testing documentation.

  • Designs and deploys AI-assisted testing workflows to automate recurring tasks such as test case generation, test data synthesis, and log analysis.

  • Evaluates and integrates LLM-based testing and coding tools into the QA team's workflow, assessing their reliability, accuracy, and fitness for automated testing and edge-case discovery use cases.

Experience and skills required:

-

  • Proven experience as a Senior QA Engineer (5+ Years of experience) or similar role, specifically testing modern web applications and backend services.

  • Strong proficiency with test automation frameworks such as Cypress, Playwright, or similar tools.

  • Deep understanding of backend services, APIs (REST and GraphQL), and their common failure scenarios.

  • Ability to read and comprehend frontend and backend code to assist in debugging and test creation.

  • Familiarity with version control systems (Git) and CI/CD tools and processes.

  • Hands-on experience with AI agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, or similar) and demonstrated ability to build, deploy, or thoroughly validate agent-assisted testing systems in a near-production context.

  • Proactive and highly detail-oriented mindset.

  • Advanced proficiency in the English language.

Applicants must be based in South, North or Central America
(applications from other locations will not be considered).
This is a fully remote role, reporting to our Tech Lead.

raw.description:
About Reserv

Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. Founded by insurtech veterans with deep experience in SaaS and digital claims, Reserv is venture-backed by Bain Capital and Altai Ventures and began operations in May 2022. We are focused on automating highly manual tasks to tackle long-standing problems in claims and set a new standard for TPAs, insurance technology providers, and adjusters alike. We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need people who can work in an evolving environment. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can't wait to meet you.

As the Product Development Lead for AiDE, Reserv Inc.’s newest initiative, you will be defining a new product line and its growth potential for years to come. AiDE was created to bring Reserv’s in house claim technology to market participants via a simple cost plus model. You will sit at the intersection of our carrier customers, the London market, and our engineering team — helping drive the product roadmap and acting as a liaison to customers as they transition their operational process to AiDE’s offerings.

For this role, we are seeking a product-minded insurance technologist who knows the London market intimately and is comfortable going deep on data. This role will require you to be the technical face of AiDE with carriers, translate market needs into a prioritized roadmap, and work hand in hand with engineering and product management to ship products that drive outcomes for carriers.

What you will do

  • Partner with AiDE’s product manager to shape the roadmap, serving as the team’s London market expert — you bring the domain knowledge of carrier and delegated authority workflows, BDX reporting, and the practical realities of where the two break down
  • Apply that market experience to a new product offering where features must be based on informed hypotheses versus solid customer feedback — anticipating carrier needs they haven’t yet articulated and helping the team avoid building the wrong thing
  • Dive into carrier operational processes to find improvements that reduce manual effort and improve the economics of delegated authority business, translating what you find into detailed, precise specifications and ruthlessly prioritizing what is a must-have, nice-to-have, or irrelevant
  • Manage the carrier relationship from a technical standpoint — as the technical liaison pre-sale (discovery sessions, scoping integrations, demos and pilots) and as the product owner post-sale, helping carriers integrate AiDE into their existing workflows and staying accountable for their success long after go-live
  • Influence the culture, values, and processes of a growing product and engineering team
  • Enjoy and have fun being creative and thinking outside of the box. You will need to draw on analogous situations you’ve worked on before, but we are not traversing well-traveled roads. “Where we’re going, we don’t need roads!”

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in product or technical account roles within insurance, with meaningful exposure to the London market and delegated authority business
  • Working knowledge of bordereaux and cash book reconciliation, as well as a vision for where the market needs to go
  • A proven ability to interface with high value carrier customers and communicate with both technical and non-technical audiences alike
  • Strong enough technical skills (SQL, ideally Python) to be credible with engineers, interrogate data yourself, and pressure-test what is feasible
  • A track record of shipping high quality product at a high cadence and an ability to think through customer requirements and prioritize what is a must-have, nice-to-have, or irrelevant
  • A passion for building intuitive technology, a thirst for learning, and the willingness and ability to take over tasks outside your core competency

At Reserv, we value diversity in backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences and believe that diversity in viewpoints and critical thinking drives innovation, first-principles thinking, and success. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage those from all walks of life to apply. If you believe you are a good fit for this role, we would love to hear from you!

PTC Solutions Developer- Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: PTC Solutions Developer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
PositionType: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
ExperienceRequired: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced PTC Solutions Developer to design, develop, and support customizations, integrations, and enhancements on the Windchill PLM platform. In this role you will work closely with PLM functional consultants and engineering stakeholders to translate manufacturing and product-lifecycle requirements into well-engineered Windchill solutions. The ideal candidate will combine strong hands-on Windchill Java customization experience with practical knowledge of Windchill data models, workflows, and integration patterns. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and develop Windchill customizations using the Windchill Java API and PTC-recommended customization patterns.
  • Build custom listeners, services, and processors that extend Windchill behavior without compromising future upgrade paths.
  • Develop and configure Windchill workflows, lifecycle templates, and object initialization rules.
  • Implement custom Info*Engine tasks and adapters for system integration, applying disciplined engineering practices and partnering closely with stakeholders to ensure outcomes are durable, well-documented, and aligned with broader team and platform standards.
  • Build custom JSP and HTML client-side extensions where required, applying disciplined engineering practices and partnering closely with stakeholders to ensure outcomes are durable, well-documented, and aligned with broader team and platform standards.
  • Design and develop Windchill business reports using report templates and Cognos integration.
  • Configure and operate Windchill Customizer’s tools, RBINFO files, and OIRs.
  • Implement migration scripts for legacy PLM data into Windchill, applying disciplined engineering practices and partnering closely with stakeholders to ensure outcomes are durable, well-documented, and aligned with broader team and platform standards.
  • Optimize performance of custom code and database queries, working closely with DBAs.
  • Conduct fit-gap analyses and translate business requirements into clean technical designs.
  • Adhere strictly to PTC customization best practices to ease future upgrades.
  • Provide hypercare and post-go-live support, including issue triage and root-cause analysis.
  • Maintain comprehensive, current technical documentation — including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration references, runbooks, and operational procedures — so that the system remains supportable, auditable, and easy to onboard new engineers onto over time.
  • Mentor and coach junior and mid-level engineers through code review, design review, pair programming, and structured knowledge sharing, helping the broader team grow in technical maturity and confidence over time.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of PTC Windchill development experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience with the Windchill Java API.
  • Solid experience with workflows, lifecycle templates, and object initialization rules.
  • Working knowledge of Info*Engine and Windchill integration patterns.
  • Hands-on experience with JSP/HTML client customization.
  • Strong SQL skills and familiarity with the Windchill data model.
  • Experience with Windchill upgrades and migrations.
  • Excellent troubleshooting and documentation skills.

raw.description:
Medical Billing Account Manager – Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: Standard U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced Medical Billing Account Manager to support day-to-day Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) operations across medical billing, claims processing, denial management, insurance follow-up, collections, and client account management.

This is an execution-focused role for someone with hands-on medical billing experience who can independently manage a high volume of claims while maintaining accuracy, compliance, and timely reimbursement.

You’ll review EOBs and ERAs, investigate denials, submit and correct claims, work with insurance carriers, monitor aging accounts, and maintain accurate billing documentation across assigned client accounts.

If you understand the medical billing lifecycle, can troubleshoot claim and payment issues independently, and thrive in a fast-paced remote environment, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Medical Billing & Revenue Cycle Management

  • Review Explanation of Benefits (EOBs) and Electronic Remittance Advices (ERAs) to identify:
    • Payment discrepancies
    • Claim denials
    • Rejections
    • Underpayments
    • Non-payment reasons
  • Analyze, investigate, and resolve claim denials and rejections
  • Review claims to ensure proper diagnosis and procedure code linkage
  • Apply appropriate billing modifiers to support accurate claim adjudication
  • Perform claims scrubbing and quality assurance before submission
  • Submit:
    • Initial claims
    • Corrected claims
    • Secondary claims
  • Follow payer-specific submission requirements and guidelines
  • Manage claim queues and prioritize follow-up activities
  • Maintain accurate billing records, account documentation, and claim notes
  • Follow up promptly on unpaid, rejected, or underpaid claims

Denial Management & Claims Follow-Up

  • Investigate the root cause of denied or rejected claims
  • Research payer requirements and determine appropriate corrective actions
  • Correct claim issues and support timely resubmission
  • Follow outstanding claims through payment or resolution
  • Monitor claim status and reimbursement timelines
  • Maintain clear documentation of actions taken and next steps
  • Help reduce unnecessary delays throughout the revenue cycle

Account Management & Insurance Follow-Up

  • Research payer portals and insurance websites to resolve claim issues and obtain billing updates
  • Coordinate directly with insurance carriers regarding:
    • Claim status
    • Payment inquiries
    • Denials
    • Rejections
    • Outstanding balances
  • Support client account management and respond to billing-related questions as needed
  • Monitor aging accounts and assist with collections activities
  • Maintain consistent communication with clients, payers, and internal stakeholders
  • Ensure assigned accounts receive timely and accurate follow-up

Quality & Compliance

  • Maintain accuracy and compliance with payer guidelines and billing regulations
  • Meet established productivity, quality, and turnaround-time expectations
  • Maintain complete and accurate billing documentation
  • Identify recurring billing or denial trends
  • Recommend process improvements where appropriate
  • Work independently while maintaining a high level of accuracy and accountability

Requirements

  • Previous professional experience in Revenue Cycle Management (RCM)
  • Hands-on medical billing experience in a production environment
  • Strong knowledge of:
    • Claim submission
    • Denial management
    • Claims follow-up
    • Collections
  • Ability to read and interpret EOBs and ERAs
  • Experience reviewing diagnosis and procedure code relationships
  • Knowledge of billing modifiers and claims scrubbing processes
  • Experience working with insurance payer portals and billing systems
  • Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • Ability to independently manage assigned billing workflows with minimal supervision
  • Ability to maintain accuracy while handling a high volume of claims
  • Availability during standard U.S. business hours

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in high-volume medical billing environments
  • Experience supporting Texas-based medical practices
  • Experience with insurance verification and account management
  • Previous experience working remotely

EHR & Practice Management Systems

Experience with one or more of the following systems is highly preferred:

eClinicalWorks | Aprima | Medisoft | Veradigm | Nextech | CureMD | Office Practicum | NextGen

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Have extensive hands-on experience managing medical billing and RCM workflows
  • Can independently resolve claim denials and payment issues with minimal supervision
  • Understand how to interpret EOBs, ERAs, claim statuses, and payer responses
  • Are highly organized and comfortable managing a high volume of claims
  • Maintain accuracy even when working across multiple accounts and priorities
  • Follow unpaid and denied claims consistently until resolution
  • Communicate professionally with clients, insurance carriers, and internal teams
  • Take ownership of billing outcomes rather than simply completing tasks
  • Thrive in a remote environment and consistently meet productivity expectations

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You may start your day by reviewing claim queues, outstanding balances, denials, and accounts requiring immediate follow-up.

Throughout the day, you’ll review claim submissions, interpret EOBs and ERAs, resolve denials, follow up with insurance carriers, research payer requirements, submit corrected claims, update billing documentation, and monitor aging accounts.

You’ll also support assigned client accounts, investigate payment issues, and ensure claims continue progressing toward reimbursement.

In short: you help keep the revenue cycle moving by ensuring claims are accurate, denials are resolved, outstanding balances are followed up on, and reimbursement happens as efficiently as possible.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Claim submission accuracy
  • Denial and rejection resolution rate
  • Claims turnaround time
  • Reduction in aging accounts receivable
  • Collections and reimbursement performance
  • Timeliness of insurance follow-up
  • Accuracy of billing and account documentation
  • Productivity across assigned claim queues
  • Compliance with payer requirements
  • Client account satisfaction

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Direct impact on reimbursement and revenue-cycle performance
  • Hands-on ownership of medical billing and claims resolution
  • Exposure to multiple EHR and Practice Management systems
  • Opportunity to strengthen expertise across RCM, denial management, collections, and account management
  • Fully remote working environment
  • Opportunity to support established U.S. medical practices
  • Career growth opportunities into:
    • Senior Medical Billing Specialist
    • RCM Account Manager
    • Revenue Cycle Operations
    • Medical Billing Team Lead
    • RCM Management

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Recruiter Screening
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer Stage

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

What Happens After You Apply

After submitting your application and completing the required Spark Hire video interview, our recruitment team will review your experience and qualifications.

Candidates whose backgrounds closely match the requirements will be contacted to discuss their medical billing and Revenue Cycle Management experience in greater detail.

During the hiring process, you may be asked about your experience with medical billing software, denial management, claims follow-up, collections, payer communication, and the EHR or Practice Management systems you’ve used.

Candidates with experience supporting high-volume medical billing operations, particularly Texas-based practices, will receive strong consideration.

Apply Now

If you have hands-on experience in medical billing and Revenue Cycle Management, can independently manage claims and denials, and understand what it takes to drive timely reimbursement, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and bring your expertise in RCM, claims processing, denial management, insurance follow-up, and collections to a fast-moving remote environment.

Bilingual Patient Follow-Up Specialist

Remote | Personal Injury | Part-Time, 30 hours/week initially | $6.5/hour

About the Role

We are seeking a highly organized, dependable, and personable Bilingual Patient Follow-Up Specialist to support a growing personal injury medical practice.

The immediate priority for this role is addressing a significant backlog of patient follow-up calls. You will conduct outbound outreach, document patient recovery progress, support attorney and legal documentation requests, and help ensure that tasks are completed accurately and on time.

The ideal candidate combines strong medical assistant experience with excellent communication, persistence, accuracy, and the ability to handle sensitive patient and legal information with a very high level of attention to detail.

Key Responsibilities

Patient Follow-Up & Outreach

  • Contact patients approximately 4 to 6 weeks after their visit to check on their recovery and current condition.

  • Conduct consistent outbound outreach through calls, texts, or other approved channels while remaining professional and respectful.

  • Follow up persistently when patients are difficult to reach without becoming overly aggressive or pushy.

Symptom Tracking & Documentation

  • Complete structured follow-up questionnaires regarding symptoms such as headaches, dizziness, and other reported concerns.

  • Record patient responses accurately in the practice's dedicated symptom tracking database.

  • Maintain complete and organized documentation so the physician can easily review patient recovery progress.

Legal Records & Billing Requests

  • Respond to requests from attorneys and law firms for patient evaluations, medical records, and billing documentation.

  • Compile the correct records and ensure all requested information is complete before sending or uploading it.

  • Handle legal and medical documentation with extremely high accuracy because errors can directly affect personal injury cases.

Portal & Task Management

  • Upload completed evaluations, records, bills, and other requested documentation into designated attorney or client portals.

  • Track outstanding requests and completed tasks so documentation does not fall through the cracks.

  • Maintain organized records across the clinic's internal systems and external portals.

Reporting & Operational Reliability

  • Provide End-of-Day reports summarizing completed calls, outreach attempts, pending follow-ups, and finished tasks.

  • Maintain consistent follow-through on assigned responsibilities and communicate quickly when an issue could affect completion.

  • Prioritize accuracy and reliability, particularly when handling patient records, legal requests, and time-sensitive documentation.

Cross-Training & Practice Support

  • Learn the Scheduling & Intake Specialist's core workflows, including scheduling, patient intake, and patient communication.

  • Provide backup coverage when the other VMA is unavailable or when patient volume increases.

  • Assist with incoming calls, emails, patient questions, or administrative work when additional practice support is required.

Required Qualifications

  • Fully fluent in English and Spanish.

  • Previous experience as a Medical Assistant, Medical Receptionist, Virtual Medical Assistant, or similar healthcare support professional.

  • Strong understanding of medical terminology and patient communication.

  • Exceptional attention to detail when entering records or managing documentation.

  • Strong telephone communication skills with a warm, conversational, and patient-centered approach.

  • Comfortable performing frequent outbound patient calls and follow-ups.

  • Highly organized and capable of independently tracking multiple open tasks.

  • Able to work consistently during Mountain Time business hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience working with personal injury practices.

  • Experience communicating with attorneys or law firms.

  • Experience fulfilling medical records or billing documentation requests.

  • Familiarity with legal, clinic, or attorney portals.

Tools & Systems

  • Internal Clinic Symptom Database for documenting standardized patient follow-up responses and recovery symptoms.

  • External Law Firm/Clinic Portals for uploading completed evaluations, medical records, bills, and other requested documentation.

  • GoLean Productivity Tool and GoLean Private Network for productivity monitoring and secure access to practice systems and patient information.

What Success Looks Like

  • The existing patient follow-up backlog is steadily cleared, with patients contacted approximately 4 to 6 weeks after their visit and their recovery information documented accurately.

  • Attorney and law firm requests for evaluations, medical records, and billing documentation are completed accurately and on time, with the practice expecting effectively zero preventable errors.

  • Follow-ups, portal uploads, records requests, and outstanding tasks are consistently tracked through completion, with clear End-of-Day reporting and reliable backup coverage for scheduling and intake when needed.
