About us:

Airtm is a financial-infrastructure company building the future of the online-work economy. We are on a mission to empower the world's growing number of Digital Entrepreneurs in the Global South, giving them the financial freedom to thrive.
The problem is clear: in emerging markets, accessing the dollar economy is difficult. Cross-border payments are slow, expensive, and often lose value to inflation. This limits the potential of millions of talented individuals.
Airtm’s solution is a swift and comprehensive financial platform that facilitates low-value cross-border payments and local cash-outs. As pioneers in stablecoin-payment infrastructure, Airtm has built the most advanced cross-border payment system available on the market.
As a company married to the world of online work, Airtm will go beyond payments to build the necessary infrastructure the online-work economy needs to thrive. We are fostering an entirely new economy, giving individuals, communities, and countries the tools to take control of their financial destinies.

About the Role:

The Senior QA Engineer is responsible for ensuring the quality and reliability of the company's software products. This role involves close collaboration with product and engineering teams to define clear acceptance criteria, develop and execute comprehensive test strategies, and build robust automated testing frameworks for a modern web application and its backend services. The engineer plays a critical role in maintaining high standards for product releases and improving the overall quality assurance process, while actively pioneering the integration of AI and LLM tools into the testing lifecycle.

What you’ll be responsible for, the QA engineer:

-

  • Analyzes product specifications to derive comprehensive and testable acceptance criteria.

  • Collaborates with product managers and developers to clarify requirements and identify potential edge cases.

  • Designs, implements, and maintains a robust suite of automated tests, including end-to-end, integration, and regression tests.

  • Performs manual testing for complex or new features prior to the establishment of full automation coverage.

  • Monitors, analyzes, and improves test coverage, reliability, and performance over time.

  • Contributes to the continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) process by integrating automated tests into the deployment pipeline.

  • Enhances overall product quality by creating detailed bug reports, providing constructive feedback, and maintaining clear testing documentation.

  • Designs and deploys AI-assisted testing workflows to automate recurring tasks such as test case generation, test data synthesis, and log analysis.

  • Evaluates and integrates LLM-based testing and coding tools into the QA team's workflow, assessing their reliability, accuracy, and fitness for automated testing and edge-case discovery use cases.

Experience and skills required:

-

  • Proven experience as a Senior QA Engineer (5+ Years of experience) or similar role, specifically testing modern web applications and backend services.

  • Strong proficiency with test automation frameworks such as Cypress, Playwright, or similar tools.

  • Deep understanding of backend services, APIs (REST and GraphQL), and their common failure scenarios.

  • Ability to read and comprehend frontend and backend code to assist in debugging and test creation.

  • Familiarity with version control systems (Git) and CI/CD tools and processes.

  • Hands-on experience with AI agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, or similar) and demonstrated ability to build, deploy, or thoroughly validate agent-assisted testing systems in a near-production context.

  • Proactive and highly detail-oriented mindset.

  • Advanced proficiency in the English language.

Applicants must be based in South, North or Central America
(applications from other locations will not be considered).
This is a fully remote role, reporting to our Tech Lead.

raw.description:
About Reserv

Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. Founded by insurtech veterans with deep experience in SaaS and digital claims, Reserv is venture-backed by Bain Capital and Altai Ventures and began operations in May 2022. We are focused on automating highly manual tasks to tackle long-standing problems in claims and set a new standard for TPAs, insurance technology providers, and adjusters alike. We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need people who can work in an evolving environment. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can't wait to meet you.

As the Product Development Lead for AiDE, Reserv Inc.’s newest initiative, you will be defining a new product line and its growth potential for years to come. AiDE was created to bring Reserv’s in house claim technology to market participants via a simple cost plus model. You will sit at the intersection of our carrier customers, the London market, and our engineering team — helping drive the product roadmap and acting as a liaison to customers as they transition their operational process to AiDE’s offerings.

For this role, we are seeking a product-minded insurance technologist who knows the London market intimately and is comfortable going deep on data. This role will require you to be the technical face of AiDE with carriers, translate market needs into a prioritized roadmap, and work hand in hand with engineering and product management to ship products that drive outcomes for carriers.

What you will do

  • Partner with AiDE’s product manager to shape the roadmap, serving as the team’s London market expert — you bring the domain knowledge of carrier and delegated authority workflows, BDX reporting, and the practical realities of where the two break down
  • Apply that market experience to a new product offering where features must be based on informed hypotheses versus solid customer feedback — anticipating carrier needs they haven’t yet articulated and helping the team avoid building the wrong thing
  • Dive into carrier operational processes to find improvements that reduce manual effort and improve the economics of delegated authority business, translating what you find into detailed, precise specifications and ruthlessly prioritizing what is a must-have, nice-to-have, or irrelevant
  • Manage the carrier relationship from a technical standpoint — as the technical liaison pre-sale (discovery sessions, scoping integrations, demos and pilots) and as the product owner post-sale, helping carriers integrate AiDE into their existing workflows and staying accountable for their success long after go-live
  • Influence the culture, values, and processes of a growing product and engineering team
  • Enjoy and have fun being creative and thinking outside of the box. You will need to draw on analogous situations you’ve worked on before, but we are not traversing well-traveled roads. “Where we’re going, we don’t need roads!”

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in product or technical account roles within insurance, with meaningful exposure to the London market and delegated authority business
  • Working knowledge of bordereaux and cash book reconciliation, as well as a vision for where the market needs to go
  • A proven ability to interface with high value carrier customers and communicate with both technical and non-technical audiences alike
  • Strong enough technical skills (SQL, ideally Python) to be credible with engineers, interrogate data yourself, and pressure-test what is feasible
  • A track record of shipping high quality product at a high cadence and an ability to think through customer requirements and prioritize what is a must-have, nice-to-have, or irrelevant
  • A passion for building intuitive technology, a thirst for learning, and the willingness and ability to take over tasks outside your core competency

At Reserv, we value diversity in backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences and believe that diversity in viewpoints and critical thinking drives innovation, first-principles thinking, and success. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage those from all walks of life to apply. If you believe you are a good fit for this role, we would love to hear from you!

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced PTC Solutions Developer to design, develop, and support customizations, integrations, and enhancements on the Windchill PLM platform. In this role you will work closely with PLM functional consultants and engineering stakeholders to translate manufacturing and product-lifecycle requirements into well-engineered Windchill solutions. The ideal candidate will combine strong hands-on Windchill Java customization experience with practical knowledge of Windchill data models, workflows, and integration patterns. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and develop Windchill customizations using the Windchill Java API and PTC-recommended customization patterns.
  • Build custom listeners, services, and processors that extend Windchill behavior without compromising future upgrade paths.
  • Develop and configure Windchill workflows, lifecycle templates, and object initialization rules.
  • Implement custom Info*Engine tasks and adapters for system integration, applying disciplined engineering practices and partnering closely with stakeholders to ensure outcomes are durable, well-documented, and aligned with broader team and platform standards.
  • Build custom JSP and HTML client-side extensions where required, applying disciplined engineering practices and partnering closely with stakeholders to ensure outcomes are durable, well-documented, and aligned with broader team and platform standards.
  • Design and develop Windchill business reports using report templates and Cognos integration.
  • Configure and operate Windchill Customizer’s tools, RBINFO files, and OIRs.
  • Implement migration scripts for legacy PLM data into Windchill, applying disciplined engineering practices and partnering closely with stakeholders to ensure outcomes are durable, well-documented, and aligned with broader team and platform standards.
  • Optimize performance of custom code and database queries, working closely with DBAs.
  • Conduct fit-gap analyses and translate business requirements into clean technical designs.
  • Adhere strictly to PTC customization best practices to ease future upgrades.
  • Provide hypercare and post-go-live support, including issue triage and root-cause analysis.
  • Maintain comprehensive, current technical documentation — including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration references, runbooks, and operational procedures — so that the system remains supportable, auditable, and easy to onboard new engineers onto over time.
  • Mentor and coach junior and mid-level engineers through code review, design review, pair programming, and structured knowledge sharing, helping the broader team grow in technical maturity and confidence over time.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of PTC Windchill development experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience with the Windchill Java API.
  • Solid experience with workflows, lifecycle templates, and object initialization rules.
  • Working knowledge of Info*Engine and Windchill integration patterns.
  • Hands-on experience with JSP/HTML client customization.
  • Strong SQL skills and familiarity with the Windchill data model.
  • Experience with Windchill upgrades and migrations.
  • Excellent troubleshooting and documentation skills.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • PTC Windchill certifications.
  • Experience with Creo, Arbortext, or related PTC products.
  • Exposure to Windchill RV&S (Integrity) or ThingWorx integration.
  • Familiarity with CAD data management workflows.

raw.description:
Medical Billing Account Manager – Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: Standard U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced Medical Billing Account Manager to support day-to-day Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) operations across medical billing, claims processing, denial management, insurance follow-up, collections, and client account management.

This is an execution-focused role for someone with hands-on medical billing experience who can independently manage a high volume of claims while maintaining accuracy, compliance, and timely reimbursement.

You’ll review EOBs and ERAs, investigate denials, submit and correct claims, work with insurance carriers, monitor aging accounts, and maintain accurate billing documentation across assigned client accounts.

If you understand the medical billing lifecycle, can troubleshoot claim and payment issues independently, and thrive in a fast-paced remote environment, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Medical Billing & Revenue Cycle Management

  • Review Explanation of Benefits (EOBs) and Electronic Remittance Advices (ERAs) to identify:
    • Payment discrepancies
    • Claim denials
    • Rejections
    • Underpayments
    • Non-payment reasons
  • Analyze, investigate, and resolve claim denials and rejections
  • Review claims to ensure proper diagnosis and procedure code linkage
  • Apply appropriate billing modifiers to support accurate claim adjudication
  • Perform claims scrubbing and quality assurance before submission
  • Submit:
    • Initial claims
    • Corrected claims
    • Secondary claims
  • Follow payer-specific submission requirements and guidelines
  • Manage claim queues and prioritize follow-up activities
  • Maintain accurate billing records, account documentation, and claim notes
  • Follow up promptly on unpaid, rejected, or underpaid claims

Denial Management & Claims Follow-Up

  • Investigate the root cause of denied or rejected claims
  • Research payer requirements and determine appropriate corrective actions
  • Correct claim issues and support timely resubmission
  • Follow outstanding claims through payment or resolution
  • Monitor claim status and reimbursement timelines
  • Maintain clear documentation of actions taken and next steps
  • Help reduce unnecessary delays throughout the revenue cycle

Account Management & Insurance Follow-Up

  • Research payer portals and insurance websites to resolve claim issues and obtain billing updates
  • Coordinate directly with insurance carriers regarding:
    • Claim status
    • Payment inquiries
    • Denials
    • Rejections
    • Outstanding balances
  • Support client account management and respond to billing-related questions as needed
  • Monitor aging accounts and assist with collections activities
  • Maintain consistent communication with clients, payers, and internal stakeholders
  • Ensure assigned accounts receive timely and accurate follow-up

Quality & Compliance

  • Maintain accuracy and compliance with payer guidelines and billing regulations
  • Meet established productivity, quality, and turnaround-time expectations
  • Maintain complete and accurate billing documentation
  • Identify recurring billing or denial trends
  • Recommend process improvements where appropriate
  • Work independently while maintaining a high level of accuracy and accountability

Requirements

  • Previous professional experience in Revenue Cycle Management (RCM)
  • Hands-on medical billing experience in a production environment
  • Strong knowledge of:
    • Claim submission
    • Denial management
    • Claims follow-up
    • Collections
  • Ability to read and interpret EOBs and ERAs
  • Experience reviewing diagnosis and procedure code relationships
  • Knowledge of billing modifiers and claims scrubbing processes
  • Experience working with insurance payer portals and billing systems
  • Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • Ability to independently manage assigned billing workflows with minimal supervision
  • Ability to maintain accuracy while handling a high volume of claims
  • Availability during standard U.S. business hours

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in high-volume medical billing environments
  • Experience supporting Texas-based medical practices
  • Experience with insurance verification and account management
  • Previous experience working remotely

EHR & Practice Management Systems

Experience with one or more of the following systems is highly preferred:

eClinicalWorks | Aprima | Medisoft | Veradigm | Nextech | CureMD | Office Practicum | NextGen

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Have extensive hands-on experience managing medical billing and RCM workflows
  • Can independently resolve claim denials and payment issues with minimal supervision
  • Understand how to interpret EOBs, ERAs, claim statuses, and payer responses
  • Are highly organized and comfortable managing a high volume of claims
  • Maintain accuracy even when working across multiple accounts and priorities
  • Follow unpaid and denied claims consistently until resolution
  • Communicate professionally with clients, insurance carriers, and internal teams
  • Take ownership of billing outcomes rather than simply completing tasks
  • Thrive in a remote environment and consistently meet productivity expectations

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You may start your day by reviewing claim queues, outstanding balances, denials, and accounts requiring immediate follow-up.

Throughout the day, you’ll review claim submissions, interpret EOBs and ERAs, resolve denials, follow up with insurance carriers, research payer requirements, submit corrected claims, update billing documentation, and monitor aging accounts.

You’ll also support assigned client accounts, investigate payment issues, and ensure claims continue progressing toward reimbursement.

In short: you help keep the revenue cycle moving by ensuring claims are accurate, denials are resolved, outstanding balances are followed up on, and reimbursement happens as efficiently as possible.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Claim submission accuracy
  • Denial and rejection resolution rate
  • Claims turnaround time
  • Reduction in aging accounts receivable
  • Collections and reimbursement performance
  • Timeliness of insurance follow-up
  • Accuracy of billing and account documentation
  • Productivity across assigned claim queues
  • Compliance with payer requirements
  • Client account satisfaction

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Direct impact on reimbursement and revenue-cycle performance
  • Hands-on ownership of medical billing and claims resolution
  • Exposure to multiple EHR and Practice Management systems
  • Opportunity to strengthen expertise across RCM, denial management, collections, and account management
  • Fully remote working environment
  • Opportunity to support established U.S. medical practices
  • Career growth opportunities into:
    • Senior Medical Billing Specialist
    • RCM Account Manager
    • Revenue Cycle Operations
    • Medical Billing Team Lead
    • RCM Management

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Recruiter Screening
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer Stage

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

What Happens After You Apply

After submitting your application and completing the required Spark Hire video interview, our recruitment team will review your experience and qualifications.

Candidates whose backgrounds closely match the requirements will be contacted to discuss their medical billing and Revenue Cycle Management experience in greater detail.

During the hiring process, you may be asked about your experience with medical billing software, denial management, claims follow-up, collections, payer communication, and the EHR or Practice Management systems you’ve used.

Candidates with experience supporting high-volume medical billing operations, particularly Texas-based practices, will receive strong consideration.

Apply Now

If you have hands-on experience in medical billing and Revenue Cycle Management, can independently manage claims and denials, and understand what it takes to drive timely reimbursement, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and bring your expertise in RCM, claims processing, denial management, insurance follow-up, and collections to a fast-moving remote environment.

Bilingual Patient Follow-Up Specialist

Remote | Personal Injury | Part-Time, 30 hours/week initially | $6.5/hour

About the Role

We are seeking a highly organized, dependable, and personable Bilingual Patient Follow-Up Specialist to support a growing personal injury medical practice.

The immediate priority for this role is addressing a significant backlog of patient follow-up calls. You will conduct outbound outreach, document patient recovery progress, support attorney and legal documentation requests, and help ensure that tasks are completed accurately and on time.

The ideal candidate combines strong medical assistant experience with excellent communication, persistence, accuracy, and the ability to handle sensitive patient and legal information with a very high level of attention to detail.

Key Responsibilities

Patient Follow-Up & Outreach

  • Contact patients approximately 4 to 6 weeks after their visit to check on their recovery and current condition.

  • Conduct consistent outbound outreach through calls, texts, or other approved channels while remaining professional and respectful.

  • Follow up persistently when patients are difficult to reach without becoming overly aggressive or pushy.

Symptom Tracking & Documentation

  • Complete structured follow-up questionnaires regarding symptoms such as headaches, dizziness, and other reported concerns.

  • Record patient responses accurately in the practice's dedicated symptom tracking database.

  • Maintain complete and organized documentation so the physician can easily review patient recovery progress.

Legal Records & Billing Requests

  • Respond to requests from attorneys and law firms for patient evaluations, medical records, and billing documentation.

  • Compile the correct records and ensure all requested information is complete before sending or uploading it.

  • Handle legal and medical documentation with extremely high accuracy because errors can directly affect personal injury cases.

Portal & Task Management

  • Upload completed evaluations, records, bills, and other requested documentation into designated attorney or client portals.

  • Track outstanding requests and completed tasks so documentation does not fall through the cracks.

  • Maintain organized records across the clinic's internal systems and external portals.

Reporting & Operational Reliability

  • Provide End-of-Day reports summarizing completed calls, outreach attempts, pending follow-ups, and finished tasks.

  • Maintain consistent follow-through on assigned responsibilities and communicate quickly when an issue could affect completion.

  • Prioritize accuracy and reliability, particularly when handling patient records, legal requests, and time-sensitive documentation.

Cross-Training & Practice Support

  • Learn the Scheduling & Intake Specialist's core workflows, including scheduling, patient intake, and patient communication.

  • Provide backup coverage when the other VMA is unavailable or when patient volume increases.

  • Assist with incoming calls, emails, patient questions, or administrative work when additional practice support is required.

Required Qualifications

  • Fully fluent in English and Spanish.

  • Previous experience as a Medical Assistant, Medical Receptionist, Virtual Medical Assistant, or similar healthcare support professional.

  • Strong understanding of medical terminology and patient communication.

  • Exceptional attention to detail when entering records or managing documentation.

  • Strong telephone communication skills with a warm, conversational, and patient-centered approach.

  • Comfortable performing frequent outbound patient calls and follow-ups.

  • Highly organized and capable of independently tracking multiple open tasks.

  • Able to work consistently during Mountain Time business hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience working with personal injury practices.

  • Experience communicating with attorneys or law firms.

  • Experience fulfilling medical records or billing documentation requests.

  • Familiarity with legal, clinic, or attorney portals.

Tools & Systems

  • Internal Clinic Symptom Database for documenting standardized patient follow-up responses and recovery symptoms.

  • External Law Firm/Clinic Portals for uploading completed evaluations, medical records, bills, and other requested documentation.

  • GoLean Productivity Tool and GoLean Private Network for productivity monitoring and secure access to practice systems and patient information.

What Success Looks Like

  • The existing patient follow-up backlog is steadily cleared, with patients contacted approximately 4 to 6 weeks after their visit and their recovery information documented accurately.

  • Attorney and law firm requests for evaluations, medical records, and billing documentation are completed accurately and on time, with the practice expecting effectively zero preventable errors.

  • Follow-ups, portal uploads, records requests, and outstanding tasks are consistently tracked through completion, with clear End-of-Day reporting and reliable backup coverage for scheduling and intake when needed.

About HighLevel:HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our People:
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our Impact:
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

Responsibilities:

    Why this role exists :

    We are looking for a Director, Product Strategy & Operations – Product Adoption to drive how customers discover, adopt, engage with, and derive value from HighLevel’s products and capabilities.

    This role will sit at the intersection of Product Strategy, Product Management, Growth, Customer Success, Data, and Operations. The primary mandate is to identify adoption gaps across the customer journey, translate data and customer insights into clear strategic priorities, and partner with product teams to improve activation, feature adoption, engagement, retention, and expansion.

    This is not a traditional program management or product operations role. We are looking for someone who can combine strategic thinking, strong analytical depth, customer understanding, and execution to influence product roadmaps and materially improve adoption across the platform

What You'll Do

    Product Adoption Strategy

    • Define and drive HighLevel’s product adoption strategy across key products, features, and customer segments.
    • Identify the biggest barriers preventing customers from discovering, activating, and repeatedly using high-value capabilities.
    • Develop frameworks to measure adoption across the customer lifecycle—from onboarding and activation through sustained engagement and expansion.
    • Prioritize adoption opportunities based on customer impact, business value, and strategic importance.

      • Adoption & Growth Analytics

      • Establish clear adoption metrics and success criteria for strategic product initiatives.
      • Analyze customer journeys, funnels, cohorts, feature usage, and behavioral patterns to identify opportunities and friction points.
      • Partner with Data and Product teams to understand time-to-value, activation, feature penetration, engagement, retention, and churn.
      • Segment adoption by customer type, cohort, geography, product, and use case to uncover actionable insights.
      • Build executive-level visibility into product adoption performance and emerging risks.

        • Product Strategy & Roadmap Influence

        • Translate adoption insights into actionable product recommendations.
        • Partner with Product leaders to influence roadmaps based on customer behavior, adoption gaps, and business priorities.
        • Identify opportunities where onboarding, UX, education, packaging, cross-product journeys, or product capabilities need to change to improve adoption.
        • Develop business cases for high-impact adoption initiatives and help teams prioritize investments.

          • Cross-Functional Execution

          • Partner closely with Product, Design, Engineering, Data, Marketing, Customer Success, Support, and Revenue teams.
          • Drive cross-functional initiatives aimed at increasing adoption of strategic product capabilities.
          • Create clear ownership, operating rhythms, metrics, and accountability for adoption initiatives.
          • Ensure product launches go beyond shipping by defining how new capabilities will achieve meaningful customer adoption.

            • Customer & Market Insights

            • Develop a deep understanding of customer needs, workflows, pain points, and reasons for non-adoption.
            • Combine quantitative product data with qualitative customer insights to identify root causes.
            • Partner with customer-facing teams to establish systematic feedback loops into Product.
            • Benchmark adoption and customer experience against relevant SaaS and technology platforms.

What Success Looks Like

    Success in this role will be measured by the ability to:

    • Increase activation and adoption of strategic product capabilities.
    • Improve time-to-value for new and existing customers.
    • Increase feature penetration and depth of product usage.
    • Improve engagement and repeat usage of high-value workflows.
    • Reduce adoption-related friction and early customer drop-off.
    • Establish measurable relationships between product adoption and retention, expansion, and customer value.
    • Build a scalable operating model for measuring and improving adoption across HighLevel.

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • 12+ years of experience across Product Strategy, Growth, Product Management, Product Operations, Strategy & Operations, or related functions, with meaningful leadership experience.
  • Strong experience driving product adoption, activation, engagement, retention, or product-led growth within a technology/SaaS business.
  • Demonstrated ability to use product and customer data to identify problems and drive strategic decisions.
  • Strong understanding of funnels, cohorts, segmentation, experimentation, retention, and customer lifecycle metrics.
  • Track record of influencing Product roadmaps and senior stakeholders without relying solely on direct authority.
  • Ability to move comfortably between executive-level strategy and hands-on problem solving.
  • Experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives with measurable business outcomes.
  • Strong communication and storytelling skills, particularly when translating complex data into clear recommendations.
  • Experience with B2B SaaS, SMB products, platform businesses, or multi-product ecosystems is highly preferred.

EEO Statement:

The company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. As an employer subject to affirmative action regulations, we invite you to voluntarily provide the following demographic information. This information is used solely for compliance with government recordkeeping, reporting, and other legal requirements. Providing this information is voluntary and refusal to do so will not affect your application status. This data will be kept separate from your application and will not be used in the hiring decision.

We encourage you to review our Privacy Policy before submitting your application

VP, People

Backblaze (Nasdaq: BLZE) | Reports to the CHRO | Remote, US-based

Salary range: $210,000 - $230,000, plus 30% target annual bonus and RSUs

How We Got Here

Backblaze is the object storage leader in the open cloud movement, fueling customer success with cloud storage built purposefully to unlock budgets, unburden administrators, and unleash innovators. Together with our partners, we're helping customers break free from the restrictive, overpriced legacy solutions that hold them back, and blaze forward with the full power of the open cloud in their hands.

We started by building storage servers from scratch in a Palo Alto apartment to save 90% on hardware. Turns out hard constraints make for pretty good engineering. That discipline forged a platform that performs as well or better than competitors, scales to multi-exabyte workloads, and costs a fraction of what AWS or Google charge. AI infrastructure runs on data. Storage gets hard at scale. We've been breaking, rebuilding, and improving that storage layer for 20 years.

Today, the world's leading AI infrastructure providers, neoclouds, and data-intensive businesses run on Backblaze. Our platform includes:

  • B2 Overdrive - high-throughput object storage engineered for AI infrastructure, GPU workloads, and massive-scale data pipelines
  • B2 Neo - white-label enterprise cloud storage powering neocloud platforms for AI, HPC, and media
  • B2 Cloud Storage - S3-compatible object storage with predictable pricing, free egress, and no lock-in
  • Computer Backup - automatic, continuous endpoint backup for Macs and PCs

500,000+ customers. 175 countries. Nasdaq: BLZE. backblaze.com

The Role

We need a builder to run People at a public, remote-first company scaling through roughly the 500-1000 range while expanding internationally. You'll design the systems that make Backblaze a great place to work when there's no office doing that job for us - engagement, culture, communications, retention, succession, and manager development - and you'll run a small HR Operations and strategic HRBP team to do it.

This isn't a maintenance role. The operational foundation is already in place; you'll build the next layer on top of it, with your team, using AI agents as part of how the work gets done. If your instinct is to scope a vendor and a project plan, or disappear for six weeks and come back with a deck, this isn't the right fit. If your instinct is to open a doc, pull your team in, and start building the first version together, keep reading.

What You Will Own

Build

  • Making Backblaze an even better place to work when there is no office carrying it for us. That means designing connection, belonging, and teamwork into how the company operates rather than hoping they happen on their own.
  • Engagement as a leader-owned discipline with outcomes, not a survey followed by silence. People want to connect their work to where the company is going. You build the system that makes that real.
  • Strategic employee and leader communications: a standing rhythm that gives people line of sight to the strategy, tells the same story every quarter, and makes sure information reaches every geography and every time zone.
  • Culture as a design output. We are remote-first, expanding internationally, and growing fast. Connection, recognition, and belonging stop happening by accident at this stage. If we do not design them, distance designs them for us. Onboarding, team rituals, and the few in-person moments a year get designed and budgeted like anything else that matters.
  • Remote working excellence: one company, many geographies. Same expectations, same development, same voice in the room, wherever someone sits. Offshore is where we hire, not a tier of employees.
  • Retention and succession: knowing who is at risk before they resign, building the bench underneath key roles, and making sure we are not one resignation away from a gap we cannot fill.
  • A learning organization: manager capability rebuilt for distributed teams, internal mobility, cross-functional movement, and development that survives contact with a busy quarter. What it means to be a manager at Backblaze is changing as spans widen, AI reshapes teams, and most managers rarely see their people. You rewrite those expectations.
  • Partnering with our AI Transformation Leader on how AI changes work design, job architecture, and team structure across the company.

Own

You will run a small, high-impact HR Operations and strategic HRBP team. The operational foundation is already in place. You inherit it, make sure it stays clean, and evolve it as we scale internationally.

What You Will Personally Build in Year One

Build - but build with the team, not over them. The point is not to arrive with finished answers. It is to bring people into the work, raise their skills along the way, and communicate constantly so the whole team understands what is being built and why.

  • The engagement program and the operating rhythm behind it, designed so leaders own the outcomes, not HR
  • How remote teams work here, written down and adopted, not aspirational. Recognition that reaches people in every geography and every time zone.
  • The employee and leader communications cadence that gives people a clear line of sight to the strategy
  • The retention model and the succession plan, including what we do with what they tell us
  • The manager development approach for a company where managers rarely see their people and where what it means to manage is being rewritten
  • The design of our in-person moments: offsites, team gatherings, and the few times a year people are in a room together

What We Are Looking For

Required

  • You have operated teams outside the United States. EOR or owned entities both count. What matters is that you have managed the reality of employing people in other countries, not that you have read about it. We are expanding internationally and the pace is accelerating.
  • You have scaled a company through roughly this stage - somewhere in the 500-1000 range, with international arriving partway through. You have seen what breaks. We are building critical AI infrastructure, expanding globally, and the thesis is more output per person from a more distributed, more AI-enabled workforce.
  • You are a builder who builds with people, not around them. You have written the framework, run the session, built the thing - recently, with your own hands - and you brought your team along while doing it. You develop people through work, not separate from it.
  • You use AI agents in your daily work. This is a filter, not a preference. We are 250+ people on Claude Enterprise, our managers will be running blended human and agent teams in 2027.
  • You lead a team and are still close enough to the work to know when it is good.
  • You care about making a company a great place to work and you know how to do it when people are distributed across geographies, time zones, and cultures.

Also True of the Right Person

  • Comfortable that this is a public company, without needing to have run a proxy. You will not be surprised by comp committee timing, disclosure windows, or audit season, but the CHRO owns that work.
  • Coming from a strong mid-sized technology company rather than a large enterprise. Not a rule, but the pattern matters: we need someone who has built in conditions of scarcity, not someone who has run a function with a large team and a large budget already in place.
  • Either a first-time VP ready to step up or a second-time VP who wants to build rather than administer. We care about the person, not the number of times they have held the title.
  • A strong communicator who over-communicates by instinct. In a remote company, silence is the default and it is corrosive.

This Is Not the Role for You If

  • Your strength is running an established function well and you want a bigger version of that
  • You need a large team to be effective
  • You do not default to building and running POCs
  • You want to spend most of your time on executive comp and board work
  • You think culture is a benefits problem or an office problem rather than a design problem

How We Will Interview

We will ask you to bring something you built, walk us through the version that did not work, and tell us what you would do differently. We will ask how you use AI in your own work, specifically. And you will spend real time with the HRBPs and HR Ops team, because they will work with you every day and their read matters.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation and equity package
  • Full benefits including medical, dental, vision, and 401(k) with matching
  • RSU grants for full-time employees
  • ESPP program
  • Flexible vacation policy
  • Maternity & paternity leave
  • MacBook to use for work, plus a generous stipend to personalize your workstation
  • Childcare bonus (human children only)
  • Fertility treatment and support
  • Learning & development program
  • Commuter benefits
  • A collaborative and transparent culture that supports a healthy work-life balance

Pay Transparency

To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base pay ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate location, skills, depth of work experience, and relevant licenses/credentials.

The expected salary range for this role is $210,000 - $230,000 plus 30% target annual bonus and RSUs.

At Backblaze, we value being fair and good to our customers, partners, and employees. Diversity, equity, and inclusion are at the core of our values. We are committed to fostering a workforce where all employees feel a sense of belonging regardless of race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, socio-economic status, ability, veteran status, and education. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

raw.description:
Who are Evotix?

We're a growing global EHS SaaS company with a clear ambition: to combine world-class software, data and AI to help our customers operate smarter, safer and more efficiently. For exceptional talent, Evotix offers something rare-the pace of a growth company, the scale to make a real difference, and the opportunity to influence strategy, technology and outcomes at a global level.

At Evotix, we're creating the future of workplace health, safety and wellbeing—and we need ELITE people to help us do it. People who pursue Excellence, show Leadership, deliver Impact, earn Trust, and Empower those around them.

The Role

The Vice President of Sales - EMEA is accountable for the region's new business strategy and performance. This role translates Evotix's growth priorities into a focused go-to-market plan, clear operating rhythms and consistent execution across EMEA.

You will lead and develop the EMEA sales organisation, partnering closely with Business Development and Marketing to build pipeline, improve conversion and win the right customers.

Success will be measured through sustainable revenue growth, forecast accuracy, sales productivity and the strength of the regional team.

What You'll Do

Set EMEA Sales Strategy

  • Own and execute the EMEA sales strategy in line with company goals, target markets and customer needs.
  • Turn regional priorities into clear coverage, capacity, territory and account plans.
  • Use market, customer and performance insight to focus investment and adapt the regional approach.
  • Provide the CEO and leadership team with clear recommendations on growth opportunities, risks and trade-offs.

Deliver Predictable Revenue Growth

  • Take accountability for EMEA new business performance and agreed revenue outcomes.
  • Set clear targets and leading indicators, reviewing progress regularly and acting early where performance is off track.
  • Build disciplined opportunity management and deal review practices that improve conversion and sales cycle effectiveness.
  • Maintain a credible forecast based on evidence, customer progress and well-defined next steps.
  • Partner with Marketing and BDR leadership to create sufficient, high-quality pipeline across priority segments and territories.

Lead and Develop the Sales Organisation

  • Build a high-performing, inclusive EMEA sales organisation with clear roles, expectations and accountability.
  • Coach sales leaders and individual contributors to improve commercial judgement, customer engagement and execution.
  • Make effective hiring, onboarding, performance and succession decisions in partnership with relevant stakeholders.
  • Create a consistent operating cadence for one-to-ones, pipeline reviews, forecasting, coaching and performance management.
  • Foster a culture aligned with Evotix's ELITE principles: Excellence, Leadership, Impact, Trust and Empowerment.

Strengthen Go-to-Market Alignment

  • Align Sales, BDRs and Marketing around target customers, messaging, campaigns, qualification and handover points.
  • Work cross-functionally to ensure customer feedback and market insight shape go-to-market decisions.
  • Establish clear ownership and service expectations across the revenue funnel, resolving barriers to execution quickly.
  • Represent EMEA sales priorities in company planning and communicate decisions clearly to the regional team.

Build Strategic Customer and Market Relationships

  • Act as an executive sponsor for strategic opportunities and customer relationships where senior involvement adds value.
  • Support the team on complex negotiations while maintaining commercial discipline and long-term customer value.
  • Develop a strong understanding of EMEA market dynamics, buyer priorities and competitive positioning.
  • Represent Evotix credibly with customers, partners and relevant market communities.

What You Bring

Essential

  • Senior sales leadership experience with accountability for regional or multi-market revenue performance in B2B software or SaaS.
  • Evidence of building and executing a sales strategy that delivered sustainable growth and improved commercial performance.
  • Experience leading, coaching and developing sales leaders and teams across different EMEA markets.
  • Strong command of forecasting, pipeline management, sales methodology and performance metrics.
  • Experience working with BDR and Marketing teams to build pipeline and improve go-to-market execution.
  • Commercial judgement and executive presence, with the ability to lead complex customer conversations and negotiations.
  • Clear, evidence-based communication and the ability to influence senior stakeholders, challenge constructively and make decisions.
  • Ability to lead effectively in a remote, international environment and travel within EMEA when business needs require it.

Desirable

  • Experience selling enterprise software into regulated, operationally complex or safety-critical organisations.
  • Knowledge of EHS, ESG, risk or compliance technology markets.
  • Experience scaling a sales organisation through a period of change or growth.
  • Experience with partner, channel or alliance-led routes to market.

Please note that Evotix is unable to offer visa sponsorship. You must have the legal right to work in the country where the role is based at the time of application.

Interview Process

We aim to keep our interview process transparent, fair, and respectful of your time. While steps may vary slightly by role, you can typically expect:

  • Initial chat: A conversation with a member of our Talent team to learn more about your background, motivations, and answer any initial questions.
  • Hiring Manager interview: A role-focused discussion exploring your experience, skills, and how you approach real-world scenarios relevant to the role.
  • Key Stakeholder interview: A discussion with a member of senior leadership in another department that you will be working with should you join.
  • Final Panel interview: A conversation with key stakeholders to dive deeper into collaboration, alignment, and mutual fit. This stage may involve a Case Study or Presentation to allow you to show off your skills!
  • Offer: If successful, we’ll move quickly to share an offer and next steps.

We’re happy to make reasonable adjustments at any stage of the process — just let us know what you need.

Why join Evotix?

  • Competitive Compensation: Enjoy a competitive base salary and commission plan.
  • Time to Recharge: Unlimited Annual Leave because we trust you to balance your work and wellbeing.
  • Support for You: Access to our Employee Assistance Program, including mental health, legal, and financial guidance.
  • Growth Opportunities: Educational benefits to help you keep learning and growing.
  • Team Culture: Regular team events, an inclusive environment, and a shared commitment to making an impact.

Ready to Make a Difference?
If you’re a bold, results-driven leader who thrives on challenges, loves scaling success, and is passionate about making a difference—we want to hear from you!

Thank you for your interest. Please note, we are not seeking support from external recruitment agencies at this time. Direct applications from candidates are warmly welcomed.

raw.excerpt: About ProductVyOS is an open-source network operating system that provides an all-in-one platform for network management.
raw.description:
About Product

VyOS is an open-source network operating system that provides an all-in-one platform for network management. Built on Linux, VyOS integrates powerful routing, firewall, VPN, and network services into a unified system. Unlike traditional networking hardware, VyOS can be deployed on a wide range of platforms, from physical routers and cloud environments to virtual machines, giving users flexibility and control over their network infrastructure.

The key strength of VyOS lies in its comprehensive feature set. It supports dynamic routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, RIP), multiple VPN types (IPsec, OpenVPN, WireGuard), firewall rules, traffic shaping, and more - all configured through a unified command-line interface (CLI) familiar to network engineers. Its ability to scale across various environments makes it popular with organizations seeking open-source networking solutions.

Job description

The Content Marketing Manager owns the content lifecycle end-to-end: planning, writing, editing, publishing, and measuring. Today, content publication at VyOS requires a web developer; this role closes that gap. The Content Marketing Manager works directly in the headless CMS (DatoCMS) and blog platform (HubSpot), turning drafts, customer interviews, and product updates into published pages without engineering involvement, executing the content strategy, messaging, and campaign priorities set by the Head of Marketing.

Reports to: Head of Marketing.

Responsibilities

Content production and publishing

  • Run the content production and publication calendar across all web properties: main website (DatoCMS), blog (HubSpot), and social channels, executing against priorities set with the Head of Marketing.
  • Write and edit blog posts, product/solution pages, landing pages, and email content. Draft press releases to the Head of Marketing's messaging; final messaging and release approval stay with the Head of Marketing.
  • Publish and maintain content directly in DatoCMS using the Marketing Editor role: create records, manage assets, use draft/preview workflow, publish. No coding required; schema changes remain with the web development team.
  • Own the customer Success Story pipeline: interview coordination, drafting, customer approval loop, publication (landing page + PDF + social announcement).

Content operations

  • Act as the marketing-side owner of CMS content quality: image sizing and alt text, metadata, slugs, structured fields, internal linking.
  • Coordinate with the web development team when content requires new page templates, blocks, or schema changes — write the requirement, not the code.
  • Maintain content governance: what lives where (website vs. blog vs. docs vs. knowledge base), avoiding duplication across properties.

SEO / discoverability

  • Own on-page SEO for marketing content: titles, meta descriptions, headings, structured data fields exposed in the CMS.
  • Contribute to answer-engine optimization (AEO) efforts: content structured for LLM/AI-assistant consumption.
  • Monitor content performance (GA4, Search Console, HubSpot analytics) and produce a monthly content report with actions.

Distribution

  • Repurpose long-form content into social posts, newsletter items, and community forum announcements.
  • Coordinate publication timing with product releases, events, and campaigns.

Cross-functional

  • Translate engineering and product material into accurate, readable marketing content; verify technical claims with engineers before publishing.
  • Support sales with content assets: one-pagers, comparison pages, battlecards.

Requirements

Skills

  • Hands-on experience with a headless CMS (DatoCMS, Contentful, Sanity, Storyblok, or similar) — comfortable working in structured content models, not just WYSIWYG editors.
  • Native-level written English; ability to edit technical drafts from non-native speakers into clean prose.
  • Working knowledge of on-page SEO and web analytics (GA4, Search Console).
  • Ability to read technical documentation and hold a credible conversation with network engineers about what a feature does — you do not need to configure BGP, but you must not misdescribe it.
  • Self-directed; comfortable in a distributed team using Jira, Confluence, and Slack.

Experience

  • 3+ years in content marketing or content management for a technical/B2B product (networking, infrastructure, developer tools, open source strongly preferred).

Nice to have

  • Networking/IT industry background or certifications (e.g., CCNA-level familiarity).
  • Experience with HubSpot (blog + email + CRM).
  • Experience in open-source communities (forums, GitHub-adjacent content, community announcements).
  • Basic Markdown/HTML literacy; familiarity with Git-based workflows.
  • Experience producing customer case studies including interview and approval management.

Work Conditions and Compensation

Fully Remote Work: This 100% remote position allows you to work anywhere.

Flexible Work Schedule: We offer a flexible work schedule that allows you to manage your time while ensuring effective collaboration across our globally distributed teams. The official workday starts between 8 AM and 11 AM (employee local time) and ends between 5 PM and 8 PM (employee local time). While flexibility is encouraged, occasional work outside typical hours may be required to align with colleagues in different time zones. Open communication and availability for cross-time-zone meetings are essential for seamless teamwork.

Time Tracking: Employees are required to use time tracker software to monitor working hours and productivity.

Vacation: Enjoy 20 days of annual paid vacation

National Holidays: You are entitled to up to 10 days of paid leave for recognized national holidays.

Sick Leave: is provided in accordance with company policy

About VyOS Networks

VyOS Networks is a company dedicated to creating cutting-edge, open-source network solutions that empower organizations to manage their networks with flexibility and control. As the company behind the VyOS network operating system, we are committed to delivering a robust, scalable, and secure platform that meets the diverse needs of businesses, service providers, and network professionals worldwide.

At VyOS Networks, our work goes beyond just providing technology - we’re shaping the future of networking with a global, community-driven project. We foster an environment where talented individuals come together to solve complex networking challenges, while continuously improving both our products and ourselves.

Our Mission

Powering a connected world, engineering for the future.

We believe that the future of networking lies in open collaboration, continuous innovation, and delivering solutions that keep the world connected, efficiently and securely.

Our Core Values

Our values define who we are as a team and how we approach our work every day:

  • Respect: We believe in fostering a respectful environment where we value each other's perspectives and contributions. We maintain a deep respect for our colleagues, our open-source community, and our clients, ensuring that all interactions are guided by understanding, professionalism, and empathy.
  • Responsibility: Trust is the foundation of our success. We hold ourselves to the highest standards of honesty, dependability, and accountability. Whether delivering on a commitment to a client or collaborating with a team member, we take responsibility for our actions and their impact.
  • Improvement: We are driven by a relentless desire to improve - ourselves, our products, and the world of networking. Continuous learning, innovation, and refining our processes are key to pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

Job Description:

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior ServiceNow Developer with deep expertise in the ServiceNow design and development across our ServiceNow platform. The ideal candidate has a strong development background, excellent analytical ability, and hands-on experience with ITSM ServiceNow modules including Now Assist.

Meaningful Work and Personal Impact

As an Sr ServiceNow Developer , your work will directly contribute to the success and stability of our ServiceNow environment. In this role, you will:

  • Design, develop, and maintain forms, flows, catalog items, integrations, etc.

  • Collaborate with developers, product owners, process owners, and platform engineers to define requirements.

  • Support Agile ceremonies and uphold quality assurance throughout the lifecycle

  • Adhere to and enforce ServiceNow and OneGDIT best practices.

  • Support platform upgrades, patching, and deployments.

  • Participate in Agile software development efforts (standups, planning, grooming, estimation) to ensure quality delivery.

  • Collaborate with Scrum Masters, Product Owners, and Developers.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

We are looking for candidates with both expertise and a passion for innovation. Requirements include:

Education

• High school diploma required; AA or Bachelor’s degree preferred

Required Skills

  • 3 years of experience in prompt engineering, Now Assist and agentic AI.

  • 7+ years of ServiceNow development experience within ITSM environment

  • Strong understanding of ServiceNow architecture, modules, and platform capabilities

  • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) or ability to obtain CSA cert within 90 days

  • Extensive experience designing forms, UI policies, client scripts, workflows, business rules, integrations, and custom applications

  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies

  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and debugging skills

  • Excellent communication and documentation skills

  • Must be a U.S. person

Preferred Certifications

  • Certified Implementation Specialist – ITSM

  • Certified Application Developer - ITSM

  • Advanced ITSM certifications a strong plus

  • ITIL v4 Certification

GDIT IS YOUR PLACE

At GDIT, the mission is our purpose, and our people are at the center of everything we do.
● Growth: AI-powered career tool that identifies career steps and learning opportunities
● Support: An internal mobility team focused on helping you achieve your career goals
● Rewards: Comprehensive benefits and wellness packages, 401K with company match, and competitive pay and paid time off
● Flexibility: Full-flex work week to own your priorities at work and at home
● Community: Award-winning culture of innovation and a military-friendly workplace

OWN YOUR OPPORTUNITY
Explore a career in software development at GDIT and you’ll find endless opportunities to grow alongside colleagues who share your dedication to advancing innovation.

The likely salary range for this position is $97,968 - $126,500. This is not, however, a guarantee of compensation or salary. Rather, salary will be set based on experience, geographic location and possibly contractual requirements and could fall outside of this range.

Scheduled Weekly Hours:

40

Travel Required:

None

Any Location / Remote

Additional Work Locations:

Total Rewards at GDIT:

Our benefits package for all US-based employees includes a variety of medical plan options, some with Health Savings Accounts, dental plan options, a vision plan, and a 401(k) plan offering the ability to contribute both pre and post-tax dollars up to the IRS annual limits and receive a company match. To encourage work/life balance, GDIT offers employees full flex work weeks where possible and a variety of paid time off plans, including vacation, sick and personal time, holidays, paid parental, military, bereavement and jury duty leave. GDIT typically provides new employees with 15 days of paid leave per calendar year to be used for vacations, personal business, and illness and an additional 10 paid holidays per year. Paid leave and paid holidays are prorated based on the employee’s date of hire. The GDIT Paid Family Leave program provides a total of up to 160 hours of paid leave in a rolling 12 month period for eligible employees. To ensure our employees are able to protect their income, other offerings such as short and long-term disability benefits, life, accidental death and dismemberment, personal accident, critical illness and business travel and accident insurance are provided or available. We regularly review our Total Rewards package to ensure our offerings are competitive and reflect what our employees have told us they value most.

Our Identity Verification Process:

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during virtual interviews. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud. By proceeding, you authorize the collection, processing, and use of your biometric data for identity verification and security purposes.

About Our Work:

We are GDIT. A global technology and professional services company that delivers technology solutions and mission services to every major agency across the U.S. government, defense and intelligence community. Our 26,000 experts extract the power of technology to create immediate value and deliver solutions at the edge of innovation. raw.excerpt: At WorkWave, we are committed to empowering the hardworking service professionals who keep our world safe, clean, and beautiful.
raw.description:
At WorkWave, we are committed to empowering the hardworking service professionals who keep our world safe, clean, and beautiful. Through our powerful suite of software solutions, we give these business owners the tools they need to run their businesses more efficiently, increase profitability, and deliver exceptional service.

We are seeking a Product Designer to craft intuitive and efficient product experiences. You will partner with product and engineering teams to deliver high-quality design solutions for well-defined problems, creating and validating designs while considering the secondary consequences of your decisions. You will be part of our collaborative, diverse team who value winning as a team and innovating to change the industry.

This role is perfect for an experienced product designer who thrives on solving complex problems for non-technical users, has a passion for creating products that feel effortless to use, and wants to make a meaningful impact on the lives of hardworking service professionals across the country.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

    Product Design Excellence
    ● Transform customer and business objectives into compelling products that have purpose, simplicity, and are feasible to build
    ● Develop multiple solutions for defined challenges across our product suite. You will manage the design process from concept to delivery, ensuring your work is aligned with business goals and maintains a high bar for quality
    ● Manage the design process for your projects from discovery and concept ideation through flows, wireframes to full-fidelity prototype designs
    ● Ensure all designs prioritize the needs of non-technical users, focusing on simplicity, speed, and trust

    Collaboration & Communication
    ● Partner with leadership and product marketing stakeholders to ensure design concepts meet our customers' needs and deliver desired results
    ● Collaborate closely with business stakeholders, product managers, engineers, and other designers in a triad model
    ● Clearly present your design process, inspiration, and decisions to stakeholders, explaining the “why” behind your work
    ● Use storytelling techniques to communicate complex design rationale and build alignment across teams
    ● Share your work in design reviews to explain your decisions, triage feedback, and use it to iterate on your solutions

    Design System & Consistency
    ● Champion cohesion, consistency, and accessibility by delivering designs that promote our organization's experience strategy and design system usage
    ● Apply design system standards consistently while contributing to its evolution based on user needs.
    ● Connect multiple screens into cohesive flows and contribute minor updates to the evolution of the design system based on user needs.
    ● Across all work apply Jobs-to-be-Done methodology and user-centered design principles, conducting customer interviews and usability tests and translating findings into design iterations.
    ● Demonstrate a solid understanding of customer needs, core workflows, and key business goals, using this context to make informed design decisions with minimal guidance

    Mentorship & Growth
    ● Continuously learn new design skills to improve overall design delivery, while building depth in one or two core areas
    ● Coach team-level peers through their design decisions and share learnings with your immediate peers and the team
    ● Nurture WorkWave's culture and principles within your team and the broader design practice
    ● Participate in design critiques, in both presenting and providing constructive feedback that elevates team output
    ● Stay current with design trends, tools, and methodologies, particularly those relevant to AI-powered products

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

    ● 4 or more years of experience as a user experience/product designer, interaction designer, information architect, or similar role
    ● Proven experience successfully delivering product design initiatives that improved user outcomes or business metrics
    ● Strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality digital products that delivered results and showcase the depth of your design skills
    ● Proven experience clearly communicating design decisions and their impact on the customer
    ● Solid capacity to communicate and present complex problems clearly to diverse audiences
    ● Deep understanding of user-centered design processes and human-computer interaction principles
    ● Demonstrated ability to evaluate the customer and business impact of your design decisions
    ● Proficiency in modern design tools (Figma preferred) and design thinking methodologies
    ● Proven ability to evaluate the customer and business impact of design decisions using both qualitative and quantitative research methods
    ● Bachelor's degree in Design, HCI, or related field, or equivalent professional experience in the design field
    ● Demonstrated commitment to continuous learning and staying current with design trends and best practices

WHAT WOULD ALSO BE AWESOME:

    ● Experience designing complex workflows for enterprise or SaaS products, particularly in B2B environments
    ● Background in designing for service industry workflows or field service management
    ● Experience with enterprise product design or financial services product design
    ● Previous work on AI-powered features or data-driven product experiences
    ● Experience working on complex problems at a systems/service level
    ● Knowledge of Jobs-to-be-Done methodology and service design principles
    ● Understanding of accessibility standards and inclusive design practices
    ● Experience with design systems and component-based design approaches
    ● Experience mentoring junior designers or leading design initiatives
    ● Background working in cross-functional product teams using agile methodologies
    ● Experience presenting to and influencing senior stakeholders and executives

WHAT YOU SHOULD KNOW ABOUT US:

• We are laid back but buttoned up. We offer a casual work environment and remote work flexibility and have a passion for developing creative, innovative best in class solutions that directly contribute to the success of our customers
• We care deeply and deliver service and solutions that make a real difference in the lives of our clients and their businesses
• We openly accept others as they are and build strong partnerships based on trust
• Teamwork and collaboration is key to help our colleagues and customers solve their challenges
• Our team is energetic, fun, naturally inquisitive and eager to make an impact, we invite you to join us!

LOVE WHAT YOU DO, NO MATTER WHERE YOU DO IT:

• Join our Remote-First Global Work Community: WorkWave provides an innovative and dynamic remote-first Global Work Community that encourages growth, creativity, and collaboration. No matter what stage of your career or where you live, WorkWave is your place to be part of a global company with a startup feel, where your ideas matter and your growth is a priority.

A GLOBAL COMPANY WITH A LOCAL PRESENCE:

• We know that there are benefits of being in the office and working from home. WorkWave promotes a healthy work/life balance and provides employees with the flexibility of collaborating in the office or the option to work virtually if desired. Our teams are well versed at working collaboratively in a fully virtual environment.
• Our HQ is based at our state of the art home office in the historic Bell Works complex located in Holmdel Township, New Jersey. We keep our offices available to all to use when working remotely isn’t feasible, or to help with cross training, team building and/or brainstorming.
• We have employees in over 30 states, 7 countries and many regional offices - each with their own set of perks and opportunities to give back to the local community.
• Whether you work remotely or take advantage of one of our offices, you’ll find a community of WorkWavers that value diversity, and care deeply about our products, clients, our communities and each other.

RELAX, WE'VE GOT YOU COVERED:

• Employees can expect a robust benefits package, including health and dental and 401k with company match

AND BEYOND...

• Find your perfect work/life balance with our Flexible Time Off policy or generous PTO plan (role dependent) and paid holidays
• Up to 4 weeks paid bonding leave
• Tuition reimbursement
• Robust Employee Assistance Program through TotalCare offering free counseling 24/7/365, plus financial counseling, legal guidance, adoption assistance services and much more!
• 24/7 access to virtual medical care with Teladoc
• Quarterly awards based on peer nominations
• Regional discounts and perks
• Opportunities to participate in charitable events and give back to the community

GROW WITH US:

• We understand the impact of attracting and keeping top talent and reward intellectual curiosity and a thirst for personal and professional growth
• Encouraging our employees that already have an intimate knowledge of and passion for our products to apply for other roles within our walls just makes sense!
• Our employees have access to extensive video libraries for soft skill and role specific training available 24/7 and live trainings are provided throughout the year

JOIN OUR WINNING TEAM!

• 10 Time winner of Best Place to Work in New Jersey by NJBiz!
• WorkWave has been recognized with multiple awards for its outstanding products, growth and culture, including the Inc. 5000, SaaS Award, IT World Awards, Globe Awards, Silver Stevie Award for Employer of the Year, and Best Place to Work Inc. Magazine
• Recently named one of The Software Report's 3rd annual list of the Top 100 Software Companies of 2022 (worldwide!)
We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status:Don't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At WorkWave, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you feel like you could make a great impact in this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles!
